# DIAL-IN search accounts

Log On to DIAL-IN [1]

### What is a DIAL-IN search account and who can get one?

If you regularly need to search DMV records for driver license, registration, vehicle (title) or insurance information, then DIAL-IN is the service you need. Our typical clients include attorneys, insurance and private investigators, process servers and building/site security personnel.

See Drivers Privacy Protection Act (DPPA) [2] for more information about permissible uses of DMV records.

### How do I apply for an account?

You should complete form Motor Vehicle Record Search Account Application (PDF) [3] (MV-15D). The instructions are on the form.

Send the form to:

Data Services - New Search AccountNYS Department of Motor Vehicles6 Empire State PlazaAlbany, NY 12228

### How will I know my application has been accepted?

We will review your application. If you application is not complete, we will return your application with an explanation that will give you more instructions.

If your application is complete, we will create an account for you. We will send you your account number and password. Your seven-digit account number will never change. You will enter this account number when you log in to the DIAL-IN system.

### Are there fees for using a DIAL-IN search account?

According to the NYS Vehicle and Traffic Law, we must charge a fee to search DMV records. Private persons, commercial organizations, and not-for-profit organizations must pay a search fee. There is a fee of $7.00 for each search that you make with the DIAL-IN service.

There are some organizations that are exempt from search fees. Any public organization, its officers, a volunteer fire company, a volunteer ambulance service, or a legal aid bureau or society or other private entity acting pursuant to section 722 of the New York State County Law, that makes a search for a public purpose, is exempt from the search fee.

### How do I pay DIAL-IN Search Account fees?

Paying customers must include a deposit with the application. Your first deposit must be enough to pay for two months of searches. When we accept your application, your deposit is added to your new account balance. When you make a search, we subtract the search fee from your account balance.

Payment by credit card is NOT available at this time.

You can use your account to pay for the mail-order searches and the online searches. If you must pay a fee for the service, your account records will reflect your debits and your credits and show your account balance. For more information, please visit our Escrow Accounts [4] page.

### What business records must I keep to document the searches I perform?

The business records you keep must exist prior to the search you perform and must establish the business purpose of the search.

Common examples of business records include invoices, retainer agreements, employment applications, consent forms, accident reports, and surveillance reports and numerous other types of records. The Terms of Service of your Search Account require you to maintain these records and to provide them to DMV when requested.

### Will DMV contact me about the searches I perform using my DIAL-IN Search Account?

Yes, DMV may ask you about a DIAL-IN search you performed. We inquire about searches to monitor compliance with the DIAL-IN Terms of Service.You must respond to the inquiry whether or not you have business records that support your search. Your response will be considered an incomplete reply if you do not give us the business records. You can complete an inquiry at any time if you send us the requested acceptable business records. If you performed the search on behalf of a client, you will need to show permissible use of your client, and your client agent relationship. If you personally did not perform the search we have inquired about, please check with the other users of your DIAL-IN account to see if one of them performed the search. If none of the known users performed the search, contact us immediately.If you do not respond to our inquiry about a DIAL-IN search, your search privileges will be suspended until you respond.

### Will you tell a motorist if I searched his records?

Yes. Records of searches are public records. If a motorist asks the DMV if his records were searched, the DMV supplies him with

- the name and business address of the DIAL-IN account holder, and
- the time, date and search criteria used to search for the records.

We do not disclose the DIAL-IN account numbers of the account holder that performed the search.

### How do I contact DMV about my Dial-in Search Account?

You can contact us at:NYSDMV DIAL-IN AccountsRoom 2316 Empire State PlazaAlbany, NY 12228(518) 473-2137e-mail: [email protected] [5]

### Note on browser compatibility

We are upgrading our security protocols to better protect your data. To verify your browser is compatible to continue using any of the state's government websites, please visit https://encryption.ny.gov/ [6]. If your browser is not currently compatible, please update it to the newest version.

# 柴油车排放检测

非豁免的柴油动力机动车可能需要进行OBDII排放检测或柴油排放检测。有关这些检测的更多信息，请参见下表。

### 柴油动力车辆排放检测

### 需进行柴油排放检测的车辆

所有在NYMA或柴油排放大都市区（DEMA）注册的非豁免柴油动力车辆（某些注册可能显示或未显示其位于DEMA内），且车辆注册证书上标明的最大总重量（MGW）超过8,500磅，必须每年进行柴油排放检测。柴油排放检测必须与年度安全检测同时进行。DEMA包括纽约市五个区，以及拿骚县、萨福克县、罗克兰县和威斯特彻斯特县。车辆型号年份并不免除检测要求。请阅读检测法规第79.2(h)节，了解豁免车辆的信息。

所有在柴油排放大都市区（DEMA）以外注册的柴油动力车辆，若最大总重量（MGW）超过8,500磅，则无需进行年度柴油排放检测，但可能接受随机的路边柴油排放检测。

所有1997年款及更新的非豁免柴油动力车辆，在纽约州任何地方注册，且车辆总重量额定值（GVWR）低于8,501磅，必须每年进行OBDII排放检测，且不适用柴油排放检测。

所有1996年款及更早的柴油动力车辆，在纽约州任何地方注册，且车辆总重量额定值（GVWR）低于8,501磅，不适用OBDII排放检测、低增强排放检测或柴油排放检测。

### 柴油烟度排放

柴油烟度排放检测在纽约州其他地区或对州外注册车辆不作要求。然而，纽约州环境保护部、纽约州交通部或纽约州警察可在纽约州任何高速公路上的路边检测点对任何MGW超过8,500磅的柴油动力车辆进行检测。若车辆未通过路边检测，可能会被开具交通罚单。

### 临时排放豁免证书（VS-1078）

当现有的柴油排放检测证书在车辆位于DEMA之外时到期，该居民可向机动车管理局申请“临时排放豁免证书”（VS-1078）。临时排放豁免证书仅在DMV发证办公室提供。当临时排放豁免证书与有效的纽约安全检测证书一同展示在车辆上时，允许车辆在DEMA之外运行。临时排放豁免证书自车辆返回NYMA之日起十（10）天内有效。请阅读纽约州DMV机动车检测法规（pdf）[1]（CR-79）第79.1(r)条。

### 柴油排放检测何时何地进行？

柴油排放检测在年度安全检测时进行，并在柴油排放检测站进行。

### 纽约大都市区（NYMA）的非柴油排放检测站

该检测站可进行其他检测，但不能检测需进行柴油排放检测的车辆。

### 费用

您可参阅检测组别与费用表（pdf）[2]（VS-77）获取此信息。

### 成为柴油排放检测站

检测站必须购买DMV认可的烟度计（查找供应商）。如果检测站获得许可对特定类型的车辆进行安全检查，则该站可对柴油动力车辆进行排放检测。为证明已购买经认可的烟度计，检测站必须将发票复印件发送至以下地址

NYS DMV Bureau of Consumer & Facility Services Application Unit P.O. Box 2700 Albany, NY 12220-0700

如有疑问，请致电1-518-474-0919。

- 1. 车辆总重量额定值
- 2. 最大总重量
- 3. NYMA - 纽约大都会区

# 驾照与学习驾照费用及退款

### 学习驾照和驾照的费用

首次申请纽约州驾照或学习驾照，或因吊销后重新申请新驾照或学习驾照的费用，取决于申请时的年龄和居住地。总费用包括

- 驾照申请费
- 驾照类型费用（更多信息请参见驾照类别 [1]）
- 文件费
- 大都会通勤交通区（MCTD）费用（如居住于MCTD区域内）

### MCTD费用

以下县的居民必须支付大都会通勤交通区（MCTD）费用：

布朗克斯、国王（布鲁克林）、纽约（曼哈顿）、皇后、里士满（史泰登岛）、达奇斯、拿骚、奥兰治、普特南、罗克兰、萨福克和威斯特彻斯特。

MCTD费用为每6个月有效期收取 $1.00。

### 费用表

下表显示您需支付的总费用。表中未显示

- 商业驾照（CDL）费用
- 获取增强版驾照（EDL）而非普通驾照的额外 $30 费用
- 非驾驶员ID卡 [2] 的费用

* 包含MCTD费用

** Class M和MJ费用的一部分用于支持纽约州摩托车安全计划。

### 更换驾照或学习驾照的费用

更换驾照或学习驾照的费用为 $17.50。

### 更改驾照或学习驾照信息的费用

更改（修正）驾照或学习驾照信息的费用为 $12.50。

### 增强版驾照（EDL）或增强版学习驾照的费用

Enhanced Driver License需额外支付$30.00费用。

### 摩托车驾照费用

首次申请摩托车驾照所需支付的费用取决于

- 您目前是否持有其他类别的纽约州驾照，以及
- 申请时的确切年龄。

Class M或MJ驾照的费用，或在现有驾照上增加Class M或MJ的费用，范围从$21到$120。我们无法在您申请前计算确切费用。

### 我可以获得驾照费用退款吗？

如果您符合条件，可以获得8年驾照费用的部分退款。最高退款金额为原8年驾照费用的50%（即4年）。部分退款不包括任何申请费或文件费。

如果您符合以下条件，则有资格获得部分退款：

- 驾照签发时有效期为8年
- 在8年期限的前4年内将驾照交回给我们或另一州
- 交回时驾照未被吊销或撤销
- 未将驾照换成非驾驶员ID卡

申请退款，您必须：

- 在驾照签发日期后不超过51个月内申请
- 填写《机动车注册和驾照费用退款申请表》[3] (MV-215)
- 如果尚未交回驾照，请将驾照附在MV-215表格上
- 如果您将纽约州驾照换成了其他州的驾照，请将外州驾照的复印件附在MV-215表格上
- 将所需表格和文件邮寄至表格上所列地址
- 退款处理时间最长可达12周

# Driving in New York State

### Who can drive here?

To drive a car or motorcycle in New York State, you must

- be at least 16 years old 1 and
- have a valid New York State driver license or learner permit, or
- a valid driver license or permit issued by another state or country

If you have a New York State learner permit or one issued in another state, you must follow New York State permit restrictions [1].

If you are under age 18, you must obey New York's Graduated License Law [2].

### Residents of New York

If you become a New York State resident, you must get a New York State driver license within 30 days. If you have a valid driver license issued by another U.S. state or territory, federal district or Canadian province, you may be eligible to exchange it for a New York driver license (see Exchange an out-of-state license [3]), or see other information about moving to New York [4].

If your license was issued outside the U.S. or Canada, you must apply for a new original New York State driver license at a DMV office (see Get a driver license [5]). When you pass your road test, you must give your foreign driver license to the DMV road test examiner. The local DMV office will destroy your foreign driver license after 60 days. If you plan to return to your home country and will need your foreign driver license, ask the road test examiner how to make sure that your foreign driver license is not destroyed.

Definition of "Resident"

Section 250 (5) of the NY State Vehicle and Traffic Law says:

To live in a house, a home, an apartment, a room or other similar place in New York State for 90 days is considered "presumptive evidence" that you are a resident of New York State. A police officer can use this as evidence to issue a traffic ticket if you drive in New York State without a New York State driver license or vehicle registration.

A judge considers the law and the evidence of your intent and decides if you are a resident of New York State. If you pay taxes or your children attend school in another state, a judge considers these facts to decide if your intent is to make New York a "fixed and permanent" residence. According to this law, students from other states or from other nations who attend school in New York State are usually not considered residents of New York. DMV does not decide if you are a resident of New York State, if you must get a New York State driver license, or if you must register your vehicle in New York State.

### Non-residents

#### Out-of-state and foreign driver licenses

You can drive in New York State with a valid driver license from another state or country. You don t need to apply for a New York State driver license unless you become a New York State resident.

If you have a driver license from another country you do not need to have an International Driving Permit, but it is helpful. The permit verifies in several languages that you have a valid driver license. Police officers who can t read the language on your foreign driver license will be able to read the permit. Contact the authorities in your home country to get an International Driving Permit.

#### Visitors from other countries

If you have a driver license from any nation, you do not need a New York State license to drive in New York State. You should only apply for a New York State driver license if you become a resident of New York State.

If you do not have a license in your home country and want to get a New York State driver license, you must pass a written test, complete a 5-hour pre-licensing course and pass a road test. See Get a driver license [5].

#### Students

Students from other states or from other nations who attend school in New York State are normally not considered New York State residents.

#### Out-of-state learner permits

You may drive in New York State with a learner permit issued in another state if

- you are age 16 or older
- your out-of-state learner permit is valid outside the issuing state
- you obey all restrictions of the state that issued the learner permit and
  - the general restrictions for learner permit holders [1] in New York State
  - if you are under age 18, the additional restrictions explained in the Graduated Driver License (GDL) Law and drivers under age 18 [2]

You cannot exchange out-of-state permit for a New York State permit. You must apply for a New York permit at a DMV office if your out-of-state learner permit does not allow you to drive in New York State.

- 1. Even if you have a learner permit or a driver license from another state, you are not exempt from this rule.

在以下情况下，护航驾驶员认证是强制性的

要成为合格的认证护航驾驶员，您必须

- 年满21岁或以上

text:
[护航驾驶员认证 [1] > 我如何获得护航车辆驾驶员认证？]
要获得护航车辆驾驶员认证

- 前往提供护航驾驶员认证考试的DMV办公室
- 填写车辆护航驾驶员申请表（PDF）[2]（MV-65）
- 参加笔试 3

您无需预约即可参加考试。但是，并非所有DMV办公室都提供该考试。请致电您计划参加考试的DMV办公室，以确保该地点提供该考试。如果您持有纽约州驾驶执照，前往办公室参加考试时必须携带。如果您持有其他州签发的驾驶执照，则必须携带有效的驾驶执照和额外的身份证明前往办公室。有关可接受额外身份证明的更多信息，请参阅DMV文件指南 [3]。

通过考试所需的所有信息均包含在交通部认证护航手册（PDF）[4]中。

您还应熟悉纽约州驾驶员手册 [5]。

如果您通过考试，您将立即获得提供超限货物护航服务的认证。您将获得一份为期60天的临时护航驾驶员证书。您的永久证书将通过邮件寄送。提供护航服务时，您必须随身携带该证书。

参加车辆护送考试的費用为40.00美元。支票抬头必须写明支付给机动车管理局局长。初次认证不收取额外费用。

如果您未通过笔试，可以再次参加。每次参加考试的费用为40.00美元。

text:
[护航驾驶员认证 [1] > 我的护送车辆认证何时到期，以及如何续期？]
如果您持有纽约州驾驶执照，您的护送驾驶员证书将与驾驶执照同时到期。如果您持有其他州的驾驶执照，您的证书自签发之日起有效期为四年。

您将通过邮件收到续期通知。请按照续期通知中的说明续办您的护送驾驶员证书。请记住保持您的邮寄地址在纽约州DMV的最新状态。

如果您在到期日期后两年内未续期认证，您将需要重新参加并通过笔试，之后才能重新获得认证。

text:
[护航驾驶员认证 [1] > 如果我需要更改地址或姓名，该怎么办？]
如果您持有纽约州驾驶执照，您必须在十天内更改您的地址[6]或姓名[7]。巴士驾驶员部门无法为您进行更改。

如果您持有其他州签发的驾驶执照，您必须在十天内书面通知DMV的巴士驾驶员部门。请将您的DMV ID号码（客户ID号码）（位于您的护送证书上）、以前的地址或姓名以及您的新地址或姓名发送至：

纽约州机动车管理局巴士驾驶员部门客户服务部6 Empire State Plaza, Room 136B Albany, NY 12228

[护航驾驶员认证 [1] > 如果我需要更换证书，该怎么办？]
如果您的车辆护送卡丢失、被盗或损毁，您可以写信给DMV申请更换。您必须发送您的姓名、地址和DMV ID号码（客户ID号码）（位于您的护送证书上）（如有）。请将您的请求以及一张5美元的支票或汇票（抬头写明支付给机动车管理局局长）发送至：

heading_path: 护航驾驶员认证 [1]
如果我的驾驶执照被吊销或暂停，我的护送车辆认证仍然有效吗？
text:
[护航驾驶员认证 [1] > 如果我的驾驶执照被吊销或暂停，我的护送车辆认证仍然有效吗？]
不。如果您的驾驶执照或驾驶特权在签发管辖区被吊销或暂停，或者您已失去在纽约州的驾驶特权，您的护送证书无效。

您的认证也可能被取消，如果

- 违反安全护送程序或NYCRR（纽约州法典、规则和条例）第17篇第154部分
- 您身体上、精神上或医疗上无法驾驶
- 您在申请护送驾驶员认证时提供虚假或欺诈信息

根据违规的性质，驾驶员可能面临罚款和处罚。4

chunk_id: Escort driver certification#1_0::c0009

heading_path: 护航驾驶员认证 [1]
纽约州是否承认其他州颁发的护航车辆驾驶员认证？
text:
[护航驾驶员认证 [1] > 纽约州是否承认其他州颁发的护航车辆驾驶员认证？]
不可以。要在纽约州合法驾驶护航车辆，您必须持有有效的纽约州认证车辆护航卡（MV-64）。在纽约州驾驶护航车辆时，您必须随身携带MV-64卡和驾驶执照。

- 1. 这些是指宽度超过12英尺、长度达到或超过80英尺、高度达到或超过14英尺的负载。还包括负载/车辆超出主体部分超过10英尺的悬伸负载。
- 2. 没有当前纽约州驾驶特权的外州驾驶员不符合护航认证资格。
- 3. 您将在DMV办公室收到考试表格。不允许携带笔记、手册和其他学习材料。管理考试的DMV工作人员不得讨论问题或提供任何帮助。
- 4. 参见纽约州车辆与交通法和/或纽约州法规、规章第17篇第154部分和/或纽约州法规、规章第21篇第102部分。

托管账户定义
text:
[Escrow accounts（托管账户） > 托管账户定义]
托管金额 - DMV要求搜索账户的最低托管金额至少为$200。我们建议您在托管账户中保留足够的资金以覆盖2个月的事务。要更改您的托管金额，您必须使用公司信笺向DMV Revenue Accounts发送请求。请求必须签名并注明日期，并包含账户号码。托管账户对账单 - 在每月的最后一个工作日，DMV会自动发出该月托管账户活动的对账单。借记 - 按日期从托管账户中扣除的金额。您的对账单不提供每笔借记的详细信息。您的对账单仅提供按日期和产品或服务类型划分的总借记金额。贷记 - 按日期向您的托管账户支付的款项。款项在收到当天下午3:00前记入您的账户。余额 - 您的托管账户中可用的金额。如果余额达到零或负数，账户将被禁用。在收到并处理付款之前，您无法使用该账户支付交易。负数表示账户透支。截至目前的月度费用 - 对账单期间您账户的总借记额。总费用 - 您账户的累计借记总额。托管不足 - 表示您账户中的余额低于所需的托管金额。支付此金额 - 将您的账户余额恢复到所需托管金额所需的付款金额。

ACH（自动清算所）付款 - 通过DMV网站从您的银行账户向您的托管账户进行电子资金转账。

# Exchange your out-of-state driver license

## Exchange your out-of-state driver license [1]

You must exchange your-out-state driver license (from another U.S. state or territory, federal district or Canadian province) within 30 days of becoming a resident of New York. 1

Your out-of-state license must

- have your photograph

- be valid or expired less than 24 months

- have been issued at least 6 months before you apply for a New York license (unless it is commercial driver license that has been valid for any amount of time) 2

You cannot exchange your license if it is

- suspended or revoked 3

- lost or stolen 4

- a hardship or an "employment only driver license" 5

- marked "non-renewable" or "non-transferable" 6

Your New York license will be valid for 5 years.

### At the DMV

This transaction can only be processed in person, at a DMV office.

You will need to

- pass a vision test at the DMV or bring a completed Eye Test Report (PDF) [2] (MV-619)

- surrender your out-of-state license, unless it is lost or stolen

- bring proof of identity

Complete this guide to make sure you have the documents and proofs of identity you need.

Find your proofs [3]

We will give you a temporary non-photo license document. Allow 2 weeks for your new license to arrive in the mail.

For quicker service, make a reservation online before visiting offices in New York City, Westchester, Nassau, Suffolk, Rockland, Onondaga, Monroe or Albany Counties. For all other counties, see our office locations and hours [4].

Make a Reservation [5]

- **** Residents of these counties must pay the Metropolitan Commuter Transportation District (MCTD) fee ($10):

Bronx, Kings (Brooklyn), New York (Manhattan), Queens, Richmond (Staten Island), Dutchess, Nassau, Orange, Putnam, Rockland, Suffolk and Westchester.

Enhanced documents have an additional $30.00 fee.

We accept

- cash

- most credit, pinless debit or prepaid cards (American Express, Discover Card/Novus, MasterCard, VISA)

- a personal check or a money order payable to

### Additional information

#### I am studying in New York State. Do I need a New York State driver license?

Students from other states, countries or nations who attend school in New York State are normally not considered residents of New York State, so they don t need to exchange their current driver license.

Normally, you can t have a NY State driver license and a driver license from another state at the same time, but there are exceptions. However, it is a violation of Federal law to hold more than one commercial driver license (CDL).

#### Drivers from other countries

You can drive in New York State with a valid driver license from another country. You do not need to apply for a New York State driver license unless you become a New York State resident.

To get a New York State driver license, you must pass a written test, complete a 5-hour pre-licensing course and pass a road test. See Get a driver license [6].

When you pass your road test, you must give your foreign driver license to the DMV road test examiner. The local DMV office will destroy your foreign driver license after 60 days. If you plan to return to your home country and will need your foreign driver license, ask the road test examiner how to make sure that your foreign driver license is not destroyed.

The DMV has additional resources for drivers from other countries [7].

- 1.

To live in a house, a home, an apartment, a room or other similar place in NYS for 90 days is considered "presumptive evidence" that you are a resident of New York State. A police officer can use this as evidence to issue a traffic ticket if you drive in New York State without a New York State driver license or vehicle registration.

A judge considers the law and the evidence of your intent and decides if you are a resident of New York State. If you pay taxes or your children attend school in another state, a judge considers these facts to decide if your intent is to make NYS a "fixed and permanent" residence. According to this law, students from other states or from other nations who attend school in New York State are usually not considered residents of NYS. DMV does not decide if you are a resident of New York State, if you must get a NYS driver license, or if you must register your vehicle in New York State.

- 2. If your out-of-state photo driver license does not show the date it was issued, get a certified driver license record or letter from the state that issued the license that indicates the date of issue. If you cannot get a letter or abstract, you must apply for a new, original driver license. See Get your first driver license [6].

- 3. If your out-of-state driver license or Canadian driver license is suspended or revoked, you cannot apply for a NY State driver license. You must remove the suspension or revocation and bring to a NY State DMV office a valid driver license that meets the requirements listed above.

- 4. If your out-of-state driver license is lost or stolen apply to the previous state for a replacement photo driver license. The replacement driver license must

be a photo driver license - show that your out-of-state driver license was valid for at least 6 months

Instead of a replacement driver license, you can apply to the previous state for a letter or certified driver abstract. The letter or abstract must be

an original document - on the letterhead of the agency that issued your driver license - issued by the other state within six months before you submit the letter or driver abstract to us - the letter or driver abstract must contain all of the following information - your name, address, date of birth and driver license identification number - the type or class of driver license and any restrictions - a list any convictions, suspensions or revocations - the date your driver license was issued and the expiration date of your most recent driver license

A letter or driver abstract has no value as proof of identity or date of birth.

- 5. You must apply for an original NY State driver license [6].

- 6. You must apply for an original NY State driver license [6].

# TNC司机常见问题解答

### 什么是TNC？

TNC代表交通网络公司，这是最近颁布的《州车辆与交通法》中定义的一个术语。TNC是一种企业，也称为“拼车公司”，由DMV许可，使用数字网络将乘客与TNC司机连接起来，进行预先安排的行程。

#### 我如何成为TNC司机？

联系纽约州许可的TNC公司之一。Lyft和Uber目前由DMV许可。

#### 成为TNC司机有年龄和驾照要求吗？

是的，根据法规，TNC司机必须年满19岁，并持有DMV颁发的有效且最新的纽约州驾照。

#### 我的车辆需要获得TNC使用授权吗？

不需要DMV授权。但TNC公司可能对其允许的车辆有要求。

#### 如果我有汽车贷款，我的车辆贷款方会允许我使用个人车辆为TNC驾驶吗？

您应该阅读您的贷款协议并联系您的贷款方，因为任何此类限制都是私人合同问题，而非TNC法案或法规的规定。

#### 我可以使用出租车或礼宾车为TNC驾驶吗？

不可以。TNC法案禁止将出租车、礼宾车、豪华轿车或持照的出租车辆用作TNC车辆。

#### TNC司机的保险要求是什么？

TNC公司将确保TNC司机了解并拥有所需的保险。如果您有兴趣成为TNC司机，您应该联系您感兴趣合作的TNC。

#### 司机可以被多个TNC授权吗？

这取决于您想为之工作的TNC，因为法律上没有限制为多个TNC驾驶。

#### 如果我是授权的TNC司机，我可以在纽约市接载乘客吗？

不，除非您另行获得纽约市出租车与豪华轿车委员会的授权：www.nyc.gov/taxi [1]。

#### 如果我是经授权的TNC司机，我是否可以在纽约市放下我在市外接载的TNC乘客？

可以。

#### 如果我获得纽约市出租车与豪华轿车委员会的许可，可以在纽约市外作为TNC司机工作吗？

可以，但前提是您获得持牌TNC公司的授权，并且仅当您使用的车辆不同于在纽约市用于出租运营的车辆（出租车和礼宾车不得用于TNC运营）。

# 联邦真实身份证

## 真实身份证对您意味着什么

从2020年10月1日起，如果您希望使用驾驶执照、许可证或身份证作为身份证明来搭乘国内航班（美国境内）、进入军事基地和某些联邦设施，联邦政府将要求其符合真实身份证标准。

增强版驾驶执照、许可证或非驾驶员身份证[1]以及有效的美国护照已经符合真实身份证标准，可用于登机。

请访问www.dhs.gov [2]了解更多真实身份证信息。

## ####

## 真实身份证法案

2005年由国会通过，真实身份证法案为各州颁发的驾驶执照、许可证和身份证确立了最低安全标准。该法案还禁止联邦机构（如运输安全管理局（TSA））接受不符合这些标准的州签发的证件用于官方目的。

## 纽约州DMV于2017年10月30日开始颁发真实身份证驾驶执照、许可证和身份证

您可以随时申请真实身份证，但您需要前往DMV办公室。您不能通过在线、电话或邮件方式申请真实身份证。

## 您必须携带以下原始或认证证明文件到办公室：

身份证明，如有效的驾驶执照、出生证明或护照，需包含您的全名（名、中间名（如有）和姓）。此姓名将按照联邦法律要求显示在您的卡片上，与您的身份证明上的姓名一致。 社会安全号码或不符合社会安全号码资格的证明。如果您持有有效的纽约州驾驶执照、许可证或身份证，您必须携带您的原始社会安全卡或带有完整社会安全号码的W-2表格。如果您持有纽约州驾驶执照或身份证，您必须携带您的社会安全卡或社会安全管理局出具的信函，证明您不符合拥有社会安全号码的资格。如果您丢失了社会安全卡，您必须在前往DMV之前补办。社会安全管理局网站有更多关于补办卡片的信息[4]。 出生日期证明。 美国公民身份、合法永久居留权或在美国的临时合法身份证明。 两份不同的纽约州居住证明，如水电费账单、银行对账单或抵押贷款对账单（不接受邮政信箱）。此地址将显示在您的卡片上。 如果您的驾驶执照、许可证或非驾驶员身份证申请上的姓名与您的身份、合法身份和社会安全证明上的姓名不符，您必须携带法院或政府签发的证明文件，记录导致您姓名变更的事件，如结婚证、离婚判决书、收养文件或法院命令文件。

申请过程还要求DMV拍摄新照片。

完成本指南，了解在前往办公室之前需要哪些确切的证明文件。

## 查找您的证明文件 [5]

## 真实身份证的费用

申请真实身份证没有额外费用。所有正常交易费用仍然适用。

如果您想申请增强版驾驶执照[1]或增强版身份证[6]，需额外支付$30费用。

## 增强版、REAL ID 和标准驾照样本

了解更多关于增强版、REAL ID 和标准文件的信息 [7]。

## 获取 REAL ID 是强制性的，但鼓励办理

## REAL ID 是可选的，以下情况不需要：

驾驶执照 投票或登记投票 进入不需要出示身份证件的联邦设施 申请或领取联邦福利 获得医疗或生命保障服务（包括医院和诊所）、执法或受宪法保护的活动（包括被告出庭） 参与执法程序或调查

如果您决定不需要 REAL ID 或增强版文件，请注意，2017年10月30日之后颁发的任何驾照、许可证或身份证件将标记为“不适用于联邦用途”。

如果您持有美国护照，可用于身份证明、国内和国际航班登机，以及进入联邦大楼或军事基地。

## 未满18岁

美国运输安全管理局（TSA）目前不要求未满18岁的儿童在美国境内与成人同行时提供身份证明。同行成人需出示可接受的身份证明。请访问 www.tsa.gov [8] 了解更多信息。

根据 FOIL，我可以请求哪些 DMV 记录？
text:
[提交信息自由法 (FOIL) 请求 [1] > 根据 FOIL，我可以请求哪些 DMV 记录？]
您可以根据 FOIL 请求任何 DMV 记录。但是，根据纽约州公职人员法第 87(2) 条，某些记录或部分记录可能被扣留。

当您根据 FOIL 请求 DMV 记录时，DMV 将在收到您的请求后的 5 个工作日内向您发送一封信。这封信将告知您请求已收到。在大多数情况下，记录将在确认信日期后的 20 个工作日内提供。在某些情况下，根据 FOIL 生成记录可能需要超过 20 个工作日。如果 DMV 无法在 20 个工作日内提供您的记录，我们将告知您记录可用的日期。

请参阅 DMV 记录主题列表 [4]。

如何提出 FOIL 请求？
text:
[提交信息自由法 (FOIL) 请求 [1] > 如何提出 FOIL 请求？]
#### 步骤 1：确定您是否需要根据 FOIL 提出请求

阅读 DMV 记录请求表 (PDF) [3] (MV-15)，以确定记录是否无需根据 FOIL 提出请求即可获取。如果您请求的记录可通过使用 MV-15 获取，这样做可能使您比提交 FOIL 请求更快收到记录。

#### 步骤 2：书面提出您的请求

如果您决定您有资格根据 FOIL 请求记录，您必须以书面形式提出 FOIL 请求。

要根据 FOIL 提出请求，请执行以下操作之一

- 填写信息自由法请求表 (PDF) [5] (MV-FOIL)

或

- 写一封描述你所需记录的信。确保包含你的邮寄地址或电子邮件地址。这将使DMV能够将记录发送给你。

#### 第三步：提交你的请求

如果你请求的记录包含个人信息，请同时附上你的驾驶执照或其他政府签发的带照片身份证的复印件。如果你愿意，可以涂黑照片。你必须说明你请求记录的允许用途。允许用途列在MV-15FOIL的第2页。

根据FOIL请求记录需要付费吗？
text:
[提交信息自由法 (FOIL) 请求 [1] > 根据FOIL请求记录需要付费吗？]
是的。法律授权我们收取$10.00的搜索费，以确定你请求的记录是否可用。支付搜索费并不保证你会收到所请求的记录。搜索费不予退还。

我们会告知你请求的记录是否可用。如果记录可用且你想要纸质副本，我们每页收取$1.00的复印费。一页指一张纸，无论单面还是双面。

你可以通过信用卡、支票或汇票支付费用，收款人为Commissioner of Motor Vehicles。

FOIL办公室在收到全额付款之前不会发布你请求的记录。

当某些个人或组织为公共目的进行搜索时，他们免于支付搜索费。这仅适用于以下个人或组织：

- 政府机构
- 志愿消防公司
- 志愿救护服务
- 公职人员、委员会或机构
- 法律援助局或协会，或根据《纽约州郡法》第722条行事的其他私人实体

# 经销商和运输商的一般信息

重要提示：从2018年夏季开始，关于经销商记录保存将有新规定。[1]

最佳信息来源是NY State Dealers & Transporters Regulations (PDF) [2] (CR-78)。

### 按现状销售零售车辆

某些例外情况允许您使用Salvage Certificate (MV-907A)将车辆作为“junk”出售。DMV不能为junk车辆或经过重建的salvage车辆颁发title certificate或注册，除非车辆通过salvage车辆检查。如果颁发了title certificate，它将带有“REBUILT SALVAGE:NY”的标记。

### 如果批发销售车辆，在Retail Certificates of Sale (MV-50)上的销售价格

当车辆批发销售时，MV-50表格上不需要填写销售价格。

### 外州客户所需的检查

对于在另一个州注册的车辆，不需要进行纽约州检查。

### 一辆至少有110,000英里的车辆以$1,295的价格卖给零售客户的保修

这些术语指的是Office of the Attorney General (网站：www.ag.ny.gov [3])在'Lemon Law'中描述的保修。Vehicle and Traffic Law要求经销商在MV-50表格上完成Used Vehicle Certification。该法律适用于以任何销售价格出售并显示任何里程表读数的所有车辆。车辆在销售时必须适合在道路上使用。

### 临时注册即将到期

如果您无法为已售车辆获得title certificate，且临时注册即将到期，您不能获得另一个临时注册。根据DMV Commissioner's Regulations，如果您没有所有权证明，就不能出售车辆。在任何情况下，您都不能签发额外的临时注册。

### 保证债券

要获得保证债券，您必须联系担保保险公司。确保债券上的企业名称和邮寄地址与您的DMV设施许可证上的完全一致。确保您在债券上写上您的设施编号。

### 经销商所需的债券金额

债券金额取决于经销商在上一个日历年度销售的车辆数量，或者经销商是否被许可为特许新经销商。请参考下面的图表

heading_path: 获取危险品（HazMat）签注
如何获取危险品（HazMat）签注？
text:
[获取危险品（HazMat）签注 > 如何获取危险品（HazMat）签注？]
您必须首先持有CDL才能申请HazMat签注。持有纽约州CDL的驾驶员必须具有“H”或“X”HazMat签 注，才能操作运输危险品的商用机动车。请阅读CDL手册[1]（CDL-10）、危险品手册（pdf）[2]（ CDL-11）和驾驶执照类别说明（pdf）[3]（MV-500C）以获取更多信息。

申请HazMat签注需要满足哪些要求？

- 您必须是美国公民或美国合法永久居民，并在申请危险品签注时出示公民身份或居民身份的证 明。有关可接受的公民身份或居民身份证明文件列表，请参阅《关于危险品签注的重要信息》 （pdf）[4]（HAZ-11）。

- 您必须满足49 CFR第391部分中的联邦医疗要求，并持有有效的USDOT体检医师证明。有关 更多信息，请参阅医疗认证要求[5]。

- 您必须进行指纹采集以进行背景调查。1

是否有任何情况可能使我没有资格获得HazMat签注？

是的，根据联邦法律，联邦运输安全管理局（TSA）可能取消您运输危险品的授权资格，如果：

- 在您申请签注日期之前的七年内，您曾因《关于危险品签注的重要信息》（pdf）[4]（HAZ-11 ）中列出的任何罪行被定罪或因精神错乱而被判无罪

- 在您申请签注日期之前的五年内，您因犯有任何取消资格的罪行而从任何司法管辖区的监禁中 获释。

HazMat部门纽约州DMV帝国广场6号纽约州奥尔巴尼市，邮编12228

如有疑问，您可以通过电话1-518-408-2997或电子邮件[email protected][7]联系HazMat部门。

heading_path: 获取危险品（HazMat）签注
我需要参加笔试吗？
text:
[获取危险品（HazMat）签注 > 我需要参加笔试吗？]
是的，您必须通过HazMat签注笔试。您必须前往DMV办公室支付$5.00的笔试费用并参加考试。 考试成绩在您的CDL到期前有效。2

您可以学习纽约州商用驾驶执照手册[1]（CDL-10）中的危险品部分，或学习危险品手册（pdf）[2] （CDL-11）。

如何提供我的指纹以进行背景调查？

所需的指纹采集服务由Identogo提供。所有HazMat签注申请人都必须在纽约州各地的Identogo ID中心之一进行指纹采集。3 4

指纹采集仅限预约。您必须联系Identogo选择指纹采集地点并安排预约。请访问https://uenroll.ident ogo.com [8]或致电1-877-472-6915。

获取指纹服务信息 [9] (HAZ-600)

以预约。预约时请携带您的纽约州CDL和HAZ-600表格上列出的第二种身份证明。

背景调查需要多长时间，我将如何收到结果通知？

通常从您提交指纹之日起至少需要30天才能完成背景调查。然而，时间可能会超过30天。

联邦运输安全管理局（TSA）将根据联邦标准通过邮件通知您背景调查结果。TSA网站 [10] 有关于危险品背书的联邦背景调查信息。5

请不要向DMV、Identogo或TSA索取背景调查结果。请等待邮件通知。

在背景调查完成之前，我可以获得临时危险品背书吗？

不可以。在背景调查完成并批准之前，我们不能签发危险品背书。DMV将仅在以下情况下提供带有 危险品背书的CDL，该背书有效期为90天：

- 您申请续期当前纽约州带有危险品背书的CDL

- 背景调查在背书到期前未完成并批准。

如果我没有通过笔试或背景调查怎么办？

如果您没有通过笔试或背景调查，DMV将签发不带危险品背书的CDL。

我如何知道我的申请是否已获批准？

我们将通过邮件通知您批准结果，并附上前往DMV办公室获取带有危险品背书的CDL的说明。您的 新CDL将显示您的CDL到期日期和危险品背书的到期日期。该背书有效期为五年。

- 1. 联邦和州法律要求任何想要获得危险品背书的人进行基于指纹的背景调查，以确定该人是否 有犯罪史和/或是否构成安全威胁，从而有必要拒绝其运输危险品的授权。除非背景调查结果使 联邦运输安全管理局（TSA）和纽约州确定申请背书的人被授权运输危险品，否则不得签发、 转让或续期任何危险品背书。为启动背景调查，规定要求申请人提供指纹，并核实其美国公民 身份或在美国的永久合法居留身份。

- 2. 您必须正确回答80%或以上的问题才能通过考试。您可以多次参加考试，直到通过为止， 但每次考试需支付$5费用。

- 3. 即使您为其他申请（例如手枪许可证或保安工作）提供过指纹，您也必须提供指纹。

- 4. 您必须为您的CDL上的H背书或X背书提供指纹。

- 5. 背景调查包括对纽约州刑事司法服务处和联邦调查局（FBI）的犯罪历史数据的检查。还有 联邦运输安全管理局（TSA）进行的背景调查。

text:
[Get a CDL [1]]
Follow these steps to get your first time New York State commercial driver license (CDL).

## Step 1: Have a New York State driver license (Class D, Class E, or Non-CDL C) or a valid CDL from another state

Get the New York State Commercial Driver's Manual [2] (CDL-10) online or from a DMV office [3] or call center. [4] Study the sections of the manual that apply to the type of CDL you need. The sections of the manual that you need to study are explained in the manual. The manual describes the classes, the restrictions, and the endorsements of CDLs. This information is also included on the Driver License Class Descriptions (PDF) [5] (MV-500C).

## Step 2: Apply for a commercial learner permit at a DMV office

You must pass the written test for the CDL that you need. There is an application fee of $10.00. This fee allows you to take all written tests (knowledge and endorsement) required for permit and license issuance applied for which are taken at the same time. There will be an additional $5 fee for any other required tests not taken and passed at the time of initial application. There is a fee of $40.00 to take the CDL road test (skills test). You can pay the road test fee when the DMV office issues your commercial learner permit, or you can pay the fee online [6]. You must pay the fee before you can schedule your road test.

When you apply for an New York State CDL (Class A, B, or C), you must certify that

- You did not hold a driver license in any state or in the District of Columbia except New York in the last 10 years or you must report every US state (or the District of Columbia) where you held a driver license in the last 10 years.

- You meet the Federal medical examination requirements (see Medical Certification Requirements [7] for more information). 1 You must also prove your legal presence in the United States.

IMPORTANT: DMV now offers three types of license/permit documents. Learn more about Enhanced, REAL ID and Standard documents [8].

## Know what to bring to the DMV office

If you have a Standard and want to change to a REAL ID or Enhanced, you must come into a DMV office. Complete this guide to make sure you have the proofs of identification you need before

coming.

Find your proofs [9]

- The DMV Document Guide [10] lists all acceptable legal presence and New York State residence proof documents. Please note: You must provide us the original documents (not photocopies), and documents submitted as proof of residence must have your current residence address on it (no P.O. Box permitted).

- If you are U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident (i.e., temporary visitors) your Commercial Learner Permit (CLP) or CDL document will have the legend NON-DOMICILED printed on documents issued on it. The TEMPORARY VISITOR and the expiration date of your legal status documentation will continue to be displayed on the CLP and/or CDL document. Per new federal regulations, the DMV will check for any open suspensions or revocations you may have in any state. If you have an open suspension or revocation, we will reject your application.

You must apply for a CDL at a DMV Office [3].

heading_path: Step 3: Prepare for your road test and practice with a supervising driver
text:
[Step 3: Prepare for your road test and practice with a supervising driver]
The supervising driver must have a driver license that is valid to drive the commercial motor vehicle that you use for practice.

Based on feedback we have received from the motor carrier industry regarding the new federal CDL test model, we have learned that drivers are facing difficulties with certain sections of the test, often times resulting in failures. In an effort to address some of the common difficulties encountered during the skills test, we are providing some information that may be useful for drivers and instructors.

Sections 11-13 of the CDL Manual (PDF) [11]covers the skills test. Please pay special attention to the Air Brake Check information on page 11-4. We strongly recommend that drivers and instructors focus on the steps outlined for the air brake check, and follow the steps as written. More information is provided in the full Commercial Driver's Manual (CDL-10) [2].

In addition, please note that the federal regulations allow the pre-trip inspection section to be randomized each time a new test is initiated for an applicant. As a result, the pre-trip portion of the test could start at the front of the vehicle, in the middle, or if the test is for a Class A vehicle, with the trailer. On page 11-12 of the manual, you will find the CDL Vehicle Inspection Memory Aid, which drivers are permitted to bring to the test as long as there are no notes or marked items on the document. Motor Vehicle License Examiners will also have a copy to provide to the applicant at the test site, if necessary.

[Step 4: Schedule your road test]
Use the Road Test Scheduling System [12]. Please note that you can t schedule an appointment for a date that is less than 14 days of being issued a Commercial Learner Permit (CLP). If you do not pass the road test, you must pay a fee of $40.00 before you can schedule another road test. You can pay the fee online with your credit card, or pay the fee at a DMV office.

New CDL restrictions defined below by the Federal Motor Carrier Safety Administration (FMCSA) may affect CLP holders when taking a Skills Test in a vehicle without full airbrakes and/or a manual transmission.

- E- No Manual Transmission Equipped Commercial Motor Vehicle (CMV)

- L- No Airbrake Equipped CMV

-Z- No Full Airbrake Equipped CMV restrictions If the vehicle used for your skills test has:

heading_path: Will | get a temporary CDL after | pass my road test?
text:
[Will | get a temporary CDL after | pass my road test?]
No. Effective May 23, 2014, the New York State DMV will no longer issue a 10-day temporary license document upon successful completion of a Commercial Driver License skills test, in order to comply with the Federal self-certification and medical certification requirements for commercial drivers.Instead, commercial drivers will be issued a receipt indicating they must wait 1 business day before visiting a DMV office in order to obtain a Commercial Driver s License document.

## What is the fee for a CDL?

It depends on the expiration date and the class of your current driver license, and the date that you receive your CDL.

chunk_id: Get a CDL#1_0::c0007

heading_path: When will | get my CDL?
text:
[When will | get my CDL?]
The local DMV office will issue a temporary CDL that is valid for 90 days. Your photo CDL will arrive by mail in 3 to 4 weeks.

## What if | have a CDL from another state?

To get a New York State CDL, you must apply for your CDL at a DMV office and surrender your out-of-state CDL. If your out-of-state CDL has a hazardous materials endorsement, you must pass the hazardous materials knowledge test when you apply for your New York State CDL. You must also provide fingerprints for federal and New York State background checks for criminal violations.

# 获取TVB罚单副本

# 获取TVB罚单副本 [1]

### 在线办理

如果您的交通违规罚单（TVB）丢失或损毁，您可以在线打印替代件。您要替换的罚单必须

- 底部有“交通违规局”字样 1
- 是“未处理”或未支付的罚单 2

您需要

- TVB交通罚单编号（示例罚单 [2]），输入所有其他信息以确定DMV能否找到罚单记录

以及您的

- DMV ID号（客户ID号），来自您的纽约州驾驶执照、学习许可证或非驾驶员照片身份证（参见示例驾驶执照 [3]）

或您的

- 全名、出生日期和性别

在线获取TVB罚单副本 [4]

### 附加信息

#### 我可以打印我所有未处理的TVB罚单的替代件吗？

可以。一旦您提供了一张未处理的TVB交通罚单的信息，您将能够打印您拥有的任何未处理的TVB交通罚单。您需要一次打印一张。

#### 我从此交易中打印的替代罚单与在TVB办公室打印的罚单相同吗？

是的。您从此交易中打印的替代罚单与在TVB办公室打印的罚单包含完全相同的信息。

#### 如果我的交通罚单不可用，我该怎么办？

如果交通罚单无法打印，交易将为您提供有关您可以采取的措施的说明。请仔细阅读交易中的所有消息。

- 1. 如果交通罚单不属于交通违规局（TVB）处理范围，您不能使用此交易处理该罚单。TVB不处理停车违规、刑事驾驶违规（例如，酒驾）或需在地方法院处理的罚单。
- 2. 如果罚单已被撤销，或者已有定罪且罚款、费用和附加费均已支付，则该罚单为“已结案”罚单。

text:
[获取驾驶执照 > 新驾驶员试用期]
一旦你通过路考或恢复被吊销的驾驶执照，你将有一个6个月的试用期。在此期间，如果你被判定犯有以下任何一项违规行为，你的驾照将被吊销60天

超速 参与速度竞赛 鲁莽驾驶 跟车过近 使用移动电话 使用便携式电子设备（例如智能手机、平板电脑、GPS或MP3播放器） 任何其他2项移动违规行为

暂停期结束后，你将进入第二个6个月的试用期。

如果你在第二个试用期内被判定犯有上述违规行为之一（或其他2项移动违规行为），你的驾照将被吊销至少6个月。吊销期结束后，你必须再服6个月的试用期。

text:

根据纽约州车辆和交通法第250条第(5)款对居民的定义：“在本节中，‘居民’一词应指户籍居民，即居住在本州并意图将其作为固定和永久住所的人。一个人在本州维持住所至少90天，应被推定为本州居民。”

在纽约州的房屋、住宅、公寓、房间或其他类似地方居住90天，被视为“推定证据”表明你是纽约州居民。如果你在没有纽约州驾驶执照或车辆注册的情况下在纽约州驾驶，警察可以利用这一证据开具交通罚单。

法官会考虑法律和你意图的证据，并决定你是否是纽约州居民。如果你在另一个州纳税或你的子女在另一个州上学，法官会考虑这些事实来决定你的意图是否是将纽约州作为“固定和永久”的住所。根据这项法律，来自其他州或其他国家在纽约州上学的学生通常不被视为纽约州居民。DMV不决定你是否是纽约州居民，是否必须获得纽约州驾驶执照，或是否必须在纽约州注册车辆。

# Get a learner permit

## Get a learner permit [1]

Getting a permit is the first step to get your driver license. Most people apply for a Class 'D - Operator' permit. 1 You must be 16 or older and must apply in person at a DMV office. Here are the steps you need to take:

## Step 1: Be prepared to take the written permit test

study the NY State Driver's Manual and take the practice tests [2] - class D and M permit tests are given in 14 languages: English, Albanian, Arabic, Bosnian, Chinese, French, Greek, Hebrew, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Polish, Russian and Spanish to pass, you must get at least 14 of the 20 multiple-choice questions correct - this includes the correct answers to at least two of the four questions about road signs - if you are applying for a motorcycle permit [3], you must get at least three out of the five motorcycle questions correct

## Step 2: Know what to bring to the DMV

complete this guide to make sure you have the documents and proofs of identification you need BEFORE going to the DMV

## Find your proofs [4]

Bringing a parent or guardian is required if you are using the "Statement of Identity and/or Residence by Parent/Guardian (PDF) [5]" (MV-45).

## Step 3: Go to the DMV

find an office location [6] and see if a reservation is necessary for written test apply and pay for your permit (use the fee chart to estimate your cost [7]) take your written test (if you fail, you can try again at no additional cost)

For quicker service, make a reservation online before visiting offices in New York City, Westchester, Nassau, Suffolk, Rockland, Onondaga, Monroe or Albany Counties. For all other counties, see our office locations and hours [6].

## Make a Reservation [8]

## Step 4: Wait up to 2 weeks for your permit to come in the mail

your permit will be valid for approximately 5 years (the exact expiration date depends on your date of birth and the date that you applied) once you have your permit, you can move onto Step 5.

## Step 5: Prepare for your road test

you must have supervised driving practice 2 you must take a pre-licensing course or a driver education course before you take your road test - learn how to find a pre-licensing course and prepare for your road test [9] you will need to follow all learner permit restrictions [10] if you are under age 18, you must wait at least 6 months from the date you received your learner permit to schedule your road test.

## Step 6: Take your road test

take your road test before your permit expires (you renew a permit [11]) - schedule & take a road test [12] if you pass your test, the examiner will give you an interim license that allows you to drive - keep the interim license with your photo permit until your new license arrives in the mail (in about 2 weeks) if you fail, start again at Step 5

## Still haven't found what you are looking for?

See a list of learner permit topics [13].

There are special requirements to apply for a motorcycle permit/license [3], a commercial learner permit [14], a taxi license [15], or enhanced permit [16]. if you are under 18, a Certification of Supervised Driving (PDF) [17] (MV-262) completed by your parent or guardian.

# Get a license to drive a taxi or livery vehicle

To drive taxis and other livery vehicles in New York State, you must be 18 years of age or older and you must have a driver license that is one of these classes

- Class A commercial driver license (CDL)
- Class B CDL
- Class C CDL
- Class E driver license

### If you plan on traveling

We recommend you come to the DMV now to get an Enhanced or REAL ID, and avoid a second office visit later. 1 Learn about Enhanced, REAL ID and Standard documents [1].

### Change from a Class D to a Class E license

#### Step 1: Complete the

- Application for Standard Permit, Driver License for Non-Driver ID Card (PDF) [2] (MV-44)

#### Step 2: Determine what identification you need to bring to the DMV

- if you want a REAL ID or Enhanced, complete this document guide to know what proofs of identity to bring to an office

Find your proofs [3]

- On the first page, select: Change my existing NY State license/ID to a REAL ID or Enhanced

- if you want a Standard that will display "NOT FOR FEDERAL PURPOSES", bring your current NY State license as proof of identity

#### Step 3: Go to the DMV

- surrender your Class D license.
- apply and pay for your Class E license
  - the fee depends on the expiration date of your current driver license - we cannot calculate your fee until you apply
- take the vision test or prove that you meet our vision requirements [4]

#### Step 4: Get your Class E license in the mail

Allow 2 weeks for your new license to arrive.

### If you do not have New York State driver license

If you do not have a driver license, learn how to apply for your first driver license [5]. Apply for a Class E driver license instead of a Class D driver license. The Class D license and the Class E license both require the same vision, written and road tests.

The New York City Taxi and Limousine Commission (T&LC) regulates taxi drivers and livery drivers in New York City. If you plan to drive a taxi or livery vehicle in New York City, contact the Taxi and Limousine Commission [6].

- 1. Starting in October 2020, you will need an Enhanced or REAL ID to board a domestic flight (unless you have a passport).

If your license or permit was issued before October 30, 2017 and is not Enhanced, you have a Standard document.

Newly issued Standard license and permits state: 'NOT FOR FEDERAL PURPOSES'

# Get a military skills test waiver

## Get a military skills test waiver [1]

If you have military experience driving commercial motor vehicles you may apply for a waiver of the NYS CDL skills road test when you apply for a CDL. To meet the requirements for this waiver, you must

- currently hold a valid New York State driver license or have a valid out of state driver license to be exchanged for a NYS driver license

- meet all other requirements to qualify for a NYS CDL (see Get a CDL [2])

- be currently regularly employed (or regularly employed within the last year) in a military position (active duty or New York National Guard) that requires operation of a CMV

- have operated a CMV of the type that the driver operates or expects to operate for at least two years immediately before

- - the application date if in active service, or

- - the date of being discharged from the military To apply, you must present the following at a DMV office

a completed form CDL Certification for Military Waiver of Skills Tests [3] (CDL -102)

- a valid NYS or out-of-state driver license

- a medical certificate (if required)

- proof of military service as listed on form CDL-102 You must pass all applicable written tests and pay the written test fee, permit fee and license fee. There is no skills test fee. If you meet the requirements we will issue your CDL. The class, endorsements and restrictions on your CDL will depend upon the type of CMV you operated in the military. For more information, see the Driver License Class Descriptions [4] (MV-500C).

## Do it at the DMV:

You must apply for a military skills test waiver at a DMV Office.

- Commercial Drivers [5]

# Get a motorcycle license

# Get a motorcycle license [1]

A New York State resident must have a Class M or Class MJ driver license or learner permit to drive a motorcycle. To get a motorcycle license, you must first get a motorcycle learner permit.

IMPORTANT: DMV offers 3 types of documents. Learn about Enhanced, REAL ID and Standard documents [2].

### How to get a motorcycle license

#### Step 1: Apply for a motorcycle permit at a DMV office

Here is what do

- study the NY State Motorcycle Operator's Manual [3] (MV-21MC) to prepare for the written test

- complete the DMV Document Guide to make sure you have the documents and proofs of identification you need

Find your proofs [4]

- if you already have a New York State learner permit or driver license, bring the document

- bring payment for the $10.00 application fee and the motorcycle license fee 1

#### Step 2: Prepare for the motorcycle road test

Before you schedule your road test, we recommend that you have at least 30 hours of practice on a motorcycle, with or without formal instruction. We also recommend that you

- have at least 10 hours of practice in medium to high volume traffic
- consider taking the New York State Motorcycle Safety Program Basic Rider Course [5] or instruction from a commercial driving school

When you practice driving with a motorcycle learner permit

- you must be supervised by a driver age 21 or older who has a valid motorcycle license from any state
- the motorcycle driver who supervises you must be within 1/4 mile of you at all times
- you must obey the general restrictions [6] for permit holders [6]
- if you have a Class MJ permit, you must obey the restrictions and requirements for drivers under age 18 [7]

#### Step 3: Schedule and take a motorcycle road test

See Schedule and take a road test [8].

- if you do not already have another class of New York State driver license, you must complete a pre-licensing course or a Driver Education course before you can schedule a road test 2

 

- if you already have another class of New York State license, you do not need a pre-licensing course or Student Certificate of Completion

#### Step 4: Get your motorcycle license

If you pass the road test, the examiner will issue a temporary motorcycle license to you.

- if you do not have another class of New York State driver license, you will receive your motorcycle license with your photo by mail about 2 weeks after your road test (you do not have to visit a DMV office)

 

- if you already have another class of New York State driver license, wait at least 7 days after your road test to apply for your motorcycle license at a DMV office, and be sure to

 

- - complete an Application for Permit, Driver License or Non-Driver ID Card (PDF) [9] (MV-44)
  - mark the "Change" box at the top, and write in Add Class M (or MJ)" in the "Other Change" box
  - bring your temporary motorcycle license, your motorcycle permit and your current photo license
  - pay the $12.50 fee to amend your driver license

Both driver license classes will be listed on your new document (for example, Class DM). Your new license expires on the same date as your previous one.

The DMV office will issue a temporary license without a photo to you. Allow two weeks to receive your new license by mail.

### Additional information

#### Can I get the motorcycle road test waived?

We can waive the test if you are qualified and you complete an approved course. To get information about approved courses in your area, visit the New York State Motorcycle Safety Program website [5] or call toll-free at 1-800-446-9227.

To qualify for the waiver you must

- be 16 years of age or older
- have a valid NY State license (Class A, B, C, D, DJ or E)
- have a valid class M or MJ motorcycle learner permit
- present either a Basic Rider Course (BRC) or a Basic Rider Course 2 License/Waiver (BRC2-LW) Course completion card issued by the NY State Motorcycle Safety Foundation within two years of completing the course

You cannot get a waiver for a motorcycle road test if you completed a rider course given in another state.

There are waivers available in some cases for members of the U.S. Armed Forces. 3

#### Can I drive in New York with an out-of-state motorcycle license?

If you have a valid motorcycle license issued by another state where you are a resident, you can drive motorcycles in New York State.

#### Can I exchange an out-of-state motorcycle license for a New York motorcycle license?

If you become a resident of New York State, you should exchange your out-of-state motorcycle license for a New York State motorcycle license. See Exchange an out-of-state driver license [10].

#### Where can I learn more about motorcycle safety?

Motorcycle safety information is available from the New York State Governor s Traffic Safety Committee [11].

- 1.

The fees you pay when you get your first motorcycle license depend on

- whether or not you currently have another class of NYS driver license and
  - your exact age when you apply.

The fees for a Class M or MJ driver license, or to add class M or MJ to your current driver license, can range from $21 to $120, but we cannot calculate your exact fee until you apply.

- 2. A Pre-licensing Course Certificate (MV-278) is valid for one year. A Student Certificate of Completion (MV-285) is valid for two years. See Prepare for your road test [12] for more information about these certificates.

- 3. A member of the US Armed Forces who completes the MSF Basic Rider Course (BRC) through the military while on active duty outside of New York State can qualify to have their military BRC converted into a NY BRC and receive the road test waiver. See the instructions on the website of the New York State Motorcycle Safety Program [13] or call 1-518-384-0045.

## Topic:

- Driver License [14]

# Get a vehicle registration or title record (abstract)

# Get a vehicle registration or title record (abstract) [1]

### What are vehicle registration and title record abstracts?

See a definition of vehicle registration and title record abstracts [2] issued by the New York DMV.

### How do I get my vehicle registration record abstract?

You can order your vehicle registration abstract by using form Request for DMV Records (PDF) [3] (MV-15).

Include these items with your request

- your plate number or Vehicle Identification Number (VIN)
  - if you do not know your plate number or VIN, provide your name and date of birth (DOB), as well as the vehicle make and year
- a photocopy of your driver license or other government issued photo ID card as proof of identity
- a personal check or money order (payable to "Commissioner of Motor Vehicles") to pay the search fee of $10.00

Mail to the address listed on the form.

### How do I get my vehicle title record abstract?

You can order your title record abstract by using form Request for DMV Records (PDF) [3] (MV-15).

Include these items with your request

- the Vehicle Identification Number (VIN)
  - if you do not know the VIN, we may be able to locate the record using our registration files - provide the name and date of birth (DOB) of the registrant, as well as the year and make for the vehicle
- a photocopy of your driver license or other government issued photo ID card as proof of identity
- a personal check or money order (payable to "Commissioner of Motor Vehicles") to pay the search fee of $10.00

Mail to the address listed on the form.

### How do I get another person's records?

You must submit a Request for DMV Records (PDF) [3] (MV-15) and certify that you have a permissible use under the Driver's Privacy Protection Act (DPPA) to see the personal information of another person on DMV records. See Driver's Privacy Protection Act (DPPA) [4] for more information.

## Do it by mail:

You can order your vehicle or title record abstracts by mail using the Request for DMV Records [3] (MV-15).

# Get an Accident Report

## Get an Accident Report [1]

DMV keeps accident reports for only 4 years from the date of the accident, except for rare instances that are described in Vehicle and Traffic Law Section 201(i).

How can I get a copy of an Accident Report?

#### By mail

Use the Request for Copy of Accident Report (PDF) [2] (MV-198C) to order a copy of an accident report by mail.

- You must provide the date of the crash/accident and the county where the crash/accident occurred and at least one of the following:

- 1. the plate number of a vehicle involved in the crash/accident, and/or

- 2. the driver license number of a person who was involved in the crash/accident, and/or

- 3. the name and date of birth of a person who was involved in the crash/accident

- Accident reports are certified copies. If DMV cannot find an accident based on the information you provide, you will be notified by DMV in a certified letter.

#### Online

To order a copy of an accident report in PDF format, use the Order and Access Motor Vehicle Accident Reports online [3] transaction. Before you order online, please read the following information:

Accident reports available through this transaction are certified copies that include an attestation and signature of the Commissioner of Motor Vehicles. To place an order, you will need one of the following:

the plate number of a vehicle involved in the crash/accident, and/or the driver license number of a person who was involved in the accident, and/or the 8-digit DMV case number (starts with the number 3)

- You can access an accident report that you purchased online within the last 7 calendar days. No fee is charged to access a report that you previously purchased. Enter your email address and the Report Confirmation Number (the number that displayed during the report purchase transaction and was emailed to you in the transaction confirmation). enter the Search Confirmation Number.

- Note: Some customers have experienced problems downloading PDF documents [4] from our website. Make sure your operating system and web browser have been updated with all recent updates.

How long after an accident does it take for the report to be available?

- If the accident was filed electronically by police or occurred in one of the five boroughs of New York City, allow at least 14 days from the date of the accident before you search for the report. - If a paper form was used by police to report the accident, allow at least 30 days from the date of the accident before you search for the report.

- If the accident report was filed by a motorist, regardless of where the accident occurred in NY State, allow at least 60 days before you search for the report. To order a copy of a motorist accident report you must:

- 1. be named on the accident report, or

- 2. represent a person named on the report, or

- 3. be a party to a civil action that arose from the accident, or

- 4. represent a person who is a party to a civil action that arose from the accident.

### How much do I need to pay?

Search fees are required by law (see Vehicle and Traffic Law Section 202).

#### By mail

You must pay a required search fee of $10.00 and an additional report fee of $15.00 for each accident report that you order by mail. The cost is less when you order your accident report online.

#### Online

You must pay a required search fee of $7.00 and an additional report fee of $15.00 for each accident report that you order online. The system will charge you separately for the search fee and for each report. You will receive a confirmation email for each transaction.

Note: You can do a free limited search to see if your report is available (see screenshot example below). The system provides a list of accidents by date and county. Search for the plate number to see if the report is available. If you submit a search by county and date, but you do not select any reports, the search fee is not charged.

Order and Access Motor Vehicle Accident Reports online [3]

Can I access accident reports I already purchased online?

Yes. If you purchased accident reports online within the last 7 calendar days, you can access the reports again [5]. Enter the Report Confirmation Number displayed during the report purchase transaction and emailed to you in the transaction confirmation. enter the Search Confirmation Number. Then, enter the email address you entered during the previous transaction. No fee is charged to access the reports you purchased previously.

# Get email and/or text reminders

## Get email and/or text reminders [1]

### About

You can sign up to get email and/or text reminders before your driver license, non-driver ID card, registration or vehicle inspection expires. DMV will also enroll you after you complete an online registration renewal transaction as part of a new initiative to save taxpayers more than $500,000 per year [2]. You can update your subscription at any time.

Commercial driver license (CDL) and commercial learner permit (CLP) holders can also sign up to get email and/or text reminders regarding the status of their medical certifications [3] and medical variances [4].

If your driver license, non-driver ID, registration, inspection, medical certification or medical variance is close to expiring when you sign up, you may not get electronic reminders until the next time it s due.

Sign up to get email and/or text reminders online [5]

### I received an email from the New York State DMV messages @nydmv.messagingchannel.com about an enhancement to the Electronic Reminder program. Is this real?

Yes, it is. You received the email from mess[email protected] because you are in the DMV Electronic Reminders program. Please do not write to this email address. You will not receive a response. If you need to, see how to contact us [6].

### How do I know if I can get reminders?

To get registration renewal and inspection reminders, you must be the primary registrant (first name listed on a registration, if the vehicle is registered to more than one person).

You won t get reminders if your registration is not eligible to renew (for example, you can t renew if the registration is suspended or revoked).

### Will the email address I use to sign up replace any other email addresses I previously provided the DMV?

Yes. The DMV only keeps one email address for each customer. The email address you provide to sign up for electronic reminders will replace any other email address you provided us in the past.

### How can I stay enrolled but still receive paper registration renewal reminders?

You can update your electronic reminders subscription to receive email and/or text reminders as well as paper reminders [7] by mail for your vehicle registrations. If your vehicle registration is due to expire within the next 75 days, you will probably not receive a paper reminder.

### How can I unsubscribe?

If you want to stop receiving email and/or text reminders, select the 'unsubscribe' on the Subscription Page [8] and enter your ID number and date of birth on the unsubscribe page.

- More Info [9]

# 获取我自己的 CDL 驾驶记录（摘要）

## 获取我自己的 CDL 驾驶记录（摘要）[1]

### 什么是 CDL 驾驶记录摘要？

商业（CDL）摘要显示扩展的驾驶员历史信息，这些信息在标准驾驶记录（Standard Driving Record）上不可用。这包括在任何州驾驶任何类型车辆时的定罪、吊销、撤销和其他许可行动。还提供医疗认证状态（Medical Certification Status）信息和自我认证（Self-Certification）信息。雇主或组织可以通过纽约 DMV 许可证事件通知服务（LENS）为注册驾驶员获取 CDL 摘要。查看更多关于 CDL 摘要的信息 [2]。

驾驶记录摘要是一份经过认证的 DMV 记录。它们都包含认证声明和机动车管理局局长的签名，以及安全水印。

### 通过 MyDMV 在线获取

您可以保存并打印您的记录的 PDF 版本。您有 5 天时间在订单后下载它。费用为 $7。

要创建 MyDMV 账户，您需要

- 纽约州驾照、许可证或非驾驶员 ID，或

- 您的纽约州驾照、许可证或非驾驶员 ID 1

确保您的计算机和网络浏览器具有所有最新更新，以避免下载记录时出现问题 [3]。

[4]

如果您无法访问 MyDMV，您可以将认证 CDL 摘要请求（PDF）[5]（MV-CDL）表格连同 $10 费用邮寄到 DMV，邮寄至表格上提供的地址，或者让您的雇主通过 LENS [6] 订购您的 CDL 驾驶记录摘要。

- 1. 您需要最近签发的文件上的文件编号（参见示例文件 [7]）。如果您最近续期或订购了文件，但尚未收到邮件，您需要等待它到达后才能创建 MyDMV 账户。

# 帮助寻找足够的身份证明

### 我没有原始的美国出生证明或结婚记录

纽约州卫生部重要记录办公室 [1] 可以帮助您获取该州的重要记录。或者，您可以通过独立合作伙伴 VitalChek Network Inc. 在 vitalchek.com [2] 在线订购纽约及许多其他州的重要记录。

### 我没有足够的姓名身份证明带去 DMV。我能做什么？

您可能已经拥有比您想象的更多的证明文件，或者您可能能够获得一些证明文件。以下是一些建议。

- 银行卡（借记卡），上面预印有您的姓名。有些银行会在您开户当天给您一张卡。
- **在线账单打印件**。您可以打印无纸化账单的副本。例如，电话账单、电费/燃气费账单、水费账单或有线电视账单。
- 离婚文件。您可以联系您的律师了解在哪里获取这些文件，或者向您离婚所在州查询。请记住，您必须向我们出示原始文件或经认证的副本。
- 结婚证书副本。您可以向您结婚所在的城市、城镇或县查询。许多地方允许您在线订购副本。
- 高中文凭或 GED。您可以联系您毕业所在州的教育部门获取经认证的副本。如果您在社区学院就读，您可能已获得（普通教育发展）GED 证书。您可以联系该学院获取经认证的副本。
- 美国大学成绩单。您可以从您就读过的学院或大学订购这些成绩单，即使您未在那里毕业。您需要拥有该学院的带照片身份证。
- 工作证、工资单或州 W2 表格。这些文件不必来自纽约，也不必是当前的。
- 工会卡。该卡可以来自其他州。如果您丢失了卡，您可以向工会寻求帮助获取副本。即使您不再从事该工会工作，您也可能终身成为会员。
- **人寿保险单**。向您的父母或配偶询问他们是否曾以您的名义投保人寿保险。该保单必须生效至少 2 年。
- **超市连锁店的支票兑现卡**，上面印有您的姓名。

### 如果满足以下条件，您可以使用配偶名下的居住证明文件

- 您和您的配偶姓氏相同

或

- 您出示额外文件证明您的关系（例如，结婚证书）

# 保险费减免如何运作

积分与保险减免计划（PIRP）是DMV批准的课程，旨在向驾驶者传授关于高速公路安全和事故预防的关键信息。

### 我如何获得保险费减免？

课程主办方将在您完成课堂课程后的45个工作日内（或完成在线课程后的14个工作日内）将完成证书邮寄给您。如果您在课程完成后的90天内将证书提交给您的保险公司或代理人，您的责任险和碰撞险保费减免将立即生效，追溯至您完成课程的日期。如果您在课程完成90天后才提交证书，保险公司可能会从提交之日起给予保费折扣。

如果您在完成课程后八周内未收到证书，请立即联系课程主办方。您必须每36个月参加一次课程，以维持保险减免福利。

### PIRP课程会阻止我的保险公司提高我的保费吗？

不会。PIRP不能阻止一般性保费上涨，或因违规或事故导致的保费上涨。它提供从您当前责任险、无过失险和碰撞险保费基本费率基础上降低10%的优惠，持续三年。

### 如果保单上有多人完成PIRP课程怎么办？

只有主要驾驶人可以获得10%的减免。

### 年轻驾驶者和参与指定风险池的驾驶者会获得保险费折扣吗？

会。任何作为主要驾驶人并完成积分与保险减免计划课程的受保驾驶者都将获得10%的减免。

### 如果年轻驾驶者已经获得驾驶教育减免，PIRP折扣也会同时适用吗？

请联系您的保险公司或代理人，了解是否同时给予两项减免。

# How to change your address

## How to change your address [1]

### Update the address on your license, permit, or ID, vehicle registration and title

If you move, you must report a change of residence address on your license, permit, non-driver ID or vehicle records to the DMV within 10 days.

Be aware that

- changing your address with the U.S. Postal Service (USPS) does not update your DMV records 1

- when you change your address for a vehicle registration, we also update the title certificate record

- you do not need to order new DMV documents with your new address 2

- updating your address for a traffic ticket does not update your address on other DMV records 3

There are instructions to change your name or other (non-address) information [2].

### Online through MyDMV

To change the address on your license, permit, non-driver ID and/or registration(s), you will need the ID number and document number from your New York State

- driver license,

- learner permit, or

- non-driver ID

If you lost your document, renewed or ordered a new one recently and have not received it in the mail yet, you will need to wait for it to arrive before you can create a MyDMV account. You can still change your address .

[3]

### By mail

To change your license, permit, non-driver ID and/or the address on your registration(s), mail a completed Address Change (pdf) [4] (MV-232) form to

NYS DMV License Production BureauPO Box 2895Albany, NY 12220-0895

If you want to replace your documents, be sure to include payment. You can find payment information on the Change Address (MV-232) form.

### At a DMV office

Unless you need to change your name or you want a new photo on your license or non-driver ID, there is no need to come to a DMV office.

If you still want to go to an office, bring a completed Address Change (pdf) [4] (MV-232) form with you. If you want to replace your documents, be sure to bring payment for the fees.

### Additional information

#### You can have different addresses on your license and registrations

The DMV sends documents and important notices to customers by mail. We recommend that you use the same address on all of your applications, documents, and transactions.

- 1. You must report your address change to both the DMV and the USPS.

- 2. When you change your address, you can write your new address on the back of your driver license, non-driver ID card or learner permit, and on the front of the registration document (carefully draw lines through the old address). **Do not** write the new address on a title certificate.

- 3. If you update your address for a Traffic Violations Bureau (TVB) traffic ticket transaction, the update does not change the address on your driver license, non-driver ID, permit, or vehicle registration records. If you update the address for your driver license, non-driver ID, permit, or vehicle registration records, the update does not change the address for your traffic ticket.

# How to check a title or lien status

# How to check a title or lien status [1]

### Do it online

You can check the status of vehicle titles and liens online. Sorry, the service is not available for boat titles.

The status check service displays

- the date the title was issued by DMV 1
- the number of liens (if any)
- the name and address of the lienholder(s)

The service does not display any personal information about the vehicle owner or registrant.

You must provide the

- Vehicle Identification Number (VIN)
- vehicle model year
- vehicle make (i.e. Ford , Jeep )

This information can be found on your vehicle's registration documents (see a sample [2]).

Check a title or lien status online [3]

Please note, it can take up to 90 days to receive the title certificate from the DMV in the mail. If it has been over 90 days, you still have not received your title,

Email the DMV to check your title status [4]

### Lien not listed

To have a lien recorded on a Certificate of Title, you must

- submit a request either through a dealer or directly to NY State DMV
- pay the required lien filing fee

If you did that, but did not see your lien listed when you checked the status of the title certificate on this website, or if you learned from another source that the lien is either not recorded or not pending, please notify DMV immediately by completing and emailing a Customer Lien Inquiry (pdf) [5] (MV-910) to the email address shown on the form.

### Customer Lien Inquiry (MV-910)

.

1.  Provide your Contact Information (if you are a lending institution, please include your lien filing code).
2.  Provide complete and accurate information for the vehicle(s) or boat(s) in question.
3.  Save the form.
    - If the version of Adobe does not allow you to save the information you typed, you can print the form and fax it to (518) 486-6581.
4.  Click on the email address shown on the form to open an email, or open an email and paste the address into the To line.
5.  Attach the completed form to the email and send it.
6.  use this form or the email to request any other type of information or service from DMV
    - we will disregard anything not related to a possible missing lien
    - However, if you have questions or issues on any other matter, see how to contact us [7].

What to expect

- DMV staff will respond to your request as soon as possible. We must first identify the vehicle or boat and verify its title status. Then we must retrieve and review the application forms to determine the appropriate response. Please note that these activities take time.
- If your lien has not been recorded, and the correct form(s) and fee have been filed, we will record your lien and send you a Notice of Recorded Lien (MV-901). If we do not have the correct form(s) and fee to record your lien, we will contact you to let you know what is needed.

 

- 1. The issue date is the date the DMV prints the title certificate. The DMV mails the certificate after it's printed.

# 如何获取我自己的驾驶记录（摘要）

# 如何获取我自己的驾驶记录（摘要）[1]

### 什么是标准驾驶记录（摘要）？

查看纽约DMV签发的“标准”驾驶记录（摘要）[2]的说明，以及驾驶记录摘要描述（PDF）[3]（DS-242.1），其中还包含样本摘要。

标准驾驶员记录包含过去几年与您的记录相关的信息。如果您需要DMV拥有的所有信息的记录，请参阅终身驾驶记录[4]。

在线、办公室或邮寄订购的摘要没有区别。它们都是经过认证的DMV记录。它们都包含认证声明和机动车管理局局长的签名，以及相同的安全水印。

### 什么是终身驾驶记录？

查看纽约DMV签发的“终身”驾驶记录[5]的说明，以及终身驾驶记录摘要描述（PDF）[6]（DS-242.3），其中还包含样本记录。

### 什么是商业（CDL）驾驶记录（摘要）？

查看CDL驾驶记录摘要[7]的说明。您可以在线订购，或让您的雇主通过License Event Notification Service (LENS)[8]订购。

### 通过MyDMV在线获取标准、终身和CDL摘要

您可以保存并打印记录的PDF版本。订单后您有5天时间下载。费用为$7。

要创建MyDMV账户，您需要最近签发的纽约州驾驶执照、许可证或非驾驶员ID。

抱歉，如果您没有以下证件，则必须通过邮寄订购：

- 纽约州驾驶执照、许可证或非驾驶员ID，或
- 您的纽约州驾驶执照、许可证或非驾驶员ID 1

确保您的计算机和Web浏览器具有所有最新更新，以避免下载记录时出现问题[9]。

[10]

### 通过邮寄获取标准及终身摘要

如需通过邮寄方式申请您的Standard驾驶记录，请发送

- 一份填写完整的Request for DMV Records (PDF) [11] (MV-15)
- 一份您的身份证明复印件 2
- 一张个人支票或汇票，金额为$10.00，收款人为"Commissioner of Motor Vehicles"

至

MV-15 ProcessingNYS Department of Motor Vehicles6 Empire State PlazaAlbany, NY 12228

如果您希望在续期驾照的同时订购您的记录，请在续期通知上标记蓝色方框，并将$10.00的查询费添加到您的续期费用中。

### 在DMV办公室获取Standard摘要

（抱歉，您无法在DMV办公室获取CDL或Lifetime摘要。）

如需在DMV办公室申请您的Standard驾驶记录，请携带

- 一份填写完整的Request for Driving Record Information (PDF) [12] (MV-15C)
- 身份证明 3
- $10.00的费用 4

查找您附近的DMV办公室 [13]。

### 在Albany的DMV客户服务柜台

您可以在Albany的DMV客户服务柜台申请驾驶记录摘要。您必须提供身份证明并支付$10.00的查询费。您必须证明您有DPPA允许的用途。使用Request for Driving Record Information (PDF) [12] (MV-15C) 在以下地点申请驾驶记录摘要：

Customer Service CounterRoom 136Swan Street BuildingEmpire State PlazaAlbany, NY 12228

#### 驾驶记录不能通过电话订购。

- 1. 您需要最近签发的文件上的文件编号（参见示例文件 [14]）。如果您最近续期或订购了文件但尚未收到邮件，您需要等待其到达后才能创建MyDMV账户。
- 2. 这可以是驾驶执照或其他政府签发的带照片身份证件（您可以遮挡照片）或6分身份证明。参见DMV文件指南 [15]。
- 3. 这可以是驾驶执照或其他政府签发的带照片身份证件（您可以遮挡照片）或6分身份证明。参见DMV文件指南 [15]。
- 4. 接受现金、信用卡、个人支票和汇票。支票和汇票收款人请写"Commissioner of Motor Vehicles"。

If you plan on traveling
text:
[How to renew a license [1] > If you plan on traveling]
Youmust renew your license before it expires or you could face fines. 1 You can renew up to 1 year before it expires and 2 years after (there are no exceptions). 2

Once renewed, your license expiration date will be extended for 8 years.

We recommend you renew in a DMV now to get an Enhanced or REAL ID, and avoid a second office visit later. 3 Learn about Enhanced, REAL ID and Standard documents [2].

chunk_id: How to renew a license#1_0::c0002
doc_id: How to renew a license#1_0
heading_path: How to renew a license [1]
Renew at an office and get an Enhanced or REAL ID
text:
[How to renew a license [1] > Renew at an office and get an Enhanced or REAL ID]
You don't have to get an Enhanced or REAL ID. 4 However, if you have a Standard, you will not be allowed to board a domestic flight starting in October 2020 (unless you have a Passport).

Complete this guide to make sure you have the proofs of identification and paperwork you need before you come to DMV. You can make a reservation at some DMV locations after completing the guide. You do not need a reservation to visit the DMV.

Find your proofs [3]

You can take a vision test at the DMV, for no additional charge.

You will receive a temporary license to use until your new license arrives by mail within 10 business days.

chunk_id: How to renew a license#1_0::c0003
doc_id: How to renew a license#1_0
heading_path: How to renew a license [1]
Renew online
text:
[How to renew a license [1] > Renew online]
WARNING: If you renew your Standard online, your new license will show: 'NOT FOR FEDERAL PURPOSES'.

Don't delay! Get your Enhanced or REAL ID today.

#### You must renew at a DMV office if you

- have a commercial driver license (CDL) 5
- want to update your photo

#### Follow these 3 steps to renew online and keep your current document type

If you already have an Enhanced or REAL ID, or you want to keep your Standard, you can renew online. Your document type will stay the same.

Step 1: Pass an eye test by an approved provider, like a pharmacy (find a test location now [4]), or have a professional complete a paper report. 6

Step 2: Renew online 7 You will keep the same document type you currently have (Standard, REAL ID or Enhanced).

Step 3: Download and print a temporary license in PDF format to use until your new license arrives. It will arrive in the mail within 10 business days.

Renew license online [5]

text:
[How to renew a license [1] > Renew by mail]
WARNING: If you renew your Standard by mail, your new license will show: 'NOT FOR FEDERAL PURPOSES'.

Don't delay! Get your Enhanced or REAL ID today.

If you already have an Enhanced or REAL ID, or you want to keep your Standard, you can renew by mail. Your document type will stay the same.

Complete the renewal notice we mailed you and return it with

- a completed Vision Test Report (PDF) [6] (MV-619) - or get tested by an approved vision registry provider (find a test location now [4])
- a check or money order payable to Commissioner of Motor Vehicles

If you did not receive a renewal notice, you can use an Application for Permit, Driver License or Non-Driver ID Card (PDF) [7] (MV-44)

Mail to:

NYS Department of Motor Vehicles207 Genesee Street, Suite 6Utica, NY 13501-2874

Fee (cost)
text:
[How to renew a license [1] > Fee (cost)]
Your renewal fee is on the renewal application we mail you and displayed before you pay online. They are also listed on the chart below for different types of licenses. The fees listed include the photo document fee and the supplemental Metropolitan Commuter Transportation District (MCTD) fee, if required. 8The additional fee for an enhanced driver licensed (EDL) is $30.00. The fee is added to the renewal fees for the driver license. There is no additional fee for a REAL ID, just the normal renewal fee will be charged.

If you have any other class combined with Class M or MJ (example: DM), add an additional $8.00 to the fee above.

If you apply by mail or at a DMV office, you can pay by credit/debit card or a check or money order made out to Commissioner of Motor Vehicles. To apply online, you must use a credit/debit card. The DMV accepts:

- American Express Card
- Discover Card /Novus
- MasterCard
- MasterCard Debit card without personal identification number (PIN)
- VISA Card
- Visa Debit Card without personal identification number (PIN)

chunk_id: How to renew a license#1_0::c0006

heading_path: How to renew a license [1]
Additional information
text:
[How to renew a license [1] > Additional information]
#### Veteran status designation

If you are a qualified U.S. military veteran who was honorably discharged, and you have a NY State driver license, learner permit or non-driver photo ID card, you can have the word "Veteran" printed on the upper left hand of your photo document.

There is no additional fee for the veteran status designation on your document, but all regular transaction fees will apply.

Learn how to get the veteran status on your license [8].

If you are active in the military, please see our military resources [9] for more information on renewing- and thank you for your service!

#### Your new license will come in about 10 business days

You can check the mailing status online [10]. If it has been more than 2 weeks since you renewed, contact us [11].

#### Your address must match the one on our records

You can first change your address online [12] and then renew. There is no guarantee that the US Postal Service will forward your DMV documents to your new address.

#### If you are turning 21 soon

If you renew more than 40 days before your 21st birthday, your license will have 'UNDER 21' 10

#### Out of the state or country

When out of NY State we recommend that you renew your NY driver license through the mail. 11 Send us

- the renewal notice we mailed you (MV-2) or if you don't have it, use the Application for Permit, Driver License, or Non-driver ID (PDF) [7] (MV-44)
- a Vision Test Report (PDF) [6] (MV-619) completed by an eye care professional
- a check or money order payable to Commissioner of Motor Vehicles

Send us a pre-addressed priority mail return envelope with your application. This will help ensure that we send your license to the correct address.

#### Temporary Visitors and international students

As long as the Temporary Visitor status that DMV has on file is not expired you can renew your license online, through the mail or in an office.

If your Temporary Visitor status has been extended, you must go to a DMV office with your updated paperwork from the United States Department of Homeland Security (DHS). We will update our records to show that your Temporary Visitor status has been extended so you can renew your license. Your new license will have your new temporary visitor expiration date.

#### Changing license class when renewing

You cannot change the class when you renew online. You can make these changes when you renew by mail or at a DMV office.

You cannot make any other class changes when you renew. Other changes require a written test and a road test. (See Get a CDL [13] or Get a motorcycle license [14]).

If you renew

- by mail, include a note about your class change in your renewal envelope
- at a DMV office, tell the DMV representative about the change

You will need to pay the renewal fee [15] for your new driver license class.

- 1.

If you drive with expired license get a traffic ticket, you will receive fines and penalties

- 60 days or less after the expiration date: $25 to $40 plus state and local surcharges
  - more than 60 days after the expiration date: $75 to $300 plus state and local surcharges

- 2. Renewal anytime within this period will not affect the expiration date of your new driver license or the fees. If your license is expired for **2 years or more,** you must apply for an original license. You must pass the vision test and the written test, complete a pre-licensing course and pass a Road Test. See Get a driver license [16].

- 3. Starting in October 2020, you will need an Enhanced or REAL ID to board a domestic flight (unless you have a passport).

If your license was issued before October 30, 2017 and is not Enhanced, you have a Standard document.

Newly issued Standard documents show: 'NOT FOR FEDERAL PURPOSES'.

- 4.

If you want to renew in an office and keep your Standard document type, follow these steps:

Step 1: Complete the renewal notice (MV-2) we mailed you.

- if you did not receive a renewal notice, you can use an Application for Permit, Driver License or Non-Driver ID Card [7] (MV-44)

Step 2: Come to an office. Bring

- your current Standard license
  - your renewal notice or application
  - payment

Newly issued Standard licenses show: 'NOT FOR FEDERAL PURPOSES'.

- 5. See information about how to renew a CDL [17].

- 6.

You can have a Vision Test Report (PDF) [6] (MV-619) completed by a medical professional listed below, and then enter the report information on the online transaction. You do not need to mail or bring us the report if you renew online.

- physician
  - physician's assistant
  - ophthalmologist
  - optometrist
  - optician
  - registered nurse
  - nurse professional

- 7. At the start of your online renewal transaction, you will be asked if you would like to register to vote or change your party designation. You are not required to register to vote, but you will be required to answer the question to proceed with your transaction. If you answer yes, you will complete your voter registration application as part of your renewal transaction.

- 8. Residents of the following counties must pay a supplemental Metropolitan Commuter Transportation District (MCTD) fee: Bronx, Kings (Brooklyn), New York (Manhattan), Queens, Richmond (Staten Island); Dutchess, Nassau, Orange, Putnam, Rockland, Suffolk and Westchester.

The MCTD fee is $1.00 for every 6 months the permit or driver license will be in effect. For an 8-year driver license, the MCTD fee is $16.

- 9. If you have a Class A, B or C with an endorsement of H or X, you must pass the hazardous materials knowledge test at a DMV office within 2 years before your renewal and pay an additional fee of $5 for the test.

- 10. If your renewal is processed less than 40 days before your birthday, we will mail you a driver license without the words UNDER 21 on or near the date of your birthday.

- 11. You can renew online if you are away and

- have a valid NY driver license
  -  have had an eye exam from the last 12 months saved to the DMV Vision Registry [18].

However, your license will not be forwarded to you out of state or out of the country.

# 如何续期注册

## 如何续期注册 [1]

您需要在注册到期前进行续期。您的新注册文件将在大约10天内邮寄给您。提前续期不会改变您新 注册的新到期日期。武装部队成员可能有更多时间续期 [2]。

您不能续期以下情况的注册

- 被暂停或吊销

- 过期超过1年 1

- 在过去12个月内未接受检查

### 在线

某些注册不符合条件。 2 如果您符合“免费”续期的条件，请不要在线续期。 3 费用在您的续期通知上，并且当您在线续期时会显示在电脑屏幕上。

您需要

- 您的注册（车牌）号码

- 您的注册类别

- 注册上的人（或企业名称）的姓氏

- 用于支付的信用卡或免密码借记卡

在线续期注册 [4]

### 通过邮寄

将您的注册续期通知（MV-3或OP-3）的底部部分邮寄到通知上列出的地址。附上一张个人支票或 汇票，收款人为“机动车专员”，用于支付费用。

如果您没有MV-3或OP-3，请使用重复/续期注册申请表（PDF） [5]（MV-82D）。如果您不知道正 确的续期金额，请寄一张支票，收款人为“机动车专员”，但不要填写金额。

将MV-82D和您的付款邮寄至

纽约州机动车管理局尤蒂卡处理中心邮政信箱359尤蒂卡，纽约州 13503

### 在DMV办公室

携带您的注册续期通知（MV-3或OP-3）和付款到DMV办公室。如果您没有MV-3或OP-3，请填写 重复/续期注册申请表（PDF） [5]（MV-82D）。

### 附加信息

#### 我的注册即将到期或已过期

您可以在到期日期后一年内在线续期。续期当天，您可以下载并打印一份有效期为10天的临时注册 证明。4

#### 我的地址变更了

您在DMV档案中的邮寄地址必须是最新的。您不能在交易过程中更改地址。请先在线更改您的地址 [6]，然后再续期。

注意：如果您向美国邮政服务（USPS）提交转寄邮件的请求，无法保证USPS会将所有DMV文件 转寄到您的新地址。

#### 我的姓名变更了

您仍然可以在线续期，但新文件将显示您之前的姓名。您不能在线交易过程中更改姓名。请参阅如 何更改注册或所有权证书上的姓名或其他信息[7]。

- 1. 您需要在DMV办公室注册车辆[8]。

- 2.

您不能在线续期以下注册：

- 免注册费的车辆 - 您必须携带证明车辆符合免税资格的文件到DMV办公室[9]

- - 需要提供保险证明、税收证明或其他文件才能续期的车辆

- - 重量为55,000磅或以上的车辆

- - 出租车辆（包括出租车、礼宾车和公共汽车）

- - 注册期为6年的半挂车

- - 根据国际注册计划（IRP）发行的分摊注册车辆

- - 救护车、纽约新闻（NYP）、政府或官方注册车辆

- - 租赁车辆

- 3. 如果您符合“免收费用”注册的资格，您需要到办公室续期。您需要携带文件以证明您符合免税 资格。

- 4. 仅在您的注册已过期或即将到期时使用临时注册，同时等待新注册文件邮寄到您手中。

在超级菜单中显示“在线办理”按钮：

主题：

- 注册[10]

相关PDF：

mv82d.pdf

在超级菜单中显示mydmv按钮：

禁用此交易？：

是或否调查：
