# Renew a CDL

# Renew a CDL [1]

WARNING: Your Standard CDL will not be accepted as proof of identification to board a domestic flight after October 1, 2020. If you plan to travel (and don't have a Passport), we recommend you upgrade to an Enhanced or REAL ID when you renew. Learn more about Enhanced, REAL ID and Standard documents [2].

Don't delay! Get your Enhanced or REAL ID today.

### You must renew at a DMV office

You must come to a DMV office [3] to renew a commercial driver license (CDL) or commercial license permit (CLP). Complete this guide to make sure you have the proofs of identification you need before coming.

Find your proofs [4]

You will receive a temporary license to use until your new license arrives by mail within 10 business days.

### What you need to renew a CDL

In addition meeting the requirements to renew any type of driver license [5], to renew your CDL, you will need to

- Meet the federal medical certification requirements [6]. You will need to indicate compliance when you answer the required questions on the MV-2CDL which is included with your renewal notice.
- Have proof of your legal presence in the United States on DMV records.The DMV Document Guide [4] lists all acceptable legal presence and New York State residence proof documents. Please note: You must provide us the original documents (not photocopies), and documents submitted as proof of residence must have your current residence address on it (no P.O. Box permitted).
  - If you are a U.S. citizen or lawful permanent resident, you will only need to provide this proof on the first (original, amendment, reciprocity or renewal) application on or after June 18, 2015. We will retain the proof on your driving record.
  - If you are temporary visitor, you will need to provide proof of legal presence in the U.S. with every application. Your new document will have the legend NON-DOMICILED and also TEMPORARY VISITOR and the expiration date of your legal status in the United States printed on it.

If you indicate the driving types NI (Non-excepted Interstate) or NA (Non-excepted Intrastate) on your renewal, you must provide a legible copy of your current USDOT Medical Examiner s Certificate to DMV if it is not already on file. Please see Federal Requirements for Commercial Driver License (CDL) Applicants (pdf) [7] (MV-44.5) to help you determine your driving type.

Per new federal regulations, the DMV will check for any open suspensions or revocations you may have in any state. If you have an open suspension or revocation, we will reject your application.

### Renewal Fees

The fees listed include the photo document fee and the supplemental Metropolitan Commuter Transportation District (MCTD) fee, if required. 1

If you have any other class combined with a motorcycle Class M or MJ (example: AM), add an additional $8.00 to the fee above.

If you have an endorsement of H or X, you must pass the hazardous materials knowledge test at a DMV office within 2 years before your renewal and pay an additional fee of $5 for the test.

- 1. Residents of the following counties must pay a supplemental Metropolitan Commuter Transportation District (MCTD) fee: Bronx, Kings (Brooklyn), New York (Manhattan), Queens, Richmond (Staten Island); Dutchess, Nassau, Orange, Putnam, Rockland, Suffolk and Westchester.

The MCTD fee is $1.00 for every 6 months the permit or driver license will be in effect. For an 8-year driver license, the MCTD fee is $16.

# Renew a hazardous materials (HazMat) endorsement

# Renew a hazardous materials (HazMat) endorsement [1]

### How do I renew my hazardous materials (HazMat) endorsement?

We will normally mail you a renewal notice for your HazMat endorsement, which is separate from the notice to renew your CDL. Follow the instructions in the HazMat endorsement renewal notice to apply for the background checks.

### How often do I need to get a background check?

To keep the HazMat endorsement, the driver must provide fingerprints and pass the background checks every five years. 1

### How do I provide my fingerprints for the background check?

The required fingerprinting service is being provided by Identogo. All HazMat endorsement applicants must be fingerprinted at one of the Identogo ID centers located throughout New York State. 2 3

Fingerprinting is done by appointment only. You must contact Identogo to select a fingerprinting location and schedule an appointment. Visit https://uenroll.identogo.com [2] or by calling 1-877-472-6915.

Attain Fingerprinting Services Information [3] (HAZ-600) to make your appointment. Bring your NYS CDL and one of the second proofs of ID that are listed on form HAZ-600.

### How long will the background checks take?

Background checks can take 30 days or more to complete. If your endorsement expires, it will not be restored until the criminal history background checks are completed and you have been re-qualified by both the TSA and the DMV.

### How will I be notified of the results?

The Federal Transportation Security Administration (TSA) will notify you by mail of the results of the background check based on federal standards only. The TSA website [4] has information about the federal background checks for the HazMat endorsements. Please do not request the results of background checks from the DMV, Identogo, or the TSA. Wait to receive the notifications in the mail.

### Can I get a temporary HazMat endorsement before the background checks are complete?

No. We cannot issue the HazMat endorsement until the background checks are completed and approved. We will provide a CDL with the HazMat endorsement that is valid for 90 days only if

- you applied to renew a current NYS CDL with a HazMat endorsement, and
- the background checks are not completed and approved before the endorsement expires.

### Do I need to take another written test?

To keep your HazMat endorsement, you must pass the test again within two years before your CDL expires. You can take the test when you apply to renew your CDL, or you can take the test up to two years before the expiration date of your CDL. 4If you need to take the test, you can study the hazardous materials section of the NYS Commercial Driver License Manual (CDL-10), or study the Hazardous Materials Manual (CDL-11).

### What if I do not pass the written test or the background checks?

If you do not pass the written test or the background checks, the DMV will issue a CDL that does not have a HazMat endorsement.It is important that a driver whose address has changed promptly file a change of address with the NYS DMV. See Address Change for more information.

### What if I no longer need the HazMat endorsement?

If you do not need a HazMat endorsement, do not take the written test and do not apply for the background checks. When it is time to renew your CDL, follow the instructions provided with your CDL renewal notice and pay the CDL renewal fee. The DMV will issue a CDL that does not have a HazMat endorsement.

- 1. Federal and State laws require fingerprint-based background checks for anyone who wants a hazardous materials endorsement, to determine whether that person has a criminal history and/or poses a security threat that warrants denying him or her the authorization to transport hazardous materials. No hazardous materials endorsement may be issued, transferred or renewed unless the background checks result in a determination by the Federal Transportation Security Administration (TSA) and New York State that the person applying for the endorsement is authorized to transport hazardous materials. To initiate background checks, the rules require that the applicant be fingerprinted, and that his or her United States citizenship or permanent legal presence in the United States be verified. The background checks include a check of criminal history data from the NYS Division of Criminal Justice Services and the Federal Bureau of Investigation (FBI). There is also a background check by the federal Transportation Safety Administration (TSA).
- 2. You must provide fingerprints even if you provided fingerprints for another application, for example for a pistol permit or employment as a security guard.
- 3. You must provide fingerprints for an H endorsement or an X endorsement on your CDL.
- 4. You must answer 80% or more of the questions correctly to pass the test. You can take the test as many times as necessary until you pass the test, but you must pay a $5 fee for each test you take.

## Do it by phone:

You can't renew a HazMat endorsement by phone.

You can call or email the HazMat unit with questions at

1-518-408-2997 or [email protected] [5]

## Do it by mail:

You can renew a HazMat endorsement by mail. Read the information on this page and send your application to

# Renew Driving School License

Driving School Licenses are issued to businesses that qualify to operate a driving school. These licenses are renewed for two years. The license must be renewed before the expiration date shown on the license if the driving school wants to continue to operate the business.

Driving School Licenses can be renewed up to six (6) months after they expire, but the Driving School business cannot operate unless the license is valid.

### How to renew

Your application for renewal of a Driving School License must be submitted between 30 and 60 days before the license expires (the expiration date is printed on your license). As part of the renewal process, you must provide updated information about your driving school including:

- Driving School Renewal Application [1] (form MV-522)
- Proof of Worker s Compensation (form C-105.2 or U-26.3) and Disability Benefits Insurance Coverage (form DB-120.1), OR a Certificate of Attestation of Exemption of Worker s Compensation and Disability Benefits Insurance Coverage (form CE-200).
- Payment of the license fee. You must include a check or money order for the renewal fee as identified on the application, payable to Commissioner of Motor Vehicles. Starter Checks cannot be accepted.

In addition:

- If your school uses vehicles for instruction, you must attach a List of Driving School Vehicles [2] (MV-527).
- If your school provides the Pre-licensing Course, you must attach a Signature Authorization List - Pre-Licensing Course [3] (MV-278.6).

### Expired Driving School License

You must immediately stop operating your driving school business. Your school will not be licensed to operate. Any services you provide through your driving school license (including Instructor Certificates, account to DMV s online road test appointment scheduling system, and authorization to order Pre-Licensing Course Completion Certificates) will be terminated.

Until your new license is issued, your instructors will not be able to teach for your school and your school will be unable to:

- provide lessons to customers
- teach the Pre-licensing Course (if your school was approved to teach this)
- schedule road tests or bring customers to a road test

You can renew the license up to 6 months after the previous license expires BUT any operation of your business between when your driving school license expired and the new license is issued will constitute unlicensed operation of a driving school. This could result in your having to pay a civil penalty of $1,000 and/or denial of future driving school license applications.

text:
# Renew non-driver ID card

# Renew non-driver ID card [1]

You can renew 1 year before and up to 2 years after your non-driver ID expires. If it is expired for 2 years or more, you can t renew - there are no exceptions.

If you are 62 or older or you receive Supplemental Security Income (SSI), you are eligible for a reduced fee or 'No Fee' ID. See the section Reduced fee or 'No Fee' non driver IDs on this page for more information.

### If you plan on traveling

We recommend you renew in a DMV now to get an Enhanced or REAL ID, and avoid a second office visit later. 2 Learn about Enhanced, REAL ID and Standard documents [2].

### Renew at an office and get an Enhanced or REAL ID

You don't have to get an Enhanced or REAL ID. 3 However, if you have a Standard, you will not be allowed to board a domestic flight starting in October 2020 (unless you have a Passport).

Complete this guide to make sure you have the proofs of identification you need before you come to DMV.

Find your proofs [3]

### Renew online

WARNING: If you renew your Standard online, your new ID will show: 'NOT FOR FEDERAL PURPOSES'.

Don't delay! Get your Enhanced or REAL ID today.

If you already have an Enhanced or REAL ID, or you want to keep your Standard, you can renew online. Your document type will stay the same.

Renew non-driver ID online [4]

### Renew by mail

WARNING: If you renew your Standard by mail, your new ID will show: 'NOT FOR FEDERAL PURPOSES'.

Don't delay! Get your Enhanced or REAL ID today.

If you already have an Enhanced or REAL ID, or you want to keep your Standard, you can renew by mail. Your document type will stay the same.

You cannot renew by mail if you have a REAL ID or Enhanced non-driver ID with a photo that is over 16 years old. You must come into an office to take a new picture.

Complete the notice we sent you and return it in the envelope provided. Be sure to include payment in the form of a check or money order payable to "Commissioner of Motor Vehicles".

If you did not receive a renewal notice, you can use an Application for Permit, Driver License or Non-Driver ID Card (pdf) [5] (MV-44).

Mail with payment to

NYS Department of Motor Vehicles207 Genesee Street, Suite 6Utica, NY 13501-2874

### Fee

Learn more about Standard, REAL ID and Enhanced documents [2].

#### Reduced fee or 'No Fee' non-driver IDs

If you receive Supplemental Security Income (SSI) and

- are under age 62, your fee is $6.50
- are age 62 or older, you can get a 'No Fee' renewal

If you have an Enhanced non-driver ID, the additional $30.00 still applies.

To get a reduced fee or 'No Fee' renewal, you must renew by mail or at a DMV office and provide proof of your eligibility. If you come to an office, you must bring an original copy of proof. If you apply by mail, send us a photocopy of your proof of SSI. You can't get a reduced or no fee renewal if you renew online. 4

We accept these documents as proof of SSI

- Notice of Award notifying you that you are eligible for SSI benefits
- Cost of Living Adjustment (COLA) letter
- Notice of change in payment (SSA-L8151)
- Third Party Query (TPQY) letter
- Report of Confidential Social Security Information (SSA-2258)
- Benefit Verification letter (you must call the Social Security Administration in advance to obtain this letter: 1-800-772-1213)

If you are age 62 or older and receive Supplemental Security Income (SSI), your fee is $6.50

#### You will get your new ID card in 2 weeks

Allow 2 weeks to receive it in the mail. You can check the mailing status [6] of your photo document online. If your document is not delivered two weeks after the date the document was processed, you can contact us [7].

### Additional information

#### If you are turning 21 soon

Wait until you are within 40 days of your 21st birthday to renew. If you renew 41 days or more before your 21st birthday, your ID will have UNDER 21 on it. If your renewal is processed than 40 days before your birthday, we will mail you a non-driver ID card the words UNDER 21 on or near the date of your birthday.

#### Temporary Visitor

As long as the Temporary Visitor status that DMV has on file is not expired you can renew your non-driver ID card online, through the mail or in an office.

If your Temporary Visitor status has been extended, you must go to a DMV office with your updated paperwork from the United States Department of Homeland Security (DHS). We will update our records to show that your Temporary Visitor status has been extended so you can renew your non-driver ID card. Your new non-driver ID card will have your new temporary visitor expiration date.

#### Overseas (out of the country, abroad)

When overseas, you must renew your non-drivers ID card through the mail. Please submit

- the renewal notice we mailed you, or if you don't have it, an Application for Permit, Driver License or Non-Driver ID Card (pdf) [5] (MV-44)
- the appropriate fee

We recommend that you send us a pre-addressed priority mail return envelope with your application. This will help ensure that we send your ID to the correct address.

- 1. Renewal anytime within this period will not affect the expiration date of your new non-driver ID card or the fees.

If your non-driver ID is expired for 2 years or more, you must apply for an original non-driver ID card. See Get a non-driver ID card (NDID) [8].

- 2. Starting in October 2020, you will need an Enhanced or REAL ID to board a domestic flight (unless you have a passport).

If your non-driver ID was issued before October 30, 2017 and is not Enhanced, you have a Standard document.

Newly issued Standard documents show: 'NOT FOR FEDERAL PURPOSES'.

- 3.

If you want to renew in an office and keep your Standard document type, follow these steps:

Step 1: Complete the renewal notice (MV-2) we mailed you.

- if you did not receive a renewal notice, you can use an Application for Permit, Driver License or Non-Driver ID Card (pdf) [5] (MV-44)

Step 2: Come to an office. Bring

- your current Standard non-driver ID
  - your renewal notice or application
  - payment

Newly issued Standard documents state: 'NOT FOR FEDERAL PURPOSES'.

- 4. If you renew online, you will need to pay the regular fees for a non-driver ID card renewal.

# Replace a title certificate

# Replace a title certificate [1]

When you apply for a replacement title at a DMV office, we will NOT hand you a new title while you are there. We print all title certificates in a secure facility in Albany and mail them to the vehicle owner.

### Express mail

We can send you your replacement title by express mail. This will cost extra, and you will need to sign for the delivery. Express mail is not available between Friday at 8:30 pm and Sunday at 8:30 pm. Sending us an application by express mail will not decrease the time it takes to review your application or issue the replacement title.

### Online

#### To order online

- you must be the owner of the vehicle or boat
- you must have a current U.S. address on file with the DMV 1
- the vehicle must be registered and titled in New York State
- there can be no other changes to the information listed on the title certificate

#### You cannot order online if

- a title certificate was processed within the last 15 days
- the title certificate is
  - a duplicate title certificate requesting removal of a lien
  - an original or amended title certificate
  - in the name of a deceased owner
  - ordered using a Power of Attorney

Examples:

- a title ordered before 8 p.m. on Tuesday is printed on Wednesday and mailed on Thursday
- a title ordered after 8 p.m. on Tuesday is printed on Thursday and mailed on Friday

A 'business day' is a weekday that is not a state holiday. If you order your title certificate during or before a weekend and/or a state holiday, the title certificate cannot be processed until the next business day after the weekend and/or state holiday.

An online transaction can only be cancelled on the same day it was ordered.

#### We mail to the address on the title record

We mail your new title to the current address on your title record. If the registration for your vehicle is in your name, you can first change your address online [2] and then replace your title. If you have allowed someone else to register your vehicle, you cannot change the address on your title record online. Please contact the Title Services Bureau at 1-518-486-4714 to update the address on your title.

Note: If you file a request with the US Postal Service (USPS) to forward mail, there is no guarantee that the USPS will forward your DMV documents to the new address. Please make certain your contact information with the DMV is up to date.

Replace a title certificate online [3]

### By mail

#### Send these items to the DMV

a completed Application for Duplicate Title (PDF) [4] (MV-902)

proof of identity - this can be a photocopy of your NY State Driver License, Learner Permit, or Non-Driver ID (see Proofs of Identify for Registration and Title (PDF) [5] (ID-82) for other acceptable proof)

a personal check or money order for $20.00 payable to Commissioner of Motor Vehicles

#### Mail to

##### Receive by standard mail

Title BureauNYS DMVPO Box 2750Albany, NY 12220-0750

##### Receive by express mail

Duplicate Title CertificatesNYS DMV6 Empire State PlazaAlbany, NY 12228

Use the Title Service Bureau phone number, 1-518-486-4714, on your express mail bill.

(Sending an application express mail will not decrease the time it takes to review the application or issue the replacement title.)

### At an office

#### Bring these items to a DMV office

a completed Application for Duplicate Titl (PDF) [4] (MV-902)

proof of identity 2

$20.00 for the replacement fee

#### You will not get your new title at the DMV

When you apply for a replacement title at a DMV office, you will NOT be issued the replacement title while there. All title certificates are printed in a secure facility in Albany and are mailed to the owner. For this reason, the fastest and easiest way to apply for a replacement title is to do it online.

### Apply for a title certificate only

Use the Application for Title Only (PDF) [6] (MV-82TON). Follow the instructions carefully.

Do not use to

- apply for both a vehicle registration and a title certificate at the same time
- replace a lost title certificate

 

- 1. Your duplicate title certificate will be sent to the address on file at the DMV. If you moved, learn how to change your address [2].
- 2. A **New York State Driver License, Learner Permit, or Non-Driver ID card** that is current or not expired for more than 2 years can serve as **proof of both identity and age.**If you don t have a New York State Driver License, Learner Permit, or Non-Driver ID, you can provide other kinds of proof [7].

# 更换 IRP 注册项目

# 更换 IRP 注册项目 [1]

要更换丢失或被盗的 IRP 注册项目，您必须向 International Registration Bureau (IRB) 申请。

### 通过邮件申请更换 IRP 注册项目

#### 通过邮件申请更换注册项目

- 填写并签署 Schedule A & C (pdf) [2] (IRP-6)
  - 在 Part 1 中，勾选“DUPLICATE CAB CARD”和/或“REPLACEMENT PLATE”和/或“REPLACEMENT STICKER”的复选框
  - 填写 Carrier and Fleet Information 部分以及表格的 Part 4，
- 寄送一张支付给 Commissioner of Motor Vehicles 的支票或汇票，金额正确。如果两块按比例分配的牌照都丢失或被盗，请从警察机构获取 Report of Lost or Stolen Motor Vehicle Items (MV-78B) 表格 1

如果您使用 United States Postal Service，请使用此地址：

International Registration BureauPO Box 2850 ESPAlbany, NY 12220-0850

如果您使用快递或其他方式，请使用此地址：

International Registration BureauNYS DMVRoom 1366 Empire State PlazaAlbany, NY 12228

### 在 Albany 的 Customer Service Counter 申请更换 IRP 注册项目

您可以在以下地点申请更换 IRP 注册项目：

Customer Service CounterRoom 136Swan Street BuildingEmpire State PlazaAlbany, NY 12228

申请时

- 填写并签署 Schedule A & C(pdf) [2] (IRP-6)
  - 在 Part 1 的 Type of Application Requested 中，勾选“DUPLICATE CAB CARD”和/或“REPLACEMENT PLATE”和/或“REPLACEMENT STICKER”的复选框。
  - 填写 Carrier and Fleet Information 部分以及表格的 Part 4，。
- 将完整的 Schedule A & C 带到 Customer Service Counter

### 通过传真申请更换 IRP 注册项目

申请时

- 填写并签署 Schedule A & C (pdf) [2](IRP-6)
  - 在 Part 1 中，勾选“DUPLICATE CAB CARD”和/或“REPLACEMENT PLATE”和/或“REPLACEMENT STICKER”的复选框
  - 填写 Carrier and Fleet Information 部分以及表格的 Part 4，
- 将完整的 Schedule A&C 传真至 IRB，号码为 518-486-6579

### 补办IRP注册项目的费用是多少？

补办IRP注册项目的费用为

- 更换按比例分配的车辆牌照及cab card - $27.50
- 更换cab card和贴纸 - $2.50
- 更换cab card - $2.50

### 当我收到新的按比例分配的牌照后，旧的按比例分配的牌照应如何处理？

如果一块或两块按比例分配的牌照仍在您手中，您必须在收到新牌照后的30天内寄回旧牌照和旧的cab card。未能归还牌照可能导致您的IRB账户被暂停。IRB将发放带有不同号码的新牌照，以及配套的新cab card。您不能要求使用与之前相同的号码。

### 如果我的按比例分配的牌照丢失或被盗，该怎么办？

如果两块按比例分配的牌照都丢失或被盗，请从警察机构获取表格Report of Lost or Stolen Motor Vehicle Items (MV-78B)。如果您的物品因犯罪而丢失，也请获取表格MV-78B。如果表格MV-78B显示物品因犯罪而丢失，您的物品将免费更换。

- 1. 如果您的物品因犯罪而丢失，请获取表格MV-78B。如果表格MV-78B显示物品因犯罪而丢失，您的物品将免费更换。

## 通过电话办理：

您不能通过电话申请补办IRP注册项目。

如有疑问，您可以致电IRB：

1-518-473-5834

text:

#### 更新地址

我们将文件寄送到下单时记录中的地址。如果您搬家了，请先更改您的地址 [7]，然后再申请更换。

#### 临时地址

当您通过邮寄或在DMV办公室申请时 [8]，您可以要求将更换文件寄送到与您证件上地址不同的地址。5 抱歉，在线申请时不能使用临时地址。

#### 我们将邮寄您的文件

我们会将其邮寄到当前记录中的邮寄地址或您提供的备用地址。6 如需核实或更改地址，请参阅地址变更 [7]。

您的驾照大约需要10天才能邮寄到。您可以在线查看邮寄状态 [9]。如果您订购补办驾照已超过2周，请联系我们 [10]。

更换证件时无需进行视力检查。

更换证件时，您的有效期和ID号码不会改变。

#### 更改姓名或进行其他更改

要更改姓名或其他非地址信息（照片、身高、添加/移除矫正镜片），您需要前往DMV办公室。请参阅如何更改姓名或其他信息 [11]。

#### 退伍军人身份标注

如果您是符合条件的美国退伍军人，且荣誉退伍，并持有纽约州驾驶执照、学习许可证或非驾驶员照片ID卡，您可以在照片证件的左上角印上“Veteran”字样。

在证件上添加退伍军人身份标注不收取额外费用，但所有常规交易费用仍适用。

了解如何在您的驾照上获取退伍军人身份标注 [12]。

#### 海外（国外、境外）

在海外时，您必须通过邮寄方式更换驾照。请提交

- 一份填写完整的Application for Permit, Driver License or Non-Driver ID Card (PDF) [5] (MV-44)
- 包含$17.50的付款

我们还建议您在申请中附上一个预先写好地址的优先邮件回邮信封（这将有助于确保我们将您的驾照寄送到正确的地址）。

#### 临时访客和国际学生

只要DMV档案中的Temporary Visitor状态未过期，您就可以在线、通过邮寄或在办公室更换驾照。

如果您的Temporary Visitor状态已延期，您必须携带来自Immigration and Naturalization Service (INS)的更新文件前往DMV办公室。我们将更新记录以显示您的Temporary Visitor状态已延期，以便您更换驾照。您的新驾照将显示新的临时访客到期日期。

- 1. 如果您在21岁生日前41天或更早申请补发驾照，驾照上会显示“UNDER 21”。

- 2. 从2020年10月开始，您需要Enhanced或REAL ID才能搭乘国内航班（除非您持有护照）。

如果您的驾照或许可证是在2017年10月30日之前签发且不是Enhanced，则您持有的是Standard文件。

新签发的Standard文件显示：“NOT FOR FEDERAL PURPOSES”。

- 3.

如果您想在办公室补办并保留Standard文件类型，请按照以下步骤操作：

步骤1：填写《许可证、驾照或非驾驶员ID卡申请表》（PDF）[5]（MV-44）

步骤2：前往办公室。携带

- 您当前的驾照或许可证
  - 您的申请表
  - 付款

新签发的Standard驾照和许可证显示：“NOT FOR FEDERAL PURPOSES”。

- 4. 要免费补发因被盗或因犯罪而丢失的驾照或学习许可证，您必须从警察机构获取MV-78B表格。此表格仅可从警察机构获得，而非DMV。

- 5. 如果您希望将新驾照寄送到备用地址，请附上额外说明并清晰打印备用地址。不要在MV-44表格上写备用地址。您在MV-44表格上填写的邮寄地址必须是您照片文件和DMV记录中列出的地址。

- 6. 如果您希望将新驾照寄送到备用地址，请附上额外说明并清晰打印备用地址。不要在MV-44表格上写备用地址。您在MV-44表格上填写的邮寄地址必须是您照片文件和DMV记录中列出的地址。

# 更换或转让个性化车牌

# 更换或转让个性化车牌 [1]

### 如何更换或转让个性化车牌？

在多种情况下，您可以更换或转让个性化车牌。

### 我可以更换老旧或损坏的个性化车牌吗？

可以，但需付费。如需更换老旧或损坏的个性化车牌，您必须致电定制车牌部门，电话1-518-402-4838。办公时间为周一至周五上午8:00至下午4:00。

费用为：乘用车车牌28.75美元，摩托车车牌18.75美元。

### 我可以将现有的个性化车牌更换为不同的个性化车牌或个性化图片车牌吗？

可以，但需付费。如需将当前的个性化车牌更换为新的定制车牌或个性化车牌，您必须致电定制车牌部门，电话1-518-402-4838。办公时间为周一至周五上午8:00至下午4:00。

### 我拥有个性化图片车牌，想更换为不同的图片车牌。我可以保留当前的个性化组合并将其用于新的图片车牌吗？

如果您想要的车牌类别允许使用当前车牌上的字符数进行个性化组合，您可以在新定制车牌上使用该组合。大多数图片车牌除了31.25美元的定制车牌费外，还需缴纳31.25美元的年度个性化费用。您还必须为新车牌支付车牌费，但您将获得当前注册中已支付的定制车牌费用的抵扣。1

请联系定制车牌部门，电话1-518-402-4838。办公时间为周一至周五上午8:00至下午4:00。2

### 我可以将当前的一套个性化车牌转让到我计划购买的新车上吗？

可以。如果注册人和注册类别不变，请指示汽车经销商将您的个性化车牌转让到您的新车上。如果您从私人处购买车辆，请在注册车辆时请求DMV转让您的个性化车牌。

### 如果我将车辆停驶，可以保留我的个性化车牌吗？

可以。您可以在大多数DMV办公室存放您的个性化车牌。3

查找DMV办公室。[2]

当您上交个性化车牌时，您将收到一张收据（表格FS-6T）。请核对收据上列出的信息，并确保收据上显示“已存放在当地办公室”字样，并保留此收据。我们将在注册记录上注明车辆车牌已存放。

要重新注册车辆，或使用您存储的自选车牌为另一辆车注册，您必须前往存放您车辆车牌的DMV办公室。请确保携带收据（表格FS-6T）以及注册车辆所需的其他文件。

- 1. 例如：您拥有IMJOE标准系列自选车牌，年费为$31.25（每两年注册费为$62.50）。您订购带有图片的车牌（如NASCAR、Yankees）上的IMJOE，并支付$62.50的年自选车牌费（下次两年续期时需支付$125，另加其他续期费用），以及车牌和文件费用。
- 2. 在线自选车牌订购系统无法为您当前注册中已支付的自选车牌费用提供抵扣，但自选车牌部门可以。
- 3. 存储车辆车牌的政策各办公室不同。

## 通过电话办理：

您必须通过电话更换或转移自选车牌。

致电自选车牌部门，电话1-518-402-4838。

办公时间为周一至周五上午8:00至下午4:00。

## 通过邮件办理：

您不能通过邮件更换或转移自选车牌。

## 在DMV办理：

您不能在DMV更换或转移自选车牌。

# Report a problem with a DMV regulated automotive business

# Report a problem with a DMV regulated automotive business [1]

### What is a DMV regulated automotive business?

The DMV regulates all repair shops, inspection stations, dealers, junk and salvage vendors, and other automotive related businesses in New York State. 1

### How do I place a complaint against a DMV regulated automotive business?

First, attempt to resolve the issue with the management of the business. Keep a written record of all contacts with management in addition to details about the inspection, repair, or sale. Copies of work orders and invoices are proof of your attempts to resolve the problem. 2

If a satisfactory resolution is not reached and you wish to file a complaint, you must submit a Vehicle Safety Complaint Report (PDF) [2] (VS-35) along with any supporting documents to the DMV Consumer & Facilities Services Complaint Unit. To submit electronically, download the complaint report available at the link above to your personal device. Attach and then email the completed report as well as any supporting documents to [email protected] [3]. Please note that DMV staff will communicate with you through email.

Complaint UnitBureau of Consumer & Facility ServicesDepartment of Motor VehiclesP.O. Box 2700-ESP, Albany, NY 12220-0700FAX: (518) 486-4102Phone: 1-518-474-8943 (between 8:30 a.m. and 4:15 p.m., Monday - Friday)Email: [email protected] [3]

IMPORTANT: DMV staff will not investigate a complaint until a completed VS-35 Complaint Report has been received. The department does not investigate complaints that have been filed anonymously. There is a 90-day limit on reporting incidents related to a NYS Repair Shop. We cannot accept complaints against Repair Shops beyond the 90-day limit or 3,000 miles (whichever comes first). The DMV cannot resolve disputes over the terms of manufacturer or third party warranties or guarantees. If you feel you have a NYS Lemon Law complaint, please see Lemon Law Complaints [4].Once your complaint has been filed, a Consumer Services Representative (CSR) from DMV will be assigned to handle your complaint. If the CSR is unable to resolve your complaint, the case will be sent to an Automotive Facilities Inspector for a formal investigation and possibly a hearing. 3Depending on the complaint, this process could take several weeks to several months to resolve. 4

- 1. Other related automotive businesses include vehicle dismantlers, salvage pools, mobile car crushers and itinerant vehicle collectors.
- 2. We cannot take action against a facility unless we can find adequate evidence to substantiate the claim. Additionally, if the facility does not have a current registration, there are limitations on any fines and penalties that may be recovered.
- 3. For additional information on the investigation and hearing process, please see our What to Expect if You File a Complaint Against a DMV Regulated Business [5].
- 4. If you have questions regarding a complaint you placed or the complaint process in general, contact the DMV Complaint Unit at 1-518-474-8943. Office hours are Monday - Friday, 8:15am - 4:15pm.

text:
[驾驶学校和教练的要求与表格 > 驾驶学校的要求]
驾驶学校必须满足多项要求，这些要求载于《专员条例》第76部分( PDF ) [2]和《纽约州车辆与交通法》第394条( PDF ) [3] ,包括

-驾驶学校必须有经批准的营业场所,包括

--对公众开放的办公室，以及

- -至少50平方英尺专用于驾驶学校业务运营的空间

- -必须展示的标识，置于显眼处:

- -驾驶学校许可证

--营业时间(办公室对公众开放的时间)

- -标明"必须向申请人提供所有付款收据”的标牌

- -可接受的收据和合同

- -可接受的记录保存

-驾驶学校必须至少有一名持证驾驶教练，且该教练具有至少1,000小时的实际驾驶教学经验。更多信息请参见《驾驶学校教练证书申请表》( PDF ) \4N] ( MV-523 )。

-如果驾驶学校提供5小时预许可课程，学校必须拥有

-- DMV批准的教室(位于营业地点或异地)，以及

- -至少一名获批准教授预许可课程的持证驾驶学校教练。

-所有用于驾驶教学或考试的车辆都必须使用驾驶学校车辆清单( PDF ) [54表格( MV-527 )向D MYV报告。每辆车还必须配备学生驾驶员标志，以及供教练使用的双控判车和后视镜。

-所有非教练的员工必须使用个人历史( PDF ) \6]表格( MV-521.1 )向DMV报告。

-如果驾驶学校教练被解屋，驾驶学校必须使用驾驶学校教练解懂通知( PDF ) [7J表格( MV-52 6 )通知DMV。

-驾驶学校所有者必须确保学校的所有广告(印刷、电子或其他形式)符合专员条例第76.21条( PDF ) \2的规定。如果您的企业被批准为驾驶学校，DMV可能会进行定期检查和审计，以确保您遵守这些要求。您还必须遵守您经营轰驶学校业务所在市政当局的所有规则和条例。

驾驶学校教练只有在受履于有执照的驾驶学校时才能获得认证。驾驶学校教练必须满足多项要求，这些要求在专员条例第76.15条( PDF ) [2]中有所规定,包括

-必须年满21岁

-必须持有在纽约州有效驾驶的轰驶执照,该执照:

- -在申请前至少2年内，在教练打算教学的车辆类别中有效，并且

- -在过去2年内未被暂停或吊销

- -显示可接受的驾驶记录

-必须拥有高中或高中同等学历文任

-必须通过要求的测试，包括

- -视力测试

- -路标测试

--笔试

- -驾驶学校教练驾驶测试

驾驶学校教练还必须在首次续签教练证书之前完成由专员批准的鸭驶员培训和交通安全课程，该课程至少包括30小时(称为)。这门30小时的课程由各个社区学院和经DMV批准提供此课程的驾驶学校教授。想要教授预许可课程的驾驶学校教练还必须成功完成30小时的教学技巧和方法课程(大学水平课程)，并且至少有一年作为经过认证的驾驶学校教练进行实际驾驶教学的经验。如需更多信息,请联系DTP :纽约州机动车辆管理局驾驶员培训项目局帝国大厦广场6号，327室奥尔巴尼,纽约州12228(518) 473-7174

# Resources for non US citizens

### Drivers from other Countries

#### Only New York state residents need New York State driver licenses

You can drive in New York State with a valid driver license from another country. You do not need to apply for a New York State driver license unless you become a New York State resident.

To get a New York State driver license, you must pass a written test, complete a 5-hour pre-licensing course and pass a road test.

When you pass your road test, you must give your foreign driver license to the DMV road test examiner. The local DMV office will destroy your foreign driver license after 60 days. If you plan to return to your home country and will need your foreign driver license, ask the road test examiner how to make sure that your foreign driver license is not destroyed.

#### You do not need to be a US Citizen to get a New York driver license, permit or non-driver ID card

If you are not a US citizen, you must have US Department of Homeland Security (DHS) documentation that supports your legal status in this country. The expiration date from your DHS document is added to your New York State permit, driver license or non-driver ID card. Learn more about how to get a

- driver license [1]
- learner permit [2]
- non-driver ID card [3]

If your temporary visitor status gets extended, you must bring to a DMV office

- a completed Application for Permit, Driver License or Non-Driver ID Card (PDF) [4] (MV-44)
- your updated paperwork from the DHS (your documents must be valid, current and verifiable)
- 6 points of identification [5]

#### Non citizens and types of ID

New York offers three types of ID documents [6]; standard licenses and IDs, Real IDs, and Enhanced licenses and IDs. Non citizens are eligibile for standard IDs and Real IDs. However, only US Citizens are eligibile for Enhanced IDs.

#### Renewing your license

As long as the Temporary Visitor status that DMV has on file is not expired you can renew your license online, through the mail or in an office.

If your Temporary Visitor status has been extended, you must go to a DMV office with your updated paperwork from the United States Department of Homeland Security (DHS). We will update our records to show that your Temporary Visitor status has been extended so you can renew your license. Your new license will have your new temporary visitor expiration date.

#### What does 'TEMPORARY VISITOR' mean?

A Temporary Visitor is defined as anyone who is not immigrating to or not residing (living) in the United States. These visitors have US Department of Homeland Security (DHS) documentation that supports their legal status in this country.

If you have DHS documents that identify you as a Temporary Visitor, your New York State driver license, permit or non-driver ID card will have

- 'TEMPORARY VISITOR' on it, and
- the expiration date from your DHS document

Please note that your DMV document does not expire on the Temporary Visitor expiration date, nor will your privilege to drive in New York.

### If I have a driver license from another country and I have a NY State learner permit, can I drive without a supervising driver?

Yes. Your valid foreign driver license allows you to drive without a supervising driver. You can drive on any street, road, highway, bridge, or tunnel, except in a DMV road test area.

If your driver license is printed in any language except English, you must bring an International Driving Permit or a certified translation of your driver license to the road test. The translation must be certified by a consulate, the US Department of State, or another official agency. The translation must include

- your name
- your date of birth
- the expiration date of your foreign driver license
- a list of the types of vehicles that your foreign driver license allows you to drive

If you have a NY State learner permit, and you do not have a valid foreign driver license, NY State law requires a supervising driver to ride with you. The supervising driver must be age 21 or over and must have a valid driver license to operate the vehicle that you drive.

#### Temporary Visitors and international students

As long as the Temporary Visitor status that DMV has on file is not expired you can renew your license online, through the mail or in an office.

If your Temporary Visitor status has been extended, you must go to a DMV office with your updated paperwork from the United States Department of Homeland Security (DHS). We will update our records to show that your Temporary Visitor status has been extended so you can renew your license. Your new license will have your new temporary visitor expiration date.

# 回复DMV保险信函和命令

### 我收到了DMV的保险“信函”或“命令”。我能做什么？

仔细阅读信函或命令（参见示例 [1]），迅速回复，并立即联系您的保险公司。如果有问题，您有责任解决。如果您不这样做，DMV可能会暂停您的车辆注册和驾驶执照。

#### 不要

- 如果您的保险被取消，即使您认为这是个错误，也不要使用您的车辆
- 在您与保险公司解决问题时，不要保留车牌 1

#### 要

- 在您的保险覆盖结束前，交出您的车辆注册和车牌 [2]

### 我如何回复信函或命令？

您的回复必须

- 证明您有保险覆盖
- 证明您出售了车辆
- 证明不需要保险覆盖

如果您有保险覆盖，也请您的保险公司（不要问您的代理人或经纪人）向DMV电子提交保险覆盖通知。 2

### 如果我没有责任保险，我必须做什么？

如果您没有保险，或者保险即将到期且您不打算更换，您需要立即向DMV交出您的车牌 [2]。 3

### 我收到一封说明我的保险失效的信。我能做什么？

这封信意味着您的保险公司通知DMV您的保险覆盖已结束，并且没有其他公司通知DMV关于新的覆盖。

如果您有保险，请按照信中的指示操作，并联系您的公司或代理人解决问题。请您的公司向DMV电子提交覆盖通知。

如果您没有保险，您需要立即向DMV交出您的车辆注册和车牌。

### 我收到一封说明我的驾照被暂停的信。我能做什么？

这封信意味着您的保险公司已通知DMV您的保险保障已终止，且没有其他公司就新保障通知DMV。

如果您有保险，请按照信中的指示操作，并就问题联系您的公司或代理人。请您的公司以电子方式向DMV提交保障通知。

如果您没有保险，您需要立即将车辆登记和车牌交还给DMV。

当保障中断达到91天或以上，或中断期间尚未确定时，驾驶执照将被吊销。要确定中断期间，

- 车牌必须交还，或
- 车牌必须报告为丢失/被盗/被没收，或
- 登记必须到期，或
- 车牌必须由DMV转移到另一辆车，或
- DMV必须收到新的或恢复的保险证明，或
- DMV必须收到其他可接受的证明

一旦中断期间确定，登记将被暂停，如果中断期间为91天或以上，您的驾驶执照也将被暂停相同天数。暂停可能不在同一日期生效。因此，您可能先执行驾驶执照的暂停，或先执行登记的暂停。驾驶执照的暂停不会结束，直到您支付暂停终止费[3]并执行完暂停。

- 1. 将您的车牌交还给DMV。当问题纠正后，您可以获得您的登记和新车牌。
- 2. 纸质证明或电子邮件信息不可接受。您的保险代理人或经纪人不能以电子方式提交您的保险证明。只有您的保险公司才能以电子方式提交保险证明。
- 3. 如果您不打算立即更换您的保险保障，您必须交还您的车牌。

截至2019年9月27日，驾驶员改进部门正在审核于以下日期或之前通过邮件收到的申请：

- 常规申请（少于3次）- 2019年7月18日
- 多次酒驾申请（3次或以上）- 2019年7月22日

严重交通违规或多次违规可能导致您的纽约州驾驶执照或驾驶特权被吊销。1 吊销意味着您的驾照被取消，一旦吊销期结束，您必须申请新的驾照。您可能还需要重新参加笔试和路考。

对于大多数吊销情况，您必须先向DMV驾驶员改进部门（DIU）请求并获得批准，然后才能在DMV办公室申请新的驾驶执照。如果您在其他州持有驾照，您必须获得DIU的批准才能恢复您的纽约州驾驶特权。DIU必须审查您的完整驾驶记录，以确定您是否符合纽约州法律和要求获得批准。

text:
[吊销后恢复驾照 [1] > 在线 > 撤销后在线申请新驾照需要什么？]
某些情况需要在您提交批准申请前采取额外行动。如果您在解决以下列出的项目之前提交申请，我们将发送电子邮件告知您需要做什么。我们将延迟处理您的申请，直到这些项目得到处理并通知DMV：

- 如果法院判决包括缓刑期，且条件包括对重新申请驾照/特权的限制，您必须提供：
  - 一份缓刑条件副本，以及由判决您的法院或您需报到的缓刑办公室出具允许申请驾照的信函。信函必须使用法院或缓刑办公室的信头；或

- 如果您的缓刑已终止，您必须提供法院/缓刑部门使用其信头出具的信函，说明缓刑终止日期；或

- 如果您的缓刑条件不包括驾驶限制，您必须提供条件副本。请将此信息邮寄或传真至DIU：

Driver Improvement UnitNYS DMV6 Empire State Plaza, Room 338Albany, NY 12228(518) 474-0774, Option \#5 (电话时间：周一至周五，上午8:30至中午)传真 (518) 474-6208

一旦DIU收到可接受的文件，您就可以在线完成恢复申请。
- 如果您在25年内有两次或以上酒驾/毒驾定罪，您必须在最终审查之日起一年内完成酒精评估和/或治疗。您的提供者必须通过电子方式通知DMV您已成功完成。您提交的纸质证明将不被接受。您可以通过访问NY State Office of Alcoholism and Substance Abuse Services (OASAS)网站 www.oasas.ny.gov [3] 查找纽约州内可接受的评估和治疗提供者。点击右侧顶部框中的“FIND A PROVIDER”链接。点击项目类型：“Providers of Clinical Screening and Assessment Services for Impaired Driving Offender”以搜索您所在地区经OASAS批准的临床服务提供者列表。您可以按县、城市或邮政编码搜索批准的提供者。如果您无法访问互联网，请拨打OASAS HOPE热线1-877-846-7369。该免费热线全天24小时、每周7天运营。选择酒精或药物评估/治疗提供者时，请注意提供者必须出现在列表中。除非提供者已获得OASAS批准，否则将不被接受。要进入此批准列表，提供者必须联系OASAS，电话1-800-482-9564获取说明。对于纽约州以外的服务，提供者必须位于Substance Abuse & Mental Health Service Administration (SAMHSA)网站 https://findtreatment.samhsa.gov [4] 的批准提供者列表中。提供者将需要表格DS-449 Alcohol and Drug Abuse Rehabilitation Program Summary。他们可以联系Driver Improvement Unit, 6 Empire State Plaza, Room 336, Albany, NY 12228或传真(518) 473-8229获取此表格。
- 如果您欠任何DMV费用（暂停终止费、民事罚款或Driver Responsibility Assessment (DRA)），必须在申请驾照前支付，否则您的申请处理将延迟。有关如何支付DMV费用的信息，请访问我们的网站dmv.ny.gov [5] 并选择标有Tickets, Points and Penalties的主题。
- 如果您目前因未支付子女抚养费而被暂停驾照，在继续申请新驾照之前，您必须联系当地子女抚养费征收单位进行支付并解除暂停。根据法律，DMV不能清除/移除子女抚养费暂停，除非Office of Temporary Disability (OTDA)指示这样做。一旦OTDA电子通知DMV解除暂停，您可以继续提交在线重新许可申请。不遵守这些指示将因您记录中的未解除暂停而延迟重新许可申请的处理。
- 如果您目前因未缴纳纽约州税款而被暂停驾照，在继续申请新驾照之前，您必须联系NY State Department of Tax and Finance (DTF) [6] 或致电(518) 862-6000进行支付并解除暂停。根据法律，DMV不能清除欠税暂停，除非DTF指示这样做。一旦DTF电子通知DMV解除暂停，您可以继续提交在线重新许可申请。不遵守这些指示将因您记录中的未解除暂停而延迟重新许可申请的处理。
- 如果您目前因未向DMV提交可接受的事故报告而被暂停驾照，在继续申请新驾照之前，您必须将填写完整的Report of Motor Vehicle Accident (表格MV-104)传真至(518) 474-0718。此表格处理后，您可以继续提交在线重新许可申请。不遵守这些指示将因您记录中的未解除暂停而延迟重新许可申请的处理。
- 如果您有未处理的交通罚单或欠法院罚款，您必须联系记录法院。未处理的罚单需要处理，所有罚款需要在您申请驾照前支付。一旦法院通知DMV罚单已处理，您可以继续提交在线重新许可申请。

注意：任何额外的驾驶违规定罪或其他添加到您驾驶记录的事件可能使您不符合批准资格或延迟批准过程。

附加要求
吊销后申请新驾照需要什么条件？
text:
[吊销后恢复驾照 [1] > 附加要求 > 吊销后申请新驾照需要什么条件？]
您必须提交完整的《许可证、驾照或非驾驶员身份证申请表》[7]（MV-44）、不可退还的$100费用以及下方任何相关材料。

- 如果法院判决中包含缓刑期，且缓刑条件包括对重新申请驾照/驾驶特权的限制，您必须提供：
  - 一份缓刑条件副本，以及由判决法院或您需报到的缓刑办公室出具的允许申请驾照的信函。信函必须使用法院或缓刑部门的信笺抬头；或
  - 如果您的缓刑已终止，您必须提供法院/缓刑部门出具的信函，使用其信笺抬头，注明缓刑终止日期；或
  - 如果您的缓刑条件不包含驾驶限制，您必须提供缓刑条件副本。
- 如果您在25年内有两次或以上酒驾/毒驾定罪，您必须在最终审查之日起一年内完成酒精评估和/或治疗。您的服务提供者必须通过电子方式通知DMV您已成功完成。您提交的纸质证明将不被接受。您可以通过访问纽约州酗酒和药物滥用服务办公室（OASAS）网站www.oasas.ny.gov [3]查找纽约州内可接受的评估和治疗服务提供者。点击右侧顶部方框中的“查找服务提供者”链接。点击项目类型：“为酒驾罪犯提供临床筛查和评估服务的提供者”，以搜索您所在地区经OASAS批准的临床服务提供者列表。您可以按县、城市或邮政编码搜索经批准的服务提供者。如果您无法上网，请拨打OASAS HOPE热线1-877-846-7369。该免费热线全天候24小时、每周7天运营。选择酒精或药物评估/治疗服务提供者时，请注意该服务提供者必须出现在列表中。除非经OASAS批准，否则服务提供者将不被接受。要进入此批准列表，服务提供者必须联系OASAS，电话1-800-482-9564获取说明。对于纽约州以外提供的服务，服务提供者必须出现在药物滥用与精神健康服务管理局（SAMHSA）网站https://findtreatment.samhsa.gov [4]的批准服务提供者列表中。服务提供者需要表格DS-449《酒精和药物滥用康复项目摘要》。他们可以联系Driver Improvement Unit, 6 Empire State Plaza, Room 336, Albany, NY 12228或传真(518) 473-8229获取此表格。
- 如果您欠任何DMV费用（暂停终止费、民事罚款或驾驶员责任评估（DRA）），必须在申请驾照前支付，否则您的申请处理将延迟。有关如何支付DMV费用的信息，请访问我们的网站dmv.ny.gov [5]并选择标有“罚单、积分和罚款”的主题。
- 如果您目前因未支付子女抚养费而被暂停驾照，在继续申请新驾照之前，您必须联系当地子女抚养费征收单位进行支付并解除暂停。根据法律，DMV不能解除子女抚养费暂停，除非临时残疾援助办公室（OTDA）指示这样做。一旦OTDA通过电子方式通知DMV解除暂停，您可以继续提交重新申请驾照的申请。不遵守这些指示将因您记录中的未解除暂停而延迟重新申请驾照的处理。
- 如果您目前因未缴纳纽约州税款而被暂停驾照，在继续申请新驾照之前，您必须联系纽约州税务和财政局（DTF）[6]或致电(518) 862-6000进行支付并解除暂停。根据法律，DMV不能解除欠税暂停，除非DTF指示这样做。一旦DTF通过电子方式通知DMV解除暂停，您可以继续提交重新申请驾照的申请。不遵守这些指示将因您记录中的未解除暂停而延迟重新申请驾照的处理。
- 如果您目前因未向DMV提交可接受的事故报告而被暂停驾照，在继续申请新驾照之前，您必须将填写完整的《机动车事故报告》（表格MV-104）传真至(518) 474-0718。此表格处理后，您可以继续提交重新申请驾照的申请。不遵守这些指示将因您记录中的未解除暂停而延迟重新申请驾照的处理。
- 如果您有未处理的交通罚单或欠法院罚款，您必须联系记录法院。未处理的罚单需要处理，所有罚款需要在您申请驾照前支付。一旦法院通知DMV罚单已处理完毕，您可以继续提交重新申请驾照的申请。

将您的申请、$100重新申请费（支票或汇票，收款人为机动车管理局局长）以及法院/缓刑文件（如适用）邮寄至：

Driver Improvement UnitNYS DMV6 Empire State Plaza, Room 338Albany, NY 12228(518) 474-0774，选项\#5（电话时间：周一至周五，上午8:30至中午）传真(518) 474-6208

驾驶员改进部门（DIU）将根据您的终身驾驶记录做出决定，并将回复邮寄给您。回复将包含关于您下一步操作的说明。无论您的申请被拒绝还是批准，这些说明也将在下方概述。

注意：以前持有其他州或司法管辖区的学习驾照、驾照，或在其他州或司法管辖区有酒驾/毒驾定罪/事故的驾驶员，将被发送额外表格填写。此表格必须填写并返回驾驶员改进部门，才能完成最终审查。

heading_path: 吊销后恢复驾照 [1]
附加要求
如果我的驾照申请被DIU拒绝会怎样？
text:
[吊销后恢复驾照 [1] > 附加要求 > 如果我的驾照申请被DIU拒绝会怎样？]
您有以下四个选项（这些选项也印在DIU发出的拒绝信上）：

1. 接受拒绝决定，不再采取进一步行动。如果您的拒绝信上印有建议您可重新申请的日期，您可在该日期前最多60天内提交重新申请。

2. 通过提交随拒绝信附上的Request For Relicensing Reconsideration After Denial表格，请求对拒绝决定进行复议，寄送至：

Driver Improvement UnitNYS DMV6 Empire State Plaza, Room 338Albany, NY 12228(518) 474-0774, Option \#5（电话时间：周一至周五，上午8:30至中午）传真：(518) 474-6208

在拒绝信日期后的六十（60）天内提交。如果您选择此选项，请阅读并遵循以下指示，因为您每次重新申请驾照时，仅有一次机会提交所有不寻常、可谅解且令人信服的情况。请注意，不寻常、可谅解且令人信服的情况必须同时满足所有三个标准才能成功。如果您认为存在不寻常、可谅解且令人信服的情况，可作为Department偏离一般吊销政策并批准您驾照申请的合理依据：

- 您必须详细解释每种情况；
- 您必须提供可信、可验证的文件来支持所有声称的情况。例如，如果您需要驾照以便自己或家人前往必要的医疗治疗，您必须提供文件来验证并解释医疗状况的性质、参加与该状况或治疗相关的必要预约的需求，并证明没有其他交通方式（包括负担得起的私人及公共交通）可用于前往医疗预约。可信、可验证的文件是指来自第三方（非亲属）的支持您主张的文件。一些例子包括：来自您的医生、雇主、宗教官员、政府官员、教授、顾问的支持信/声明、公共交通时刻表、路线和/或地图、收据、医疗账单、预约时间表等。如果您未为每种声称的情况提供可信、可验证的文件，您的请求将被拒绝。请注意：不寻常、可谅解且令人信服的情况本身并不保证批准。如果您的驾驶记录表明您对高速公路安全构成持续风险，即使有可谅解的情况，您的重新申请也可能不被批准。
- 寄往Driver Improvement Bureau的Request For Relicensing Reconsideration After Denial必须包含您初次申请时提交的关于不寻常、可谅解且令人信服情况的任何文件。
- 如果致Driver Improvement Bureau的信函逾期，将不予考虑，您收到的拒绝决定将成为最终决定。您的请求/信函必须在拒绝信日期后的六十（60）天内提交至Driver Improvement Bureau。如果在60天后收到，将被拒绝。

1.  向DMV上诉委员会提交对撤销的上诉。要提交上诉，请在拒绝信日期后的六十（60）天内，将上诉表格[12]、上诉书及拒绝信副本邮寄至DMV上诉委员会。如果在60天后收到，您的上诉请求将被拒绝。
    - 根据法律，上诉委员会不能考虑超过60天提交的上诉。它也不能审查您未首先提交给Driver Improvement Bureau的任何论点或主张。不要向上诉委员会提交关于异常、可减轻处罚和令人信服的情况的主张。
2.  向Driver Improvement Unit提交另一份重新许可申请。虽然您可以随时提交新驾驶执照的申请，但请注意，Driver Improvement Unit将根据导致先前拒绝的相同标准审查您的整个驾驶历史。每份申请还需缴纳法定的100美元费用。您可以向上述地址提交额外的申请。

附加要求
如果我的驾驶执照申请被DIU批准会怎样？
text:
[吊销后恢复驾照 [1] > 附加要求 > 如果我的驾驶执照申请被DIU批准会怎样？]
对于被撤销纽约州驾驶执照的持有人，如果在撤销后获准重新许可，您不能驾驶，直到新的纽约州驾驶执照由DMV发证办公室签发。

您将收到来自Driver Improvement Unit的批准包。此包包含针对您的具体说明。按照说明申请您的新驾驶执照。根据您的纽约州驾驶执照记录，您可能会在Problem Driver Restriction和Ignition Interlock Device (IID)条件下获得批准。在前往当地机动车办公室申请许可证/执照之前，您可能需要在您拥有或操作的所有车辆上安装并维护Ignition Interlock Device。

有关如何获取点火联锁装置并安装的信息，请访问http://www.criminaljustice.ny.gov/opca/ignition.htm [13]。页面中央有Forms、Regulations/Laws、Manufacturers/Vendors和Interlock Devices选项卡。选择Manufacturers/Vendors选项卡以获取有关制造商和安装商的信息，选择Interlock Devices选项卡以获取可用型号和费用。

在安装点火联锁装置后，您需要携带来自Driver Improvement的批准包中的以下所有物品到任何当地机动车办公室申请许可证/执照：

- 批准通知
- 驾驶执照或非驾驶员ID卡申请表（表格MV-44）
- 已填写的Department of Motor Vehicles Ordered Interlock Device Installation Confirmation
- 姓名和出生日期证明
- 社会保障卡

问题驾驶员限制和点火联锁装置是根据《机动车管理局专员条例》第3.2(4)(c)条的授权而要求的。您需要在自己拥有或操作的所有机动车上安装并维护点火联锁装置，为期五年。在重新获得驾照后，除就业时间内且仅当您的职业要求操作机动车时，您不得驾驶任何未安装联锁装置的车辆。您的雇主必须提供一份签署的公司信笺文件，说明他们知晓点火联锁限制。该信函还必须允许您在没有该装置的情况下为商业目的操作车辆。在操作雇主的车辆时，您必须随身携带此文件。

具有A2问题驾驶员限制的驾驶员只能在以下限制下操作车辆：

- 往返于工作或教育场所；在工作或教育期间，如有需要。如果您因工作而驾驶，您的雇主必须提供一份签署的公司信笺文件，说明他们知晓点火联锁限制。该信函还必须允许您在没有该装置的情况下为商业目的操作车辆。在操作雇主的车辆时，您必须随身携带此文件。
- 往返于为您或您的家庭成员进行必要医疗治疗的医疗预约。您可能需要提供持照医疗从业者的书面声明，以验证此类出行。
- 往返于DMV办公室，以修改带有问题驾驶员限制的驾驶执照。
- 往返于一个地方，包括学校，孩子定期在那里得到照顾，并且这对于持有人维持其就业是必要的。
- 在认可的学校、学院或大学或州批准的职业技术培训机构注册。

这些限制将从文件签发之日起持续五年。如果您有任何违规/定罪，批准可能会被撤销，并且可能不会对您恢复纽约州驾驶执照的任何未来请求给予有利考虑。

如果您由其他州颁发驾照，并且您获得恢复纽约州驾驶特权的批准，如果您持有有效的州外驾驶执照，您可以恢复在纽约州的驾驶。

注意：无论您是申请纽约州驾驶执照还是驾驶特权，任何额外的移动违规或其他事件添加到您的驾驶记录中，都可能使您不符合批准条件或可能延迟批准过程。

- 1. 驾驶特权是指州外驾驶员被允许在纽约州驾驶机动车。驾驶特权可能因与纽约州驾驶执照相同的原因而被暂停或撤销，并承担与无照或吊销驾照驾驶相同的处罚。

- 2. 您需要通过邮件请求批准。

- 3.

# 销售税信息

销售税支付或销售税豁免证明，或购买价格

当您在纽约（在DMV办公室）注册车辆时，您必须

- 支付销售税

- 证明销售税已支付

- 证明您的车辆注册免于销售税

您可能还需要在注册时缴纳县使用税。参见估算注册费和税费 [1] 了解县使用税的信息。

即使交易免于销售税，您也必须从DMV获得销售税收据。

以下是具体说明

- 如果纽约州所有权证书上的姓名不会改变，则不需要销售税表格和证明。如果您在购买车辆时 不是纽约州居民，请参见下面的信息。

- 如果您从纽约州汽车经销商或经授权收取纽约州销售税的州外经销商处购买车辆，请携带显示 您已支付纽约州销售税的经销商销售单。同时携带经销商销售单（MV-50）（仅限纽约州经销 商）或填妥的销售税豁免 {销售税表格} (pdf) [2] （纽约州税务和财政局）（DTF-803）（适用 于州外经销商）。如果纽约州销售税已支付给纽约州经销商，DMV在您申请车辆注册时不会收 取销售税，并且DMV不会签发销售税收据。

- 如果您在私人交易中从他人处购买车辆，您（买方）和卖方都必须填写交易声明 {销售税表格} (pdf) [3] （纽约州税务和财政局）（DTF-802）。将表格带到DMV办公室。DMV计算并收取销 售税，并签发销售税收据。

- 如果您租赁车辆，请参见注册租赁车辆 [4]。

- 如果车辆是礼物或从家庭成员处购买，请使用交易声明 {销售税表格} (pdf) [3] （纽约州税务和财政局）（DTF-802）以获得销售税豁免。

- 如果您支付了州外销售税，请出示州外经销商的销售单。销售单必须显示购买价格和支付给经 销商的州外销售税金额。使用在其他州支付的销售税 {销售税表格} (pdf) [5] （纽约州税务和财 政局）（DTF-804）表格来申请您在其他州支付的州和地方销售税的抵免。如果纽约州和其他 州有关于销售税的协议，此过程可以减少您的纽约州销售税金额。并非所有州都与纽约有协议 。参见DTF-804第2页。

- 如果您在购买车辆时不是纽约州居民，请使用销售税豁免 {销售税表格} (pdf) [2] （纽约州税 务和财政局）（DTF-803）表格以获得纽约州销售税的非居民豁免。DTF-803表格定义了“非居 民”和“居民”的术语。

- 如果您是美国武装部队成员且不居住在纽约，您可以推迟缴纳销售税。如果您符合以下条件， 请填写销售税豁免 {销售税表格} (pdf) [2] （纽约州税务和财政局）（DTF-803）表格

- - 您是纽约州居民

- - 您现在是美国武装部队成员

- - 您现在不居住在纽约州或在纽约州没有住所

销售税豁免（DTF-803）表格提供了推迟缴纳销售税的信息和定义。当您离开武装部队或返回纽约 时，您必须缴纳销售税。

我在哪里可以获得更多关于销售税的信息？

欲了解更多信息，请访问纽约州税务和财政局网站 [6]。

# Schedule and take a road test

# Schedule and take a road test [1]

Use the DMV Road test system to schedule confirm, cancel or reschedule a driving skills road test (including CDL and motorcycle) online or by phone.

### If you are under 18

If you are under age 18, you must wait at least 6 months from the date you received your learner permit to schedule your road test.

### Fee

The fee for up to two road tests for a non-commercial license is in your $10.00 driver license application fee.

If you do not pass your first two tests, you must pay another $10.00 fee for up to two more tests. There is no refund if you do not take both tests.

For a road test for a commercial driver license (CDL) the fee for a single test is $40.00. See Get a CDL [2].

### You need

a valid New York State learner permit (see a sample learner permit [3])

an original, unexpired Pre-Licensing Course Certificate (MV-278) or a Student Certificate of Completion (MV-285) 1

at least one unused test available 2

the ZIP Code for the test site - find test locations, directions and ZIP Codes [4]

### Finding a test location and date

You do not need to take your test in the area of the state where you live.

The system offers the earliest available dates and times at sites near the ZIP Code you provide. 3

Tests are almost always on weekdays (only rarely do we offer them on a Saturday)

### Schedule, confirm, cancel or reschedule now

To reschedule your test, you must cancel your appointment before you can search for a new date (you cannot have more than one appointment at a time).

Schedule, cancel or reschedule a road test online [5]

Schedule by phone: 1-518-402-2100

### On your test day

#### Make sure your test was not rescheduled or relocated

Tests can be cancelled/rescheduled or relocated because of bad weather or road construction. Before you leave for your test, check the DMV cancellations, closings and delays [6] webpage or call 1-518-402-2100.

#### Be on time

Try to arrive up to 30 minutes before the time of your test. If you are late, the license examiner may need to reschedule.

#### Bring

your photo learner permit 4

glasses or contacts, if your permit indicates you need corrective lenses

your original Pre-licensing Course Certificate (MV-278) or Student Certificate of Completion (MV-285), copies are not acceptable

if you are under 18, a Certification of Supervised Driving (PDF) [7] (MV-262) completed by your parent or guardian - this must be given to the license examiner each time you take a road test

a driver age 21 or older who has a license valid to operate the test vehicle

a vehicle to drive during the test that has a valid registration and inspection, operates properly and is in clean condition 5

#### For a motorcycle test, you also need

a properly operating, registered and inspected motorcycle 6

a properly operating, registered and inspected motor vehicle and a driver with a valid driver license to transport the license examiner during your road test

* *Print this checklist** [8]

### After you pass your test

- our license examiner will give you an interim license that allows you to drive. Keep the interim license with your photo learner permit
- you will receive your photo driver license in the mail, in about 2 weeks
- if you are under age 18 and have a Class DJ, MJ or DJMJ driver license, you must obey the restrictions for junior drivers (see Graduated Driver License (GDL) Law and restrictions on drivers under age 18 [9])

### If you fail your test

Don't worry. If you fail a non-commercial license road test, your learner permit remains valid until the expiration date. If your learner permit expires before your next road test, you must get a new learner permit. See Get a learner permit [10].

You can schedule another road test, but you must pay additional fees if you failed your first two road tests. You will need to wait at least one day to take the test again.

### How to pay for additional tests

If you fail your road test, you can pay for additional tests online or by phone. To pay, you must

- have a valid learner permit or driver license
- provide your DMV ID Number from your Learner Permit (Client ID Number) and your date of birth
- have no other road tests currently available
- pay the fee with a credit or debit card 7

Pay additional road test fees online [11]

Pay additional fees by phone: 1-518-402-2100

- 1. For information about how to get a Pre-Licensing Course Certificate (MV-278), see Prepare for your road test [12].

- 2. The fee for up to two road tests for a non-commercial license is included in your $10.00 driver license application fee.

- 3. Usually, the earliest date is within three to five weeks, but at peak testing periods during summer and school breaks it may be up to 10 weeks away. There are no waiting lists.

- 4. If you have an interim or temporary learner permit without a photo, you must also show a NY State photo driver license or a NY State non-driver ID Card. Photo documents from other states are not acceptable.

- 5. The vehicle must have functional seat belts, headlights, windshield wipers and other equipment, a front passenger area and seatbelt free of trash, clutter or debris that might stain or damage the license examiner s uniform, and a front passenger door that is able to be opened from the inside of the vehicle

- 6. The motorcycle must not have more than three wheels in contact with the ground

- 7.

The DMV accepts:

- American Express Card
  - Discover Card /Novus
  - MasterCard
  - MasterCard Debit card without personal identification number (PIN)
  - VISA Card
  - Visa Debit Card without personal identification number (PIN)

text:
[分享您的信息 > 任何访问 DMV]
DMV 是否向他人出售驾驶执照和车辆信息？

是的。DMV 通过三种方式有偿提供驾驶执照和车辆注册信息：合同销售（contract sales）、按次搜索（pay-per-search）和柜台服务（over-the-counter）。

信息的人都必须遵守联邦《驾驶员隐私保护法》[1]（DPPA）。国会在经过仔细辩论后制定了 DPPA，讨论为何应允许各州共享 DMV 数据。DPPA 禁止各州向任何不符合 DPPA 所认为的允许用途的人披露驾驶员的个人信息。

DPPA 将个人信息定义为个人的照片、社会安全号码、驾驶员识别号码、姓名、地址、电话号码和 医疗信息。事故、驾驶违规和驾驶员状态的信息不被视为个人信息。

社会安全号码会被出售。

1. 合同销售（Contract Sales）

根据联邦 DPPA 和纽约州法律，DMV

每两年通过公开采购流程出售注册和车辆数据。中标者不得将 DMV 信息用于除与制造商保修、安 全召回或类似重要通知（保障公众安全）相关的任何其他目的。数据可用于统计汇编和分析，但不 得包含任何个人身份信息。

DMV 不允许中标者将数据用于调查、营销或招揽。

DMV 每年从合同销售中收取约 $220 万。

2. 按次搜索（Pay-Per-Search）

为了合法 DPPA 目的访问 DMV 数据，DMV

提供按次搜索服务。根据纽约州法律，任何使用此方法请求访问的人都必须向 DMV 申请并签署协议，明确其在 DPPA 下的允许用途。在申请经过验证和批准后，将为请求者建立搜索 账户。大多数搜索账户持有者是保险公司（必须对驾驶员进行评级和监控，并调查索赔）以及需要 监控员工驾驶记录的雇主。每次搜索费用为 $7，并由 DMV

记录。搜索账户持有者必须对每次搜索都有 DPPA 允许用途，DMV 通过审计计划监控其合规性。

DMV 每年从按次搜索销售中收取约 $5800 万。

3. 柜台服务（Over-the-counter）

任何人都可以访问州或县 DMV

办公室购买驾驶执照记录，只要请求者提供足够且具体的信息以识别唯一一份记录，并提供 DPPA 允许用途。每次柜台搜索费用为 $10。

DMV 每年从柜台销售中收取约 $300 万。

共享 DMV 信息的好处
text:
[分享您的信息 > 共享 DMV 信息的好处]
通过三种共享方式与公交公司、雇主、保险公司、研究人员和汽车制造商共享的 DMV 信息，使我 们的生活更安全、更便捷。如果这些信息不可用，交通安全和商业将受到负面影响。以下提供了一 些 DMV 信息共享计划如何惠及我们所有人的示例。

### 校车司机

学区及私立校车公司在雇用司机接送儿童及其他乘客之前，必须了解司机的驾驶历史。访问DMV信 息使校车公司能够就雇用何人做出明智决定。一旦雇用，DMV要求巴士运营商定期查询其司机记录 ，以确认在其任职期间没有发生任何可能影响其安全驾驶校车能力的负面事件。

### 危险品运输司机

同样的情形也适用于运输危险品的企业。我们所有人都希望运输危险材料的车辆司机具备驾驶资格 、受过适当培训，并持有有效的商业驾驶执照（CDL）。纽约州法律规定，危险品公司只能雇用和 聘用合格且持有有效执照的司机。雇主必须定期从DMV获取其员工的驾驶记录。

### 保险公司

当您在线购买汽车保险时，您期望在几分钟内获得费率报价。保险公司之所以能提供这种便捷服务 ，是因为他们可以直接按次付费访问DMV信息。他们检查您的驾驶历史以立即给出费率报价。如果 公司无法进行这些查询，保险公司将要求您购买自己的驾驶记录并发送给他们，然后才能为您提供 报价。这种做法将使客户更难购买到实惠的费率，并可能增加欺诈性篡改或不可靠驾驶记录的可能 性。

### 汽车制造商

购买二手车并不会自动在制造商处将您登记为该车的车主。制造商依赖DMV的合同销售计划来查找 并通知受安全召回影响的车辆的当前车主。召回不仅危及受影响车辆车主/驾驶者的安全，还可能影 响与该潜在不安全车辆共享道路的其他所有人的安全。

这些只是DMV信息共享计划如何对改善公共安全和使每个人的生活更加便利至关重要的几个例子。

# 登录 MyDMV

# 登录 MyDMV [1]

为什么我会被重定向到“欢迎来到 MyDMV”页面？

您用于登录的用户名与您的 MyDMV 账户不关联。

要解决此问题：

- 使用此链接清除您在我们系统中的登录信息 [2]。这将阻止您被重定向到“欢迎来到 MyDMV”页面。
- 然后，
  - 如果您之前创建过 MyDMV 账户，请前往使用“忘记用户名”工具获取您所有 NY.gov ID 用户名的列表。如果您有多个电子邮件地址，请务必检查所有地址。使用您为 MyDMV 创建的用户名登录。如果您不记得密码，可以在同一页面上使用“忘记密码”工具。
  - 如果您从未创建过 MyDMV 账户，请使用注册链接。

如果您按照这些说明操作后仍然无法登录 MyDMV，请联系我们 [3]。

我忘记了 NY.gov 用户名和/或密码。我该怎么办？

您可以使用该工具将您的用户名（您的用户名可能是您的电子邮件地址）发送到您的邮箱。您需要输入您的姓名和电子邮件地址。如果您有多个电子邮件地址，请对每个地址使用该工具，以确保您找回用于 MyDMV 的用户名。

您可以使用该工具重置密码。您需要输入您的用户名以及您在创建账户时选择的安全问题和答案（共享机密）。

我可以使用我的 NY.gov 企业或员工账户登录 MyDMV 吗？

不可以。纽约州将您的个人身份与您的政府员工或商业伙伴身份分开。您需要使用与工作不同的用户名创建一个个人账户。

text:
# 被盗及找回车辆

### 被盗车辆

如果您的车辆被盗，请尽快向警方和您的汽车保险公司报案。警方会将信息录入国家和州的汽车盗窃计算机记录中。该盗窃记录会标注在您的车辆所有权证书记录上，以防止有人出售该车辆或申请所有权证书。

#### 如何报告被盗车牌？

请警方为您被盗的车牌填写一份“丢失或被盗机动车物品报告”表格（MV-78B）。该表格与车辆被盗报告不同，且仅可从警方机构获取，DMV不提供。请复印一份MV-78B报告留作记录，并将原件带到DMV办公室以交回您的注册。更多信息，请参见报告或更换丢失或被盗车牌 [1]。

#### 我需要补发（替换）所有权证书吗？

如果您的车辆未被找回，您可能需要使用您的所有权证书将所有权转让给您的保险公司。如果您丢失了所有权证书，您必须申请补发所有权证书。更多信息，请参见更换所有权证书 [2]。

当车辆被盗时签发的补发所有权证书会标注车辆被盗，且该补发证书仅用于保险转让。

如果在您将“仅限保险转让”的所有权证书转让给您的保险公司之前车辆被找回，请确保警方已取消被盗车辆警报。然后将所有权证书连同解释您的车辆已被找回的信函寄至Title Bureau，DMV将签发常规所有权证书。Title Bureau的地址为

Title BureauNYS DMVPO Box 2750Albany, NY 12220-0750

#### 如果我的所有权证书尚未签发怎么办？

如果车辆在您能够以您的名义申请注册和所有权证书之前被盗，您必须首先以您的名义申请所有权证书，以便将所有权转让给您的保险公司。获取保险公司抬头的信函，说明所有权证明仅用于保险转让。将该信函与您的“仅申请所有权证书” [3]（MV-82TON）一同提交。DMV将以您的名义签发纽约州残值证书（MV-907A）。MV-907A是所有权文件，可转让给您的保险公司。请在我们的网站上参见仅申请所有权证书 [4]。

### 找回车辆

如果您的车辆被找回，请确保警方取消被盗车辆警报，以便找回记录会列在您的所有权证书记录上。在确认警报已取消之前，请勿使用车辆或申请车牌/注册。

如果车辆损坏或全损，请联系您的汽车保险公司。在联系您的保险公司并解决此事之前，请勿按以下说明申请车牌/注册。

如果车牌随车辆一起找回，且您已提交MV-78B表格，请将车牌和您的MV-78B副本带到DMV办公室，交回它们并申请新车牌及恢复您的注册。

如果车牌丢失，请携带您的MV-78B表格副本到DMV办公室，申请新车牌并恢复您的注册。

如果在您提交MV-78B表格之前车辆和车牌已被找回，且被盗车辆警报已取消，您的注册仍然有效，您可以继续使用该注册。

# Surrender (return or turn in) your plates to the DMV

### When you need to surrender plate(s)

- Before you end the vehicle's liability insurance coverage. If you do not turn in your plate(s), we will suspend your registration and can suspend your driver license.

 

- If you want to register your vehicle in another state. You must surrender your New York State vehicle plates to the New York DMV.

### How to surrender New York State plates

Note: If you need to surrender plates from another state, you need to surrender them to that state's DMV (not the New York State DMV).

#### By mail

Step 1: Remove plates and stickers

This includes the plate frames and fasteners - we will not accept plates with them attached. Destroy the registration and inspection stickers from your windshield.

Do not give your plates to another person unless that person will surrender the plates for you.

* *Step 2: Complete the PD-7 application**

You must complete the Plate Surrender Application (PDF) [1] (PD-7) for each set of plates you are surrendering.

Step 3: Mail the application with your plates to

NYS DMV6 Empire State PlazaRoom B240Albany, NY 12228

We use the mail postmark date as the date that you surrendered your plates. To be notified by the US Postal Service that we received your plates, send them by registered or certified mail, and request a return receipt. We will mail you your FS-6T receipt.

#### At a DMV Office

Step 1: Remove plates and stickers

This includes the plate frames and fasteners - we will not accept plates with them attached. Destroy the registration and inspection stickers from your windshield.

Do not give your plates to another person unless that person will surrender the plates for you.

Step 2: Complete the PD-7 application

You must complete the Plate Surrender Application (PDF) [1] (PD-7) for each set of plates you are surrendering.

Step 3: Bring the plates and PD-7 to an DMV

Find a DMV office [2] near you.

County motor vehicle offices will charge you a $1 fee to process the surrender. If another person surrenders your plates for you, make sure that the person gives you the FS-6T receipt for your records.

### Refunds

#### Will I receive a refund when I surrender my plates?

It depends. See registrations refunds for surrendered plates [3] for more information.

### Temporary surrender

#### Can I surrender my plates temporarily?

Yes. See special procedures to surrender plates for a season [4] (temporary surrender of plates).

### Motorcycle and trailer plates

#### Do I need to surrender motorcycle plates?

It s not necessary to surrender motorcycle plates, but your motorcycle must be insured if you ride it. 1

#### Do I need to surrender trailer plates?

Even though some trailers are not required to have liability insurance, you must surrender the plate if the trailer does not have a valid registration. 2

### Lost, stolen or destroyed plates

#### Do I need to surrender the registration if the plates are lost, destroyed or stolen?

Yes. You need to report plates that are lost, stolen or destroyed [5] and surrender the registration. In these cases the DMV can issue you a new registration and plates.

- 1. **Motorcycles:** You do not need to surrender motorcycle plates if there is a lapse in the liability insurance coverage. A motorcycle must have liability insurance to be operated.
- 2. **Trailers:** Normally a trailer does not need liability insurance. The DMV will not suspend your driver license or registration if you fail to surrender the plate. The DMV recommends that you surrender any type of vehicle plate when the plate is not used to make sure that the plate is destroyed.

# 放弃IRP注册和车牌

## 放弃IRP注册和车牌 [1]

如果您因不希望续展注册而放弃IRP注册，请将按比例分配的车牌和驾驶室卡寄至以下地址。如果您希望在稍后时间续展且未放弃按比例分配的车牌，您将被收取全年注册费。

## 国际注册局邮政信箱2850 ESP奥尔巴尼，纽约州 12220-0850

## 要放弃IRP注册并从您的车队中删除车辆2

## 客户服务柜台136室斯旺街大楼帝国广场奥尔巴尼，纽约州 12228

## 如何获得我向纽约州支付的IRP注册费的退款？

如果您将按比例分配的车牌交还给纽约州IRB，并且发生以下任何列出的情况，您可能有资格获得您向纽约州支付的IRP注册费的退款

纽约州IRB出现错误，且错误在您的发票上 您为同一车辆或车辆重复支付了按比例分配的注册费 您在转为IRP注册后错误地支付了标准注册续展费 您能提供证明，证明车辆的最后运营日期早于IRP注册的生效日期3

要申请退款，请填写退款申请表（pdf）[3]（MV-215），并将其发送至IRB办公室。DMV必须从退款金额中扣除5.00美元的手续费，且最低退款金额为1.00美元。您只能根据上述条件申请IRP注册费的退款。您无法获得驾驶室卡费、车牌费或IRP临时授权费的退款。

## 如何获得我向其他司法管辖区支付的IRP注册费中的纽约州部分的退款？

## 您只有在以下情况下，才可以申请退还支付给其他司法管辖区的IRP注册费中的纽约州部分费用

## 其他司法管辖区出现错误，且错误在您的发票上 您为同一车辆或车辆重复支付了分摊注册费

IRB必须收到其他司法管辖区的书面证明。证明必须包括车辆的注册重量、分摊里程百分比、支付给纽约州的费用以及申请退款的原因。

如果任何分摊车牌丢失或被盗，请从警察机构获取填写完整的《机动车物品丢失或被盗报告》（MV-78B）表格，并将MV-78B表格与IRP-6表格一起寄送。仅当没有车辆将替换当前车辆时，才交回分摊车牌。 如果任何分摊车牌丢失或被盗，请从警察机构获取填写完整的《机动车物品丢失或被盗报告》（MV-78B）表格，并将MV-78B表格与IRP-6表格一起寄送。仅当没有车辆将替换当前车辆时，才交回分摊车牌。 您必须在收到未使用的驾驶卡、贴纸和分摊车牌后60天内（原始）或注册生效日期后60天内（续期）归还它们

## 通过电话办理：

您不能通过电话交回您的IRP注册。如有疑问，您可以拨打1-518-473-5834联系IRB。

## 通过邮件办理：

您可以通过邮件交回您的IRP注册。请按照本页及附表A和C [2]（IRP-6）上的说明操作。

# 临时上交车辆牌照（季节性存放牌照）

### 临时或季节性上交牌照

您可以在当地的DMV办公室上交您的车辆牌照，之后可以恢复注册。例如，当您冬季将车辆停驶时，可以上交车辆牌照并取消责任保险。

### 在办公室上交

将您的牌照带到当地的DMV办公室，并索取转让收据。不要索取注册费退款收据。

上交前请务必取下牌照框和紧固件。我们不会接受带有牌照框或紧固件的牌照。

### 牌照存放

DMV不存放标准车辆牌照。如果您上交标准牌照，它们将被销毁。您可以在任何处理注册交易的DMV办公室申请恢复注册。DMV办公室将发放一套新的车辆牌照，并可能收取最高$25.00的车辆牌照费。

如果您上交个性化牌照或定制牌照，DMV办公室将存放它们。您必须在您上交个性化牌照或定制牌照的同一DMV办公室申请恢复注册。

### 恢复已上交的牌照

您必须在DMV办公室申请恢复注册并领取车辆牌照。请携带以下物品

- 一份填好的注册或所有权申请表（pdf）[1]（MV-82）
- 您上交车辆牌照时收到的收据（FS-6T）
- 显示当前保险范围的NY State保险ID卡（FS-20）（参见示例[2]）
- 您的身份和出生日期证明
- 用于支付任何费用的支票或现金

请记住，注册到期日与您上交的注册相同。如果您在注册到期前60天内恢复注册，您可以续期注册并支付续期费用。

text:
# 毕业驾照法律及对18岁以下驾驶员的限制

# 毕业驾照法律及对18岁以下驾驶员的限制 [1]

除了适用于所有人的学习者许可证限制 [2] 外，毕业驾照法律还对持有初级学习者许可证或初级驾照（Class DJ、MJ 或 DJMJ）的18岁以下驾驶员施加了限制。这些限制取决于

- 你持有的是初级学习者许可证还是初级驾照
- 你将在纽约州何处以及何时驾驶

如果你不遵守这些限制，你的初级学习者许可证或初级驾照可能会被暂停或吊销60天。

### 你将在哪里驾驶？

你的驾驶特权将取决于你将在以下三个地理区域中的哪一个驾驶

- 纽约州北部（定义为纽约市边界以北的任何县）

 

- 纽约市（定义为五个行政区）

 

- 长岛（包括拿骚县和萨福克县）

### 区域地图

### 初级学习者许可证和初级驾照有什么区别？

- 初级学习者许可证允许年轻驾驶员仅在有人监督的情况下驾驶

 

- 根据你驾驶的区域，初级驾照可能允许年轻驾驶员在特定限制下无人监督驾驶。

### 我可以持初级学习者许可证或初级驾照在纽约州以外驾驶吗？

您可以在纽约州以外的地方驾驶，前提是您持有纽约州的初级学习驾照或初级驾驶执照，并且该州法律允许。您必须遵守该州适用的初级驾照和执照限制。请咨询您将前往的州的警察或机动车管理局。

### 我能否持其他州的学习驾照、初级学习驾照或初级驾驶执照在纽约州驾驶？

如果您未满16岁，即使持有其他州签发的驾照或执照，也不能在纽约州驾驶。

如果您年满16岁或以上，并持有纽约州以外的学习驾照、初级学习驾照或初级驾驶执照，您必须遵守

- 签发您驾照或驾驶执照的州所施加的任何限制，以及

 

- 纽约州一般学习驾照限制 [2]，如果您未满18岁，还需遵守这些页面中解释的区域性初级学习驾照和初级驾驶执照限制

在纽约州驾驶前，请确保您的学习驾照或驾驶执照在您所在州以外有效。

### 如果我未满18岁，能否获得D类或M类驾照？

如果您年满17岁，并且持有初级驾驶执照或有限初级驾驶执照，且已完成州批准的高中或大学驾驶教育课程，您就有资格获得高级驾驶执照（D类或M类）。要将您的初级驾照更换为高级驾照，请携带您的初级驾照和您从教练处获得的学生完成证书（MV-285）前往任何DMV办公室 [3]。您必须交回证书和初级驾照才能获得高级驾照。如果您不将初级驾照更换为高级驾照，您将受到初级驾驶员限制的约束，直到您年满18岁，即使您随身携带完成证书也是如此。您也可以在路考时将证书与初级驾照一起交给考官。当您符合条件时，您将自动获得高级驾照。

# The Impaired Driver Program - Alcohol & Drug Rehabilitation Program

- The Drinking Driver Program (DDP) is now called the Impaired Driver Program (IDP). As this new name is being implemented, you may see the two names interchangeably.

What happens if I am convicted of an alcohol or drug-related violation in New York State?

If you are convicted of an alcohol or drug-related driving violation, your license or privilege to drive in New York State will be revoked or suspended [1]. However, you may be eligible for a conditional license or a conditional driving privilege if you participate in New York State s Impaired Driver Program (IDP) (previously known as Drinking Driving Program (DDP)) or an approved out-of-state program.

Your Order of Suspension or Revocation from the Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) will indicate a nearby state or county motor vehicle office where you may enroll in the Impaired Driver Program and apply for a conditional license/privilege, if applicable.

Your license suspension or revocation officially begins at your hearing or sentencing in court, unless the court gives you a Continuation of Driving Privileges (MV-1192). Your credit for serving the suspension or revocation begins on the effective date of the order. If you receive a continuation, your suspension or revocation will begin 20 days after sentencing

It is a criminal offense to drive a motor vehicle while your license is suspended or revoked. If you are convicted of driving under suspension or revocation, you may be fined and you may be sentenced to jail and/or probation. In addition, the police may impound the vehicle you were driving when arrested.

If you are placed on probation because of this conviction, you also must bring written permission from the sentencing court, or your probation officer, that allows you to apply for a license.

## Driver Responsibility Assessments

If you are convicted of Driving While Intoxicated (DWI), Driving While Ability Impaired (DWAI) or Driving While Ability Impaired by Drugs, or if you are found to have refused to submit to a chemical test, you will be required to pay a driver responsibility assessment each year for the next three years. For more information, see Pay driver responsibility assessment [2].

Participation in the Impaired Driver Program (IDP) will not prevent, reduce, or delay fines, fees, or penalties imposed under the driver responsibility assessment program.

text:
# Tickets received in another state

### What happens if I get a traffic ticket in another state?

#### Moving violations

Your NY State Driver License will be suspended if you fail to answer a ticket for a moving violation in any state except Alaska, California, Michigan, Montana, Oregon or Wisconsin. Your license will remain suspended until you answer the ticket.

Drivers from any state, except those from the six states listed above, will have their driver licenses suspended in their own state for failure to answer a moving violation in New York State.

The New York State DMV does not record out-of-state convictions of moving traffic violations of New York State non-commercial licensed drivers, except for traffic offenses committed in the provinces of Ontario and Quebec in Canada.

#### Alcohol and drug violations

##### If you are 21 or older

If you are 21 years of age or older when you commit an alcohol or drug related driving violation in any other state or the provinces of Ontario and Quebec in Canada and you are convicted of the violation, your New York State driver license will be revoked for at least 90 days. Out-of-state drivers ticketed in New York State should contact the Motor Vehicle Department of their own state or province about the effect of a conviction in New York State.

##### If you are under 21

If you are under the age of 21 when you commit an alcohol or drug related driving violation that occurs out-of-state and you are convicted of the violation, your New York State driver license will be revoked for at least one year. If you have any prior alcohol or drug related driving conviction, your license will be revoked for at least one year or until the age of 21, whichever is longer.

#### Convictions for criminal negligence, homicide or assault

The New York State DMV records the out-of-state convictions of any New York driver for criminal negligence, homicide, or assault, which arise out of the operation of a motor vehicle and which results in death. As a result of any of these convictions, your NY State Driver License will be revoked.

# Tickets received in New York City

DMV s Traffic Violations Bureau (TVB) processes tickets for non-criminal moving traffic violations issued in the five boroughs of New York City. 1 For more information about the TVB, you can read our brochure [1].

### How do I answer a TVB ticket?

You can answer most TVB tickets online [2]. You can either schedule a hearing for the traffic ticket, or you can pay the fine and surcharge with your credit card. For more information, see how to plead to or pay TVB tickets [3].

To answer your ticket by mail, enter your plea on the ticket and include the appropriate fee if pleading guilty.

Mail to

Traffic Violations Plea UnitP.O. Box 2950 - ESPAlbany, NY 12220-0950

To answer your ticket at a TVB office, follow the instructions on the ticket. Be sure to bring proof of identity such as your driver license.

### What happens if I do not answer a TVB traffic ticket?

If you do not answer a traffic ticket on time, your driver license will be suspended. It is a crime to drive with a suspended license. A suspension for the failure to answer a ticket does not indicate that you are guilty of the charge. The suspension only indicates that you failed to answer the ticket. To remove the suspension, you must contact the court to

- answer the ticket
- pay a $70 suspension termination fee

### What happens if I do not respond to my TVB ticket after I receive a suspension notice?

If you continue to ignore the ticket after your license is suspended for failure to answer the ticket, you will automatically be convicted of the charge. This is known as a 'default conviction.' The default conviction is equivalent to a guilty finding. The DMV then suspends your driver license for your failure to pay the fine. To terminate the suspension resulting from the default conviction, you must pay the fine, mandatory surcharge and the suspension termination fees. 2

Note: Some convictions can cause the suspension or the revocation of your driver license. For more information, see Suspensions and Revocations [4] or read the DMV brochure Suppose Your License Were Taken Away [5].

### What happens if I plead guilty to a violation that results in 5 or more points?

If you have 3 or more alcohol-related convictions on your entire driving record, a plea of guilty to a violation that results in 5 or more points may result in the revocation of your license under Part 132 of the Commissioner's Regulations. You may want to consult with an attorney before entering your plea.

- 1. In other parts of New York State, traffic violations are processed in the criminal or traffic court of the city, county, town or village where the alleged offense took place. To answer these types of traffic tickets, contact the court directly.
- 2. A suspension due to a traffic ticket is an '**indefinite**' suspension. An indefinite suspension means your driver license or privilege to drive is taken away until you pay a suspension termination fee of $70 and have valid driver license.

text:
# Top 5 DMV Mistakes and How to Avoid Them

Many DMV customers make easily avoidable mistakes that cause them significant problems, including encounters with law enforcement and impounded vehicles. Because we see customers make these mistakes over and over again, we are issuing this list of the top five DMV mistakes and how to avoid them.

### 1. Forgetting to Update Address

By statute, you must report a change of address to DMV within ten days of moving. That is the case for the address associated with your license, as well as all the addresses associated with each registered vehicle, which may differ.

It is not sufficient to only: write your new address on the back of your old license; tell the United States Postal Service; or inform the police officer writing you a ticket. If you fail to keep your address current, you will miss a suspension order and may be charged with operating an unregistered vehicle and/or aggravated unlicensed operation, both misdemeanors. This really happens, but the good news is this is a problem that is easily avoidable.

Learn more about how to change the address on your license and registrations [1]

### 2. Leaving the State Without Notifying DMV

States communicate with each other, so when you move to another state, be sure to tie up any loose ends regarding your New York State license or registration. That means resolving any unanswered tickets, suspensions or revocations, and surrendering your license plates to NYS when you get to your new home state.

A license suspension or revocation here could mean that your new home state will not issue you a license there. Remember, it is important to notify DMV of your new address so that any possible mail correspondence can reach you. Also, turning in your plates is important to avoid an insurance lapse.

### 3. Letting Insurance Lapse

Because we all pay indirectly for crashes involving uninsured motorists, New York State requires every motorist to maintain auto insurance every single day a vehicle is registered. DMV works with insurance companies to electronically monitor your insurance coverage, and we know when coverage is dropped for any reason. When that happens, we mail you an insurance inquiry letter to allow you to clear up the problem.

We send 500,000 inquiry letters a year. If the inquiry letter does not resolve the problem, we must suspend the vehicle registration and, if it persists, your driver license!We suspend 300,000 registrations a year for failure to maintain insurance. If you fail to maintain an updated address with us, you won t learn that you have an insurance problem, and we will suspend your registration and license. Make sure you turn in your vehicle s license plates at DMV before you cancel your insurance policy. Insurance policies must be from a company licensed in New York State.

Learn more about Insurances Lapes [2] and How to Surrender your Plates [3]

### 4. Understanding how Much Traffic Points Cost

DMV maintains a point system to track dangerous drivers. Often, motorists convicted of a traffic ticket feel they have resolved all their motoring issues with the local court, but later learn that the Driver Responsibility Assessment (DRA) is a separate DMV charge based on the total points they accumulate.

The $300 DRA fee can be paid in $100 annual installments over three years. Motorists who fail to maintain an updated address with DMV may resolve their tickets with the court, but never receive their DRA assessment because we do not have their new address on record. Failure to pay the DRA will result in a suspended license.

Learn more about About the NYS Driver Point System [4] and how to Pay Driver Responsibility Assessment [5]

### 5. Not Bringing Proper Documentation to DMV Office

About ten percent of customers visiting a DMV office do not bring what they need to complete their transaction, and have to come back a second time to finish their business. This can be as simple as not bringing sufficient funds to pay for a license renewal or not having the proof of auto insurance required to register a car. Better yet, don t visit a DMV office at all, and see if your transaction can be performed online, like an address change, registration renewal, license renewal, replacing a lost title, paying a DRA or scheduling a road test.

Our award-winning website is recognized as one of the best in the nation. It has all the answers you need to efficiently perform any DMV transaction. Consider signing up for our MyDMV service, which offers even more benefits.

Sign up or log into MyDMV [6]

## What To Do If You Receive A Traffic Ticket

## INTRODUCTION

## If you are issued a ticket for a non-criminal moving traffic violation in the five boroughs of New

York City, it will be handled by a New York State Department of Motor Vehicles (DMV) Traffic Violations Bureau (TVB). This allows courts in these areas to concentrate on criminal cases, including driving offenses, such as driving while intoxicated and driving while suspended or revoked (aggravated unlicensed operation). However, TVBs do not handle parking violations.

If you plead not guilty to a traffic ticket in one of these TVB areas, your case will be heard by a DMV Administrative Law Judge (ALJ), an experienced attorney with special training in the Vehicle

## and Traffic Law. An ALJ has the authority to decide whether or not you are guilty and to set a fine if

you are found guilty. An ALJ also has the authority to revoke or suspend your driver license and/or auto registration when required by law or when the ALJ believes it is in the interest of traffic safety.

Just as in traffic courts in other areas of the state, you may present witnesses and evidence ata hearing before an ALJ and be represented by an attorney.

## IF YOU ARE ISSUED A TICKET

Follow the instructions on the ticket for the plea you wish to make, and act promptly.

If you don't answer the ticket in the time allowed, your driver license will be suspended. Later, you could be found guilty of the charge because of your failure to respond (a default conviction). Your license would be suspended for not paying the fine and a judgment would be entered against you.

Driving with a suspended license is a crime. A felony conviction may result in fines of up to $5,000, jail, probation, or confiscation of your vehicle. As the number of suspensions you have increases, the penalties also increase. A driver is suspended for ticket not answered and fine not paid.

To Plead Not Guilty - Use the Traffic Ticket Pleas, Hearings and Payments online transaction [1] or read the “not guilty" instructions and check the “not guilty” box on the back of the ticket. Fill in the requested information, sign it, and mail the ticket to the Albany address listed. DMV will send

## you a letter telling you when and where to go for your hearing. If you are hearing impaired and

require an interpreter, include a request for one when you mail your not guilty plea. An interpreter will be assigned to your hearing at no charge to you.

## ATTEND YOUR HEARING

Hearings are open to the public. You may go to any TVB office to watch hearings so you know what to expect at yours.

To Plead Guilty - Use the Traffic Ticket Pleas, Hearings and Payments online transaction [1] or read the instructions and check the "guilty" box on the back of the ticket. Fill in the requested information, sign it and, , either mail it with your payment to the Albany address listed on the ticket or bring your payment to any TVB office. You may pay the fine and surcharge by Visa or Mastercard, or by a check or money order payable to the Commissioner of Motor Vehicles. Include the total fines and surcharges listed on the ticket for your violation(s).

You may not plead guilty by mail if the charge against you will result in license or registration suspension or revocation upon conviction (such as driving without insurance or a third speeding violation within 18 months). If you plead guilty to such a charge by mail, you will be notified that you must go to the TVB to answer the charge in person.

You are considered innocent of the charge against you unless you are proven guilty at your hearing. You cannot be found guilty unless there is "clear and convincing evidence" that you committed the violation.

If you find it hard to understand English, you may bring someone to help you. Tell the ALJ, before the hearing starts, that someone who speaks your native language and English is there to interpret.

The ALJ will listen to sworn testimony from the police officer, who will explain why you were given the ticket. Then, you or your attorney may ask the officer questions. You also may bring witnesses to testify for you and written evidence. The judge may ask witnesses questions to better understand their testimony.

You do not have to testify but you may if you wish. You cannot be found guilty just because you do not testify.

When all of the evidence and testimony have been given, the ALJ will decide whether or not you are guilty. That decision will be based only on the evidence and testimony presented at the hearing and what the law states. If the ALJ decides the charge against you was not proven by clear and convincing evidence, you will be found not guilty. If the charge is proven and you are found guilty, the judge will set a fine. Your license or registration also may be suspended or revoked, depending on the violation and your overall driving record.

## APPEALS

If you believe the ALJ's decision was incorrect based on the facts and the law, you may file an appeal. You can determine if you can file an appeal online [2] or download Traffic Violations Bureau Appeal form [3] (AA-33) from the DMV web site. The appeal form is also available at TVB offices. Read the instructions carefully. If you wish, your attorney may help you file the appeal. Remember to include a payment for the appeal fees.
