# 住院时间增加的伤残评级 | Veterans Affairs

# 住院时间增加的伤残评级

你是否曾在VA医院或VA批准的医院因与兵役相关的伤残（称为service-connected disability）住院？如果是，你可能可以获得额外的伤残补偿或福利，在住院期间获得temporary 100% disability rating。了解你是否能获得此福利。

### 我能从VA获得伤残福利吗？

如果以下情况之一描述了你的经历，你可能可以获得伤残福利。

以下情况之一必须属实：

- 你因service-connected disability在VA医院或其他批准的医院住院超过21天，或
- 你因service-connected disability在我们承担费用的情况下接受医院观察超过21天

### 谁符合条件？

Veterans

## 我能获得什么样的伤残福利？

- Health care
- 住院期间的increased compensation（付款）

## 如何获得这些福利？

你需要提交伤残补偿申请。了解如何提交伤残补偿申请

注意：如果你不在VA医院，提交申请时需提供医院出院摘要，显示住院时长和原因。

示例：一位因糖尿病获得40% service-connected disability rating的Veteran，在糖尿病昏迷后不得不住进VA医院。由于昏迷及相关感染，他需要住院25天。我们在其住院期间将其评级提高至100%。出院后，其伤残评级恢复为40%。

# Insurance claims | Veterans Affairs

# Insurance claims

If you disagree with a VA decision on an insurance claim, you can choose one of the following review options to continue your case. If you aren t satisfied with that review, you can try another option.

#### Mark your calendar

You have 1 year from the date on your decision to request a decision review.

## Decision review options

### Add new and relevant evidence

Download VA Form 20-0995: Supplemental Claim (PDF)

When you choose to file a Supplemental Claim, you re adding new evidence that supports your case or identifying evidence for review. A reviewer will determine whether the new evidence changes the decision. Learn how to file a Supplemental Claim

You must add evidence that VA didn t have before that supports your case.

4-5 months VA s goal for completing Supplemental Claims is 125 days.

### Ask for a new look from a senior reviewer

Download VA Form 20-0996: Higher-Level Review (PDF)

When you choose to request a Higher-Level Review, you re asking for another review of the same evidence. A senior reviewer will take another look at your case and determine whether the decision can be changed based on a difference of opinion or an error. Learn how to request a Higher-Level Review

You can t submit any evidence.

You and/or your representative can speak with the reviewer on the phone. You can tell them why you think the decision should be changed and identify errors.

4-5 months VA s goal for completing Higher-Level Reviews is 125 days. A review may take longer if VA needs to get records or schedule a new exam to correct an error.

#### Can I request a Higher-Level Review?

You can request a Higher-Level Review of an initial claim or Supplemental Claim decision. This option isn t available after a Higher-Level Review or Board decision.

### Appeal to a Veterans Law Judge

Download VA Form 10182: Board Appeal (PDF)

A judge at the Board of Veterans Appeals in Washington, D.C., will review your case. Learn more about how to request a Board Appeal

About 1 year The Board s goal for deciding appeals with no new evidence and no hearing is about a year.

You have the option to add new evidence that will be reviewed by a judge.

You have the option to request a hearing with a judge. A video conference hearing will take place at a VA location near you.

Longer The Board will take longer to decide your appeal if you add new evidence or request a hearing.

#### Can I request a Board Appeal?

You can request a Board Appeal after an initial claim, Supplemental Claim, or Higher-Level Review decision. You can t request two Board Appeals in a row.

## Bring an action in district court

You also have the option to bring an action in a United States district court. You have 6 years to bring such an action after accrual of the right for which the claim is made. You may want to speak with an attorney about this option.

## After a Board decision

If you disagree with the Board s decision and have new and relevant evidence that supports your case, you can file a Supplemental Claim. You can also appeal to the U.S. Court of Appeals for Veterans Claims. Learn more about your options after a Board decision

## What happens next?

Find out what happens after you request a decision review

You don t need to do anything while you wait unless VA sends you a letter asking for more information. If VA schedules exams for you, be sure not to miss them.

Track the status of your appeal

## What if I need help?

A Veterans Service Organization or VA-accredited attorney or agent can help you request a decision review. Get help requesting a decision review

## What if I have more questions?

Get answers to frequently asked questions about decision reviews. Go to FAQs

# 电离辐射暴露 | Veterans Affairs

## 电离辐射暴露

了解您是否有资格获得因军事服役期间接触辐射而引发的疾病（包括某些癌症）的残疾补偿或福利 。

我能从 VA 获得残疾福利吗？

如果您没有不名誉退伍，并且满足以下列出的要求，您可能可以获得残疾福利。

以下两点必须同时满足：

- 您患有我们列出的被认为由辐射引起的疾病，或医生认为可能由辐射引起的疾病，并且

- 您的疾病在特定时间内开始（如疾病列表所示）

查看与辐射相关的疾病列表

并且您在军队服役期间必须以下列方式之一接触过电离辐射。您：

- 参与了大气层核武器试验，或

- 在广岛或长崎战后占领期间服役，或

- 曾是日本的战俘（POW），或

- 担任X光技师、在反应堆工厂工作，或从事核医学或放射摄影工作（在现役期间或在预备役训 练期间），或

- 执行了类似于能源部（DOE）员工的任务，使其成为特殊暴露队列（Special Exposure Cohort）成员（参见 42 U.S.C. 7384L(14)）

如果您曾在以下至少一个地点和身份服役，您也可能有资格获得残疾福利。您：

- 参与了阿拉斯加阿姆奇特卡岛的地下核武器试验，或

- 被分配到肯塔基州帕迪尤卡的气体扩散工厂，或

- 被分配到俄亥俄州朴茨茅斯的气体扩散工厂，或

- 被分配到田纳西州橡树岭K-25区域的气体扩散工厂

谁有资格？

退伍军人

我能获得哪些残疾福利？

- 医疗保健

- 补偿（付款）

如何获得这些福利？

您需要提交残疾补偿申请，并提供以下列出的证据（支持文件）：

- 医疗记录，显示您已被诊断患有我们列表中认为由辐射引起的疾病之一，或者您的医生声明这 些疾病可能是由辐射暴露引起的，以及

- 服役记录，显示您参与了上述描述的辐射风险活动之一

注意：当您提交索赔时，我们会要求您服役的军种（或国防威胁降低局）提供他们认为您可能接触 到的辐射剂量范围。我们将使用他们报告的最高水平来决定您的福利。

了解如何提交伤残补偿索赔

# Military Sexual Trauma (MST) | Veterans Affairs

# Military sexual trauma (MST)

Military sexual trauma (MST) refers to sexual assault or repeated, threatening sexual harassment that happened while a Veteran was in the military. This can happen to both women and men. If you were involved in any sexual act against your will during your time in the military, you may have experienced MST. Find out how to access our free services that can help you recover.

### How do I talk to someone right now?

Find out how to get support anytime day or night.

If you're a Veteran in crisis or concerned about one, connect with our caring, qualified Veterans Crisis Line responders for confidential help. Many of them are Veterans themselves. This service is private, free, and available 24/7.

To connect with a Veterans Crisis Line responder anytime day or night:

- Call 800-273-8255, then select 1.
- Start a confidential Veterans chat.
- Text 838255.
- If you have hearing loss, call TTY: 800-799-4889.

You can also:

- Call 911.
- Go to the nearest emergency room.
- Go directly to your nearest VA medical center. It doesn't matter what your discharge status is or if you're enrolled in VA health care.Find your nearest VA medical center

### What services does VA provide for Veterans who ve experienced MST?

We provide free, confidential (private) counseling and treatment to male and female Veterans for both mental and physical health problems linked to MST.

Our services include:

- MST-related treatment and support at every VA medical center, and providers knowledgeable about treating the aftereffects of MST at each facility
- Specialized outpatient mental health services focused on sexual trauma at many VA locations
- Counseling with professionals who are specially trained to treat conditions related to sexual trauma at Vet Centers across the country
- Specialized MST treatment in a residential (live-in) or inpatient setting including gender-specific programs for Veterans who need more intensive care
- Treatment and support for health conditions linked to MST, like:
  - Posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD)
  - Depression
  - Substance use problems

## How do I access VA services for MST?

If you re a Veteran who has experienced MST, you can get help through VA. You don t need to have a service-connected disability rating, and you may be able to get MST-related care even if you don t qualify for other VA services. You also don t need to have reported the MST or have other proof that it happened.

Here s how to access VA services for MST:

- If you have a VA primary care provider, talk to that professional about what you ve been through. All our primary care providers are trained in MST and can help you figure out if you have related issues, like PTSD or depression. Your provider will offer treatment and support as needed.
- If you don t have a VA primary care provider, call your nearest VA medical center and ask to speak to the MST coordinator. You should feel free to ask for a provider of a specific gender if that makes you feel more comfortable.Find a VA medical center near you
- If you d prefer to receive MST-related care outside of a medical setting, get free confidential counseling, alcohol and drug assessment, and other support at one of our 300 community Vet Centers.Find a Vet Center near you
- If you re homeless or at risk of becoming homeless:
  - Contact the National Call Center for Homeless Veterans at 877-424-3838 for help 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. A trained VA counselor will offer information about VA homeless programs, health care, and other services in your area. The call is free and confidential.
  - Visit our website to learn about VA programs for Veterans who are homeless.Learn about our homelessness programs
  - Call or visit your local VA Community Resource and Referral Center. Even if you don t qualify for VA health care, our staff can help you find non-VA resources you may qualify for in your community.Find your local Community Resource and Referral Center

You can also call the VA general information hotline at 800-827-1000, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 9:00 p.m. ET.

See our Guide to VA Mental Health Services (PDF)

## Can I get disability compensation (monthly payments) or other benefits from VA?

You can t get compensation for the traumatic event itself. But you may be able to get disability compensation for conditions resulting from MST like PTSD (the most common mental health condition linked to MST).Find out if you can get disability benefits for PTSD

Or get help applying for disability compensation by:

- Reading our fact sheet on disability compensation for conditions related to MST.Read the fact sheet (PDF)
- Talking to the MST coordinator at your nearest VA regional office.Find an MST coordinator near you

## Where can I find more information and support?

- Download our military sexual trauma brochure for Veterans:
  - In English (PDF)
  - En espa ol (PDF)
- Download our educational brochure for men who ve experienced MST:
  - In English (PDF)
  - En espa ol (PDF)
- Watch a video about MST, its effects on survivors, and VA services available to Veterans who ve experienced MST.Watch the video
- Access more fact sheets, articles, and resources, and learn more about our programs and services.Get VA information about mental health
- Go to our Make the Connection website to hear stories from Veterans about their own experiences with the effects of MST, and find more resources and support.Visit Make the Connection
- Go to the Department of Defense (DoD) Safe Helpline website, a crisis support service for members of the DOD community affected by sexual assault. When you contact the Safe Helpline, you can remain anonymous (meaning you don t have to give your name). You can get 1-on-1 advice, support, and information 24/7 by phone, text, or online chat. You can also connect with a sexual assault response coordinator near your base or installation.Visit SafeHelpline.org

Am I eligible for education benefits through the MGIB-AD program?
text:
[Montgomery GI Bill Active Duty (MGIB-AD) > Am I eligible for education benefits through the MGIB-AD program?]
The Montgomery GI Bill Active Duty (MGIB-AD) can help you pay for education and training programs. If you ve served at least 2 years on active duty, find out if you qualify for the MGIB-AD program.

You can get education benefits through this program if you were honorably discharged and you meet the requirements of one of the categories below.

### One of these categories must describe you

#### Category I

All of these are true. You:

- Have a high school diploma, GED, or 12 hours of college credit, and
- Entered active duty for the first time after June 30, 1985, and
- Had your military pay reduced by $100 a month for the first 12 months of service

And at least one of these is true. You served continuously (without a break) for:

- 3 years, or
- 2 years if that was your agreement when you enlisted, or
- 4 years if you entered the Selected Reserve within a year of leaving active duty (called the 2 by 4 program)

#### Category II

All of these are true. You:

- Have a high school diploma, GED, or 12 hours of college credit, and
- Entered active duty before January 1, 1977 (or before January 2, 1978, under a delayed enlistment program contracted before January 1, 1977), and
- Served at least 1 day between October 19, 1984, and June 30, 1985, and stayed on active duty through June 30, 1988 (or through June 30, 1987, if you entered the Selected Reserve within 1 year of leaving active duty and served 4 years), and
- Had at least 1 day of entitlement left under the Vietnam Era GI Bill (Chapter 34) as of December 31, 1989

#### Category III

All of these are true. You:

- Have a high school diploma, GED, or 12 hours of college credit, and
- Don t qualify for MGIB under categories I or II, and
- Had your military pay reduced by $1,200 before separation

And one of these is true. You:

- Were on active duty on September 30, 1990, and involuntarily separated (not by your choice) after February 2, 1991, or
- Involuntarily separated on or after November 30, 1993, or
- Chose to voluntarily separate under either the Voluntary Separation Incentive (VSI) program or the Special Separation Benefit (SSB) program

#### Category IV

Both of these are true. You:

- Have a high school diploma, GED, or 12 hours of college credit, and
- Had military pay reduced by $100 a month for 12 months or made a $1,200 lump-sum contribution (meaning you paid it all at once)

And one of these is true. You:

- Were on active duty on October 9, 1996, had money left in a VEAP account on that date, and chose MGIB before October 9, 1997, or
- Entered full-time National Guard duty under title 32, USC, between July 1, 1985, and November 28, 1989, and chose MGIB between October 9, 1996, and July 9, 1997

text:
[Montgomery GI Bill Active Duty (MGIB-AD) > What benefits can I get?]
You may get up to 36 months of education benefits. We ll pay the benefits monthly. The amount you ll receive depends on these factors:

- Your length of service, and
- The type of educational or training program you choose, and
- Your category (as defined above), and
- Whether you qualify for a college fund or kicker, and
- How much you ve paid into the $600 Buy-Up program Learn more about the $600 Buy-Up program

Note: You usually have 10 years to use your MGIB-AD benefits. This may change depending on your situation.

text:
[Montgomery GI Bill Active Duty (MGIB-AD) > How do I get these benefits?]
Follow the steps below to apply for these benefits.

1.  ### Make sure we've approved your program

Before you enroll, contact the school or use the GI Bill Comparison Tool to find out if we ve approved your program for VA educational benefits. If you have questions, call us at 888-GIBILL-1 (888-442-4551). We're here Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. ET. If you have hearing loss, call TTY: 711. Or submit a question through the GI Bill website.Use the GI Bill Comparison ToolAsk a question online

Note: If you want to enroll in a program that we haven t approved, you ll need to ask the school to request approval. We can t take any action until an official from your school (not you) requests approval. If we don t approve your program, you ll have to pay all costs at the school, including tuition and fees.

2.  ### Apply for benefits

You can submit your Application for VA Benefits (VA Form 22-1990) online. Apply online now

You can also apply by mail, in person, or with the help of a trained professional.Learn more about other ways to apply

3.  ### Ask your school or training program to certify your enrollment

The certifying official may be someone in your school's financial aid, Veterans affairs, registrar, admissions, or counseling office. For on-the-job training or an apprenticeship, the official may be someone in your school's training, finance, or human resources office.

Note: You'll then need to verify your enrollment at the end of each month to keep receiving payments. You can verify your enrollment online through our Web Automated Verification system (called "WAVE") or by phone by calling 877-823-2378. Verify your enrollment online

[Montgomery GI Bill Active Duty (MGIB-AD) > Can I qualify for more than one VA education benefit?]

# Multiple party or contested claims | Veterans Affairs

## Multiple party or contested claims

If you re one of multiple people claiming the right to the same benefit, you have 60 days to appeal to a Veterans Law Judge at the Board of Veterans Appeals in Washington, D.C. A judge who s an expert in Veterans law will review your case.

## Mark your calendar

You have 60 days from the date on your decision to request a Board Appeal.

## Can I add new evidence?

You have the option to add new evidence for a judge to review. You ll have to submit this evidence within 90 days from the date VA receives your Board Appeal form.

This option will take longer.

## Can I request a hearing?

You have the option to request a hearing with a judge. A video conference hearing will take place at a VA location near you.

This option will take longer.

## What happens at a hearing?

You and the judge will have a conversation. The judge will listen to your testimony. The judge may ask you a few questions. Your representative, if you have one, may help you at the hearing.

The hearing will be transcribed and added to your appeal file. You can add new and relevant evidence within 90 days after the hearing, but it isn t required.

## How do I request a Board Appeal?

To request a Board Appeal, fill out the Decision Review Request: Board Appeal (VA Form 10182). Download VA Form 10182 (PDF)

### Choose one of the 3 options to appeal with a Veterans Law Judge

Direct Review If you want a Veterans Law Judge to review your case as quickly as possible, choose a Direct Review.

You can t submit any evidence.

About 1 year The Board s goal for deciding appeals with no new evidence and no hearing is about a year.

Evidence Submission If you have additional evidence for a Veterans Law Judge to review, choose Evidence Submission.

You must submit evidence within 90 days of the date VA receives your Board Appeal form.

Longer If you add new evidence, it ll take longer than the Direct Review appeal option.

Hearing Request If you want a video conference hearing with a Veterans Law Judge at a nearby VA location, choose a Hearing Request.

At your hearing, you and a Veterans Law Judge will have a conversation, and they ll ask you questions about your appeal. Your hearing will be transcribed and added to your appeal file. Learn more about hearings and how to request one

You can add new and relevant evidence within 90 days after the hearing, but it isn t required.

Longer If you request a hearing, it ll take longer than the Direct Review appeal option.

### List the issue(s) you want to appeal in Part III

You can include all or just some of the issues VA has decided. You ll need to list the issue(s) you disagree with and the VA decision date for each.

### Apply

## Fill out the Decision Review Request: Board Appeal (VA Form 10182). Download VA Form 10182 (PDF)

## By mail

## Send the completed form and any supporting documents to this address:

## Board of Veterans Appeals PO Box 27063 Washington, D.C. 20038

## In person

## Bring your completed form to a regional benefit office. Find a regional benefit office near you

## By fax

Fax your completed form to 844-678-8979.

You can also ask a regional benefit office for a copy of this form to fill out. Or you can call the VA toll-free hotline at 800-827-1000, Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. - 9:00 p.m. ET, to request a form.

## After a Board decision

If you disagree with the Board s decision, you can appeal to the U.S. Court of Appeals for Veterans Claims. You can hire an attorney to represent you, or you can represent yourself. Learn more about filing a Court Appeal

## Mark your calendar

You have 120 days from the date on your decision to file a Court Appeal. Note: A Court Appeal must be filed with the Court, not with VA.

## What happens next?

## Find out what happens after you request a decision review

You don t need to do anything while you wait unless VA sends you a letter asking for more information. If VA schedules exams for you, be sure not to miss them.

## Track the status of your appeal

## What if I need help?

A Veterans Service Organization or VA-accredited attorney or agent can help you request a decision review. Get help requesting a decision review

## What if I have more questions?

## Get answers to frequently asked questions about decision reviews. Go to FAQs

# 芥子气或路易氏剂暴露 | 退伍军人事务部

## 芥子气或路易氏剂暴露

如果您曾接触过芥子气（也称为硫芥子气、伊珀里特或氮芥子气）或路易氏剂（一种含有砷毒物的 天然化合物），您可能患有某些相关的长期疾病。了解您是否有资格获得残疾补偿或福利。

我能从退伍军人事务部获得残疾福利吗？

如果您患有被认为是由接触芥子气或路易氏剂引起的残疾，并且您的军事记录显示您曾接触过芥子 气或路易氏剂，您可能可以获得残疾福利。

如果您曾在陆军服役并在以下地点服役：

- 意大利巴里

- 佛罗里达州布什内尔

- 北卡罗来纳州勒琼营

- 阿拉巴马州西伯特营

- 犹他州达格韦试验场

- 马里兰州埃奇伍德兵工厂

- 华盛顿特区海军研究实验室

- 印度翁达尔

- 科罗拉多州落基山兵工厂

- 巴拿马运河区圣何塞岛

如果您曾在海军服役并在以下地点服役：

- 意大利巴里

- 北卡罗来纳州勒琼营

- 南卡罗来纳州查尔斯顿

- 伊利诺伊州大湖海军训练中心

- 纽约州哈特岛

- 马里兰州班布里奇海军训练中心

- 弗吉尼亚州海军研究实验室

- 华盛顿特区海军研究实验室

- 美国海军鹰艇58号

一些曾参与以下地点测试的服役人员：

- 新几内亚芬什港

- 英格兰波顿当

部分商船海员也在意大利巴里暴露于这些物质。

谁受保障？

退伍军人

我能获得哪种残疾福利？

- 医疗保健

- 补偿（付款）

## 我如何获得这些福利？

您需要提交残疾补偿申请。

您必须申报实际的疾病或残疾。仅说明您在服役期间接触过芥子气或路易氏剂是不够的。您需要根 据据信因接触这些化学物质之一而导致的疾病来申请。提交申请时，请务必提供任何显示您接触过 起疱剂的军事记录。

了解如何提交残疾补偿申请

## 如果我需要帮助提交残疾申请怎么办？

如果您对与芥子气暴露相关的福利有疑问，您可以通过电子邮件联系我们。

发送电子邮件至 mustardgas@vba.va.gov

您也可以从受过培训、可信赖的专业人士那里获得帮助，他们可以协助处理与VA相关的申请。

获取提交申请的帮助

如果我自愿参加涉及化学和生物测试的研究，我能获得福利吗？

多达60,000名退伍军人自愿参加了美国生物和化学项目的医学研究。如果您参与了这项研究，如果 您满足以下两项要求，您可以通过美国陆军获得医疗护理。

以下两项必须均为真实情况。您：

- 在1942年至1975年间自愿参加涉及化学和生物测试的研究，并且

- 有直接由参与这些测试造成的伤害或疾病

如果您有疑问或需要获得医疗护理的帮助：

- 访问美国陆军网页，或

- 致电800-984-8523

# 国家召唤服役计划 | 退伍军人事务部

# 国家召唤服役计划

如果您完成了一段国家服役期，您可能有资格参加国家召唤服役计划，该计划允许您选择一项教育福利，作为蒙哥马利军人法案（MGIB）的替代方案。了解您是否符合资格。

### 我是否有资格享受此福利？

如果您满足以下列出的要求，您就有资格参加国家召唤服役计划。

以下两项必须均为属实：

- 您完成了初始入伍训练，随后在国防部长指定的军事职业专业中继续服役15个月，并且

- 然后，在没有服役中断的情况下，您要么按照国防部长的决定再服役一段额外的现役期，要么在选定的预备役部队中保持现役状态24个月

以下其中一项必须属实：

在没有服役中断的情况下，您随后完成了剩余的服役义务：

- 在武装部队中服现役，或
- 在选定预备役部队中服役，或
- 在个人待命预备役中服役，或
- 在美国志愿队或国防部长联合指定的其他国内国家服务计划中服务

### 谁受保障？

退伍军人

## 我可以获得哪些福利？

您可以选择以下其中一项：

- 5,000美元的现金奖励，或
- 偿还符合条件的学贷，金额不超过18,000美元，或
- 相当于3年期月度MGIB标准12个月的教育援助，或
- 相当于不足3年期月度MGIB标准50%的36个月教育援助

## 如何获得这些福利？

立即在线申请

如果您根据国家征召服役计划入伍，除非您日后重新入伍并额外服役一段时间，否则您不符合《蒙哥马利军人法案》（MGIB）的资格。请联系您的招募人员，了解您是否符合资格并注册国家征召服役计划。此福利会影响您的服役合同。

heading_path: Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33)
Am I eligible for Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) benefits?
text:
[Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) > Am I eligible for Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) benefits?]
The Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) helps you pay for school or job training. If you ve served on active duty after September 10, 2001, you may qualify for the Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33). Find out if you can get this education benefit.

You can get these education benefits if you meet at least one of the requirements listed below.

At least one of these must be true. You:

- Served at least 90 days on active duty (either all at once or with breaks in service) on or after September 11, 2001, or
- Received a Purple Heart on or after September 11, 2001, and were honorably discharged after any amount of service, or
- Served for at least 30 continuous days (all at once, without a break in service) on or after September 11, 2001, and were honorably discharged with a service-connected disability, or
- Are a dependent child using benefits transferred by a qualifying Veteran or service member

Note: If you re a member of the Reserves who lost education benefits when the Reserve Educational Assistance Program (REAP) ended in November 2015, you may qualify to receive restored benefits under the Post-9/11 GI Bill.

chunk_id: Post-9/11 GI Bill | Veterans Affairs#1_0::c0003

heading_path: Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33)
What benefits can I get through the Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33)?
text:
[Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) > What benefits can I get through the Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33)?]
You can receive up to 36 months of benefits, including:

- Tuition and fees. If you qualify for the maximum benefit, we ll cover the full cost of public, in-state tuition and fees. We cap the rates for private and foreign schools, and update those rates each year. View current rates
- Money for housing (if you re in school more than half time). We ll base your monthly housing allowance on the cost of living where your school is located.
- Money for books and supplies. You can receive up to $1,000 per school year.
- Money to help you move from a rural area to go to school. You may qualify for this one-time payment of $500 if you live in a county with 6 or fewer people per square mile and you re either moving at least 500 miles to go to school or have no other option but to fly by plane to get to your school.

Here s how we ll determine how much of the benefit you ll qualify for:

The specific amount you ll receive will depend on how much active service you ve had since September 10, 2001. We ll calculate this amount based on a percentage of the maximum benefit.

For example: If you had 90 days of active service since September 10, 2001, you would qualify for 40% of the maximum amount. If you served for 3 years, you would qualify for 100% of the benefit. So if your school charges $22,000 for in-state tuition and fees, you would receive $8,800 if you had 90 days of active service and the full $22,000 if you had 3 years of active service.

Note that this will change August 1, 2020. In this example, 90 days of active service would qualify you for 50% of the maximum amount as of August 1, 2020.

Do these benefits expire?
text:
[Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) > Do these benefits expire?]
This depends on when you were discharged from active duty.

If your service ended before January 1, 2013, your Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) benefits will expire 15 years after your last separation date from active service. You must use all of your benefits by that time or you ll lose whatever s left.

If your service ended on or after January 1, 2013, your benefits won t expire thanks to a new law called the Forever GI Bill - Harry W. Colmery Veterans Educational Assistance Act. Some letters you receive from us may not yet reflect this change. Thank you for your patience as we work to update our systems.Learn more about this new law

Can my family members or I get any additional benefits through the Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33)?
text:
[Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) > Can my family members or I get any additional benefits through the Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33)?]
You may qualify for these additional benefits:

- If you need more money to cover higher private-school or out-of-state tuition, you can apply for the Yellow Ribbon Program. Learn about the Yellow Ribbon Program
- If you re a qualified service member, you can transfer all 36 months or a portion of your Post-9/11 GI Bill benefits to a spouse or child. The Department of Defense approves a transfer of benefits. Learn about transferring Post-9/11 GI Bill benefits
- If you re the child or surviving spouse of a service member who died in the line of duty after September 10, 2001, you may qualify for the Marine Gunnery Sergeant John David Fry Scholarship (Fry Scholarship). Learn more about the Fry Scholarship

text:
[Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) > How can I use my Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) benefits?]
You can use your GI Bill benefits in many ways to advance your education and training.

Work toward a degree:

- Undergraduate and graduate degrees
- Tuition Assistance Top-Up
- Tutorial Assistance

Train for a specific career, trade, or industry:

- Vocational/technical training and non-college degree programs
- On-the-job training and apprenticeships
- Entrepreneurship training
- Flight training
- Test fees

Work while you study:

- Co-op training
- Work study

Take classes from home:

- Correspondence training
- Independent and distance learning

heading_path: Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33)
What is the Location-Based Housing Allowance (Section 107)?
text:
[Post-9/11 GI Bill (Chapter 33) > What is the Location-Based Housing Allowance (Section 107)?]
What is Section 107 (Location-Based Housing Allowance)? Previously, GI Bill beneficiaries were paid Monthly Housing Allowance (MHA) based on the main or branch campus of the school they were enrolled. If a student attended classes at more than one location, they were paid the rate that was most advantageous.

Now, MHA is based on the campus location where the student physically attends the majority of their classes.

VA s campus definitions:

- Main campus: A location where the of an educational institution are located.
- Branch campus: A location of an educational institution that is from and of the main campus of the educational institution.
- Extension campus: A location that is from the main or branch campus but is on that campus for the performance of administrative tasks.

此申请仅适用于VA国家公墓。如果您希望安葬在州或部落退伍军人公墓，请提前联系该公墓了解其预先计划。一些州退伍军人公墓要求您居住在该州或有其他资格规定。您可以向VA以及州或部落退伍军人公墓申请预先资格认定。查找州退伍军人公墓

此申请不适用于阿灵顿国家公墓或美国士兵和飞行员之家国家公墓。如果您希望安葬在这两个陆军部公墓之一，请致电877-907-8585。我们周一至周五上午8:00至下午5:30（东部时间）以及周六上午9:00至下午1:00（东部时间）提供服务。

获得预先资格认定并不保证您会安葬在特定的VA国家公墓。我们不接受任何VA国家公墓的预订。但是，我们会询问您希望安葬的地点，以便我们尽力帮助实现您的最终愿望。

### 收集填写申请所需的支持文件和信息。

请参阅以下列表。如果您没有列表中的所有内容，您仍然可以申请，我们将帮助查找所需的支持文件。请记住，您在申请时提供的信息越多，我们就能越快审核您的申请并给您决定。如果需要您提供额外信息，我们会与您联系。

### 确保为每位请求预先资格认定的人填写一份申请。

如果您和您的配偶都在申请，你们每个人都需要填写自己的申请表。

# 打印您的 VA Welcome Kit | Veterans Affairs

# 打印您的 VA Welcome Kit

无论您是刚刚退役，还是已经退伍多年，VA Welcome Kit 都能帮助您了解您应得的福利和服务。根据您所处的人生阶段，您的 VA 福利和服务可以以不同方式为您提供支持。请将您的 welcome kit 放在手边，以便在人生各个阶段随时查阅，例如上学、找工作、买房、获得医疗保健、退休或为年老时的护理做计划时。

## 下载您的 VA Welcome Kit

欢迎与需要福利帮助的朋友或家人分享本指南。您也可以为自己和他人打印副本：

您的 VA Welcome Kit 黑白版 (PDF)

您的 VA Welcome Kit 彩色版 (PDF)

## 下载我们的 VA 福利和服务指南

### 面向 Veterans

申请 VA 医疗保健 (PDF)开始使用心理健康服务 (PDF)申请伤残评级 (PDF)申请教育福利 (PDF)

### 面向家庭成员

开始使用照护者福利 (PDF)申请遗属福利 (PDF)

### 探索 VA.gov 了解您的福利

-

#### Disability

为与您的兵役相关的疾病提交伤残补偿申请，并随时间管理您的福利。

-

#### Health care

申请VA医疗保健，了解如何获取服务，并在线管理您的健康和福利。

-

#### 教育与培训

申请并管理您的GI Bill和其他教育福利，以帮助支付大学和培训项目的费用。

-

#### 住房援助

了解您是否符合VA房屋贷款项目的资格，以帮助您购买、建造、维修或保留住房。如果您有与服务相关的残疾，请查看您是否有资格获得住房补助金，以帮助您更独立地生活。

-

#### 职业与就业

申请职业康复服务，为您的Veteran-owned小企业获得支持，并获取其他职业资源。

-

#### 人寿保险

探索为Veterans、现役军人及其家庭提供的VA人寿保险选项。在线管理您的保单，提交福利索赔，并获取有用的资源。

-

#### 养老金

为收入有限或无收入且符合特定年龄和残疾要求的战时Veterans和遗属申请每月付款。

-

#### 葬礼与纪念

获取有关在VA国家公墓规划葬礼的帮助，订购墓碑或其他纪念物品以纪念退伍军人的服役，并申请遗属和受抚养人福利。

-

#### 记录

申请打印的退伍军人身份证，获取您的VA福利信函和医疗记录，并了解如何申请退役升级。

-

#### 配偶、受抚养人、遗属和家庭照护者的福利

了解退伍军人或服役人员配偶和受抚养人的福利，包括如果您正在照护有服役相关残疾的退伍军人时的额外支持。

text:
[PTSD 治疗 > 我现在如何与人交谈？]
无论您是刚从部署归来，还是已经回家40年，寻求 PTSD（创伤后应激障碍）帮助永远都不晚。接受咨询或治疗可以帮助您管理症状并防止其恶化。

我们的 National Center for PTSD 是 PTSD 研究、教育和治疗领域的全球领导者。了解如何通过 VA 获取 PTSD 健康服务。

了解如何白天或夜晚随时获得支持。

如果您是一位处于危机中的退伍军人，或担心某位退伍军人，请与我们关怀备至、经验丰富的Veterans Crisis Line responders联系，获取保密帮助。他们中许多人本身就是退伍军人。此服务是私密的、免费的，并且全天候24/7可用。

要随时与Veterans Crisis Line responder联系，白天或夜晚：

- 拨打800-273-8255，然后选择1。
- 开始一次保密的Veterans聊天。
- 发送短信至838255。
- 如果您有听力障碍，请拨打TTY：800-799-4889。

您还可以：

- 拨打911。
- 前往最近的急诊室。
- 直接前往最近的VA医疗中心。无论您的退役身份如何，或是否已加入VA医疗保健，都可以。查找最近的VA医疗中心

heading_path: PTSD 治疗
VA为PTSD提供哪些服务？
text:
[PTSD 治疗 > VA为PTSD提供哪些服务？]
#### 我们在全国有近200个PTSD治疗项目，提供：

- 一对一心理健康评估和测试，以确定您是否患有PTSD
- 经证明对治疗PTSD有效的药物
- 一对一心理治疗（也称为谈话疗法）。这包括如认知处理疗法（CPT）等经过验证的方法。
- 一对一家庭治疗
- 针对特殊需求的团体治疗，如愤怒或压力管理，或战斗支持
- 为曾在特定战区服役或经历过类似创伤的退伍军人提供团体治疗

#### 我们还提供其他形式的治疗和支持：

- PTSD专家在美国各地的每个VA医疗中心为患有PTSD的退伍军人提供常规门诊护理。
- 美国各地区设有专门的住院（住宿）或住院护理项目，帮助有严重PTSD症状且难以进行正常日常活动（如上班）的退伍军人。
- 提供商在我们一些大型社区门诊诊所提供额外的PTSD护理。

查找您附近的VA医疗中心或诊所

请注意：如果您不住在VA医疗中心或诊所附近，我们的心理健康提供者可以通过电话为您提供咨询（称为远程心理健康护理）。或者，我们可以将您转介到附近的Vet Center或医疗保健提供者。

# Reconstruct Military Records Destroyed In NPRC Fire | Veterans Affairs

# Reconstruct military records destroyed in NPRC fire

In 1973, a fire at the National Personnel Records Center (NPRC) in St. Louis, Missouri, destroyed the records held for Veterans who were discharged from the Army and Air Force during certain periods of time. Find out if your records may have been destroyed in this fire, and how to reconstruct your records to support a VA disability compensation claim.

### Were my records destroyed in the 1973 NPRC fire in St. Louis?

Your records may have been destroyed in the fire if you were discharged from either:

- The Army between November 1, 1912, and January 1, 1960. The fire destroyed 80% of the records held for Veterans discharged from the Army during this time period. The fire didn't involve records for retirees and Reservists who were alive on July 12, 1973.
- Or the Air Force between September 25, 1947, and January 1, 1964. The fire destroyed 75% of the records held for Veterans discharged from the Air Force during this time period with surnames beginning with Hubbard and running through the end of the alphabet.

Learn more about the 1973 NPRC fire

## Reconstructing your records

### How does VA reconstruct my records?

We submit a specific request to the NPRC for any additional service records they may have or can find for you.

With the information we provide, the NPRC searches for documents that may help to reconstruct your records. They may also reach out to other government agencies. For example, they may try to reconstruct portions of your service treatment records by reviewing unit records, morning reports, and hospital admission records from the surgeon general's office.

### How can I get the records I need to support my VA disability compensation claim?

If you're filing a VA disability compensation claim, follow the steps below to get the records you need.

1.  #### Fill out the National Archives request for information form

You'll need to fill out a Request for Information Needed to Reconstruct Medical Data (NA Form 13055). We'll use this form as our request to the NPRC to reconstruct your records.

Please give us as much information as you can about your assignments during service, including any of the below that apply to you:

- Unit
    - Company
    - Battalion
    - Regiment
    - Squadron
    - Group
    - Wing

Download NA Form 13055 (PDF)

2.  #### Gather or request other records or documents

We'll also look at other records or documents (called supplemental records ) to help decide your claim. You can provide these records or ask us to help you find them.

Please send us any of these documents you may have:

- Statements from service medical personnel
    - Certified buddy statements or affidavits from fellow service members who witnessed your injury or illness
    - Military accident and police reports
    - Examination reports related to employment or insurance
    - Letters or photographs from your time in the service
    - Prescription records
    - Photocopies of any service treatment records or medical reports from any private hospitals, clinics, or doctors who treated you during service or shortly after separation

3.  #### Submit your disability compensation claim, NA Form 13055, and any supporting documents

You can file your claim online, by mail, in person, or with the help of a trained professional. For claims involving the reconstruction of records, we encourage you to work with a professional, such as an accredited attorney, claims agent, or Veterans Service Officer (VSO).

Make sure to include your NA Form 13055 (PDF) and any supplemental records or other documents you may have with your claim.

Get instructions for filing a disability claimGet help from a trained professional

text:
# Request a Board Appeal | Veterans Affairs

# Request a Board Appeal

选择此选项时，您将向位于华盛顿特区的Veterans' Appeals委员会的Veterans Law Judge提出上诉。熟悉Veterans法律的法官将审查您的案件。

您可以选择添加法官将审查的新证据。

您也可以选择请求与法官举行听证会，可以在华盛顿特区亲自出席，或通过视频会议在您附近的VA地点进行。

### 我可以请求Board Appeal吗？

在初始索赔、Supplemental Claim或Higher-Level Review决定之后，您可以请求Board Appeal。您不能连续请求两次Board Appeal。

## 我可以添加新证据吗？

您可以选择添加新证据供法官审查。您需要在VA收到您的Board Appeal表格之日起90天内提交此证据。

此选项将花费更长时间。

## 我可以请求听证会吗？

您可以选择请求与法官举行听证会。视频会议听证会将在您附近的VA地点进行。

此选项将花费更长时间。

## 听证会上会发生什么？

您和法官将进行对话。法官将听取您的证词，并可能问您几个问题。如果您有代表，您的代表可以在听证会上帮助您。

听证会将被记录并添加到您的上诉文件中。您可以在听证会后90天内添加新的相关证据，但这不是必需的。

## 如何请求Board Appeal？

要请求Board Appeal，请填写Decision Review Request: Board Appeal (VA Form 10182)。下载VA Form 10182 (PDF)

1.  ### 从3个选项中选择1个，向 Veterans Law Judge 提出上诉

Direct Review 如果你希望 Veterans Law Judge 尽快审查你的案件，请选择 Direct Review。

你不能提交任何证据。

约1年 Board 对无新证据且无听证的上诉作出裁决的目标时间约为一年。

Evidence Submission 如果你有其他证据供 Veterans Law Judge 审查，请选择 Evidence Submission。

你必须在 VA 收到你的 Board Appeal 表格之日起90天内提交证据。

更长 如果你添加新证据，所需时间将比 Direct Review 上诉选项更长。

Hearing Request 如果你希望在附近的 VA 地点与 Veterans Law Judge 进行视频会议听证，请选择 Hearing Request。

在听证会上，你和 Veterans Law Judge 将进行对话，他们会询问你关于上诉的问题。你的听证将被记录并添加到你的上诉档案中。了解更多关于听证会以及如何申请的信息

你可以在听证后90天内添加新的相关证据，但这不是必需的。

更长 如果你要求听证，所需时间将比 Direct Review 上诉选项更长。

2.  ### 在 Part III 中列出你希望上诉的问题

你可以包括 VA 已决定的所有或部分问题。你需要列出你不同意的每个问题及对应的 VA 决定日期。

3.  ### 申请

填写 Decision Review Request: Board Appeal (VA Form 10182)。下载 VA Form 10182 (PDF)

邮寄

将填写完整的表格发送至以下地址：

Board of Veterans Appeals PO Box 27063 Washington, D.C. 20038

亲自办理

将填写完毕的表格带到地区福利办公室。查找离您最近的地区福利办公室

传真办理

将填写完毕的表格传真至 844-678-8979。

您也可以向地区福利办公室索取此表格的副本进行填写。或者，您可以拨打 VA 免费热线 800-827-1000（周一至周五，东部时间上午 8:00 至晚上 9:00）索取表格。

#### 标记您的日历

您有 1 年的时间（自决定日期起）来申请 Board Appeal。如果您是共同申领同一福利的多人之一（这种情况很少见），则您有 60 天的时间。

## Board 决定之后

如果您不同意 Board 的决定，并且有支持您案件的新且相关的证据，您可以提交 Supplemental Claim。您也可以向 U.S. Court of Appeals for Veterans Claims 提出上诉。了解 Board 决定后您的更多选择

## 接下来会发生什么？

了解您申请 decision review 后会发生什么

在等待期间，您无需做任何事情，除非 VA 向您发送信函要求提供更多信息。如果 VA 为您安排了考试，请务必不要错过。

跟踪您的上诉状态

## 如果我需要帮助怎么办？

Veterans Service Organization 或 VA 认可的律师或代理人可以帮助您申请 decision review。获取申请 decision review 的帮助

## 如果我有更多问题怎么办？

获取有关 decision reviews 的常见问题解答。前往 FAQs

[Request a Higher-Level Review > 我可以请求Higher-Level Review吗？]
如果你不同意VA的决定，你可以要求一位高级审查员重新审视你的案件。审查员将根据意见分歧或错误来判断是否可以更改决定。

你不能提交任何证据。

你和/或你的代表可以通过电话与审查员交谈。你可以告诉他们你认为决定应该更改的原因，并指出错误。

你可以对初始申请或Supplemental Claim的决定请求Higher-Level Review。此选项在Higher-Level Review或Board Appeal之后不可用。如果你是多位申请同一福利的人之一（这种情况很少见），也不可用。

text:
[Request a Higher-Level Review > 如果我请求与高级审查员通话，我应该期待什么？]
如果你请求与高级审查员进行非正式会议，他们会拨打你或你的代表在Higher-Level Review表格上提供的电话号码，以安排时间讨论你的案件。高级审查员会尝试通过电话联系你或你的代表两次。如果无人接听，他们会留下语音邮件。

在通话期间，你和/或你的代表可以讨论你认为决定应该更改的原因并指出错误。这次通话不会有记录。

要请求Higher-Level Review，请填写Decision Review Request: Higher-Level Review (VA Form 20-0996)。下载VA Form 20-0996 (PDF)

1.  ### 在表格第一部分选择福利类型

最常见的福利类型是compensation，但如果你不确定，请查看你的VA决定。你不能选择多种福利类型。每种类型你必须填写单独的表格。

2.  ### 可选：请求与审查员通话（非正式会议）

你和/或你的代表可以通过电话与审查员交谈。你可以告诉他们你认为决定应该更改的原因，并指出错误。

要安排非正式会议，请在表格第二部分选择时间并填写电话号码。审核员将在VA处理您的请求后2-4周内致电给您。

3.  ### 在表格第三部分列出您希望审核的问题

您可以包含VA已决定的所有或部分问题。您需要列出您不同意的每个问题及对应的VA决定日期。

您不能提交任何证据。

text:
# 申请你的军人服务记录| Veterans Affairs

# 申请你的军人服务记录(包括DD214 )

通过milConnect网站提交军人记录申请，以获取你的DD214或其他军人服务记录。

### 你需要登录milConnect才能获取你的军人服务记录

要使用此功能,你需要一个Premium DS Logon账户。你的My HealtheVet或ID.me凭据在milConnect网站上无法使用。前往milConnect登录、注册或将你的DS Logon账户升级为Premium。前往milConnect

## 登录milConnect后，我如何申请我的DD214或其他军人记录?

按照以下步骤提交军人记录申请。从已登录的主页, Ata AR Correspondence/ Documentation。然后从下拉菜单中选择Defense Personnel Records Information (DPRIS)。选择Personnel File选项卡。选择Request My Personnel File.填写表格。在Document Index B42 , Ait (RAB BAY SI SAE,点击或轻触Create and Send Request按钮。

## 我可以使用此工具申请哪些类型的记录?

您可以从您的官方军事人事档案Official Military Personnel File)中请求文件以查看和下载。您可以请求:

-DD214

-DD215

-退役报告( Report of Separation )

-其他退役文件您还可以请求包含您服役信息的文件，例如:

-命令和背书( Orders and endorsements )

-绩效报告( Performance reports )

-奖项和勋章(嘉奖物品)

-资格、执照和证书

-安全许可( Security clearance )

# 请求我的军事记录后会发生什么?

您籽收到一封电子邮件，告知我们正在处理您的请求。当您的请求完成且文件准备好供您查看和下载时，您将收到第二封电子邮件。您还可以通过登录milConnect并转到国防人事记录信息( DPRIS )部分内的"人事档案"选项卡来检查您的军事记录请求状态。这也是文件准备好后您查看和下载文件的地方。

# 还有其他方式获取我的军事记录吗?

是的。您可以通过以下任一方式申请您的军事记录:

-邮寄或传真《军事记录申请》(标准表格SF 180 )至国家人事记录中心( NPRC )。下载SF 180表格( PDF )

-写信给NPRC。寄至: 1 Archives Drive St. Louis, Missouri 63138

-亲自前往NPRC

-联系您所在州或县的退伍军人事务机构

-聘请独立研究员

# 如何申请他人的军事记录?

## 如果您是家属，计划将退伍军人安葬在VA国家公墓

请致电我们的国家公基调度办公室: 800-535-1117。我们可以帮助您获取可能需要的退伍军人DD214或其他退役文件。了解更多关于安排葬礼的信息

## 如果您是已故退伍军人的近亲

您可以通过以下任一方式申请该退伍军人军事记录的副本:

-邮寄或传真《军事记录申请》(标准表格SF 180 )至国家人事记录中心( NPRC )。下载SF 180表格( PDF )

-写信给NPRC。寄至: 1 Archives Drive St. Louis, Missouri 63138

-亲自前往NPRC

-联系您所在州或县的退伍军人事务机构

-聘请一位独立研究员如果您与退伍军人在以下任何方面存在亲属关系，您可能被视为其近亲:

-未再婚的未亡配偶,或

-父母,或

-子女,或

-兄弟姐妹

# 如果您不是退伍军人的近亲

如果退伍军人退役超过62年，您可以申请获取其军事记录的副本。国家档案馆( National Archives )在退役62年后向公众开放所有记录。了解如何访问存档记录如果退伍军人退役不足62年，您或许可以申请获取其军事人事档案( Military Personnel File )中的有限信息。了解公众获取军事记录的一般途径最后更新:

# Reserve Educational Assistance Program (REAP) | Veterans Affairs

# Reserve Educational Assistance Program (REAP)

The Reserve Educational Assistance Program (REAP) ended on November 25, 2015, but under the National Defense Authorization Act of 2016, some REAP benefits will remain in place for 3 more years. Learn more about what this change means for you.

## How does it affect me that REAP has ended?

Find the description below that best fits your situation to learn about how this change affects you, and what to do next.

### If you were actively using REAP benefits on or before November 24, 2015

You can keep using your REAP benefits until November 25, 2019.

Note: You fit this description if you were already attending a school or training program on November 24, 2015, or during the last semester, quarter, or term ending before that date.

### If you applied for REAP benefits, but you didn t start school until after November 24, 2015

You re no longer eligible to receive REAP benefits, but you may be eligible for Post-9/11 GI Bill benefits. Learn more about the Post-9/11 GI Bill

### If you applied for REAP benefits after November 24, 2015

You re not eligible to receive REAP benefits, but you may be eligible for Post-9/11 GI Bill benefits. We ll review your application and give you the benefits you qualify for.Learn more about the Post-9/11 GI Bill

### If we determined you were eligible for REAP benefits, but you lost your benefits when the program ended

You can credit your REAP eligibility toward your Post-9/11 GI Bill eligibility if you meet both of the requirements listed below.

Both of these must be true. You:

- Established REAP eligibility before November 25, 2015, and
- Lost eligibility when we retired that program on November 25, 2015

If you credit your eligibility toward your Post-9/11 GI Bill eligibility, you:

- Will receive one month (or a partial month) of Post-9/11 GI Bill benefits for each month (or partial month) of remaining REAP benefits up to a maximum of 36 months
- Will not be eligible for 48 months of entitlement based on your previous eligibility for REAP and your new eligibility under the Post-9/11 GI Bill
- Will be entitled to the 60% payment tier under the Post-9/11 GI Bill regardless of the length of your Post-9/11 active-duty service

If you d like to switch your benefits, call 888-GI-BILL-1 (888-442-4551), Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. ET.

[为退伍军人或家属安排安葬 > 如何为退伍军人或其他家属安排安葬？ > 如果您有确认资格的预先决定信]
了解如何为退伍军人、配偶或受抚养家属制定安葬计划。

heading_path: 为退伍军人或家属安排安葬
如何为退伍军人或其他家属安排安葬？
如果您没有预先决定信
text:
[为退伍军人或家属安排安葬 > 如何为退伍军人或其他家属安排安葬？ > 如果您没有预先决定信]
首先，您可能需要选择一位殡葬承办人来帮助您规划安葬事宜。然后，您或殡葬承办人需要采取以下 3 个步骤来安排安葬。

1.  #### 收集您在致电国家公墓调度办公室时需要用来确认逝者身份的信息和文件

您需要退伍军人或军人的 DD214 或其他退役文件，其军事服役将用于确定是否有资格安葬在 VA 国家公墓。他们的退役条件必须不是不光彩退役。

我们可能还需要其他文件来核实与退伍军人的关系或受抚养家属的身份。这些文件可能包括死亡证明、医生证明信、离婚判决书、社会保障管理局的声明或其他支持您申请的文件。

了解我们接受哪些退役文件以及您的申请了解如何申请退伍军人的 DD214

如果您找不到这些文件，请在致电时请求我们的帮助。如果您没有退役文件，我们可能需要 48 小时或更长时间来核实资格。

注意：当退伍军人或符合条件的受抚养家属已安葬在国家公墓时，通常不需要退役文件来安排安葬。

您还需要以下关于逝者的信息：

- 姓名
    - 性别
    - 社会安全号码或兵役号码（退伍军人身份证）
    - 出生日期
    - 与将用于决定资格的军人或退伍军人的关系
    - 婚姻状况
    - 死亡日期（以及死亡时的邮政编码和县）

您需要提供以下关于近亲（逝者最亲近的在世亲属）的信息：

- 姓名
    - 与逝者的关系
    - 社会安全号码
    - 电话号码
    - 地址

在某些情况下，您可能还需要更多信息：

- 如果逝者已婚，您还需要提供尚存配偶作为退伍军人、服役人员或家庭成员的身份。
    - 如果逝者有残疾子女，您需要提供未来可能安葬在国家公墓的残疾子女的身份和详细信息。
    - 如果逝者的配偶此前已去世并安葬在VA国家公墓，您需要提供配偶的全名以及其安葬的公墓区和墓穴编号。

2.  #### 决定安葬细节并收集所有相关信息

您需要告知我们：

- 您希望退伍军人、配偶或受抚养家庭成员安葬的公墓查找VA国家公墓查找州退伍军人公墓
    - 您希望为逝者选择的安葬类型（棺葬或火葬）以及棺木或骨灰瓮的尺寸
    - 您希望的墓地纪念物类型。这可以是墓碑、墓标、壁龛盖或奖章。
    - 您希望在墓碑或墓标上添加的任何宗教标志或可选铭文。

如果逝者是退伍军人或预备役人员，您还需要告知我们您是否希望获得安葬荣誉或纪念物品，例如：

- 安葬旗帜
    - 总统纪念证书
    - 除播放《熄灯号》和折叠并呈递旗帜之外的其他可能的军事荣誉

申请墓地纪念物和安葬荣誉了解更多关于军事葬礼荣誉的信息

3.  #### 联系国家公墓调度办公室

您选择的殡仪馆馆长也可以帮助您完成这些步骤：

- 对于在国家公墓的安葬，请将任何退役文件传真至国家公墓调度办公室，号码为866-900-6417。或者将文件扫描并通过电子邮件发送至NCA.Scheduling@va.gov，并在主题行中注明您为其申请安葬福利的人员姓名。

- 然后致电800-535-1117确认安葬申请。请确保手头有上述“准备”部分列出的所有信息。

国家公墓调度办公室每天从东部时间上午8:00至晚上7:30开放。该办公室在感恩节、圣诞节和元旦关闭。国家公墓的安葬时间为周一至周五。当周一或周五遇到联邦假日时，公墓可能会在假日当天或假日周末的某一天安排安葬。国家公墓调度办公室可以告知您每个公墓可用的安葬时间。

# 在线安排和查看VA预约 | Veterans Affairs

# 在线安排和查看VA预约

通过我们的VA预约工具，您可以在线安排部分VA医疗预约。您还可以查看即将到来的预约详情并管理您的健康日历。了解您是否符合资格，以及如何在我们的My HealtheVet健康管理门户上注册开始使用这些工具。

### 我如何立即与人交谈？

了解如何随时获得支持，无论白天还是夜晚。

如果您是处于危机中的退伍军人或担心某位退伍军人，请与我们富有爱心、经验丰富的Veterans Crisis Line responders联系，获取保密帮助。他们中的许多人本身就是退伍军人。此服务是私密的、免费的，并且24/7可用。

要随时联系Veterans Crisis Line responder，无论白天还是夜晚：

- 拨打800-273-8255，然后选择1。
- 开始一次保密的Veterans聊天。
- 发送短信至838255。
- 如果您有听力损失，请拨打TTY：800-799-4889。

您还可以：

- 拨打911。
- 前往最近的急诊室。
- 直接前往最近的VA医疗中心。无论您的退役身份如何，或者您是否已加入VA医疗保健，都没关系。查找最近的VA医疗中心

请注意：通常，进行所有VA预约的最快方式是致电您希望接受护理的VA医疗机构。如果您无法赴约，请尽快联系该机构以重新安排或取消。查找您的VA医疗机构电话号码

## 在线查看您的VA预约

## 在线安排或取消VA预约

## VA预约工具如何帮助我管理我的医疗保健？

VA预约工具提供了一种安全的、基于网络的方式，用于在线安排、查看和组织您的VA预约。

您可以使用这些工具来：

- 在线安排部分VA医疗预约
- 重新安排和取消在线进行的预约
- 在您的健康日历上查看预约
- 查找您预约的VA设施的位置
- 为即将到来的预约设置电子邮件提醒
- 打印您未来预约的列表
- 查找过去2年的历史预约
- 将非VA预约添加到您的健康日历

## 我是否有资格使用VA预约工具？

如果您满足以下列出的所有要求，您可以使用这些工具。

以下所有条件都必须满足。您：

- 已注册VA健康护理，并且
- 正在预约使用在线预约的VA健康机构，并且
- 在过去2年内曾在该VA健康机构有过预约

了解如何申请VA健康护理

并且，您必须拥有以下免费账户之一：

- 一个Premium My HealtheVet账户，或
- 一个Premium DS Logon账户（用于eBenefits和milConnect），或
- 一个已验证的ID.me账户，您可以在VA.gov上创建

了解3种不同的My HealtheVet账户类型

## 我如何知道我的VA健康机构是否使用在线预约？

您可以查看我们目前使用在线预约工具的VA机构列表。我们希望未来能扩大VA机构和预约类型的数量。

查看目前使用在线预约的VA机构列表

## 我可以在线预约哪些类型的VA医疗预约？

这取决于您接受护理的VA健康机构。

您或许可以预约以下门诊预约：

- 初级护理
- 心理健康
- 验光
- 听力

请与您接受护理的具体机构核实，询问在线预约事宜。查看目前使用在线预约的VA机构查找VA健康机构

## 我可以使用此工具预约非VA预约吗？

不可以。了解更多关于从非VA提供者获得护理的信息。

## 我可以通过VA安全消息安排预约吗？

如果您与VA医疗团队使用Secure Messaging，您或许可以通过此服务来安排和取消预约。了解更多关于Secure Messaging的信息

## 我的个人健康信息会受到保护吗？

是的。这是一个安全的网站。我们遵循严格的安全政策和实践来保护您的个人健康信息。并且只有您和您的VA医疗团队能够访问您的安全消息。

如果您打印或下载任何消息，您需要负责保护这些信息。获取保护个人健康信息的提示

## 如果我有更多问题怎么办？

您可以在我们的My HealtheVet门户网站中找到关于这些工具的答案。阅读VA预约常见问题解答

您也可以联系My HealtheVet帮助台。了解如何在线联系我们

或致电我们：877-327-0022（TTY：800-877-8339）。我们的服务时间为周一至周五，上午7:00至下午7:00（中部时间）。

# Service-Disabled Veterans Life Insurance (S-DVI) | Veterans Affairs

# Service-Disabled Veterans Life Insurance (S-DVI)

Service-Disabled Veterans Life Insurance (S-DVI) provides low-cost coverage to eligible service members. If you have a service-connected disability, find out how to apply for S-DVI online or by mail.

### Can I apply for Service-Disabled Veterans Life Insurance?

You can apply for S-DVI if you meet all of the requirements listed below.

All of these must be true. You:

- Were released from active duty on or after April 25, 1951, and didn t receive a dishonorable discharge, and
- Were rated for a service-connected disability (even if only 0%), and
- Are in good health except for any service-connected conditions, and
- Apply within 2 years from the date we grant your new service-connected disability

Note: An increase of a rating you had before or a rating of Individual Unemployability, meaning you can t work doesn t qualify you for S-DVI. Watch our video about the benefits of S-DVI

### Can I get more life insurance coverage if I need it?

If you carry the basic S-DVI coverage and become totally disabled and unable to work, you can apply to get up to $30,000 more in coverage. This is called supplemental S-DVI coverage.

You may be able to get $30,000 of supplemental coverage if you qualify for a premiums waiver, and you meet both of the requirements listed below.

Both of these must be true. You:

- Apply for the coverage within 1 year from the date you get notice of the grant of waiver, and
- Are younger than age 65

Learn more about premium waivers

### Who s covered?

Veterans

## What should I do if I received an other than honorable, bad conduct, or dishonorable discharge?

If you ve received one of these discharge statuses, you may not be eligible for VA benefits.

There are 2 ways you can try to qualify:

Find out how to apply for a discharge upgradeLearn about the VA Character of Discharge review process

## What kind of life insurance benefits can I get with Service-Disabled Veterans Life Insurance?

- Up to $10,000 of coverage
- Up to $30,000 of supplemental coverage

## How do I get these benefits?

You ll need to apply for benefits in 1 of 2 ways:

- Apply for basic S-DVI online, or

- Fill out an Application for Service-Disabled Veterans Life Insurance (VA Form 29-4364). Download VA Form 29-4364 (PDF)

Fax it to 888-748-5822, or mail it to:

Department of Veterans Affairs Regional Office and Insurance Center (RH) PO Box 7208 Philadelphia, PA 19101

If you want to apply for supplemental S-DVI, you must have already applied for and been granted a waiver of premiums. (See our information below about getting a waiver.) To apply for supplemental S-DVI, file an Application for Supplemental Service-Disabled Veterans Insurance (VA Form 29-0188) or send a letter requesting this insurance over your signature. You must apply for the coverage within one year from the date you receive notice of the grant of waiver of premiums.Download VA Form 29-0188 (PDF)

## How much will I pay for these benefits?

Your premium rate (the amount you ll pay each month for your coverage) depends on all of the factors listed below.

Your premium rate depends on:

- Your age, and
- The amount of insurance you want, and
- The coverage plan requested

See the premium rates and a description of the plan options. Download Service-Disabled Veterans Insurance RH Information and Premium Rates (VA pamphlet 29-9)

## Can I get a waiver so I don t have to pay the premiums?

Yes, in some cases. Under certain conditions, the basic S-DVI policy provides for a waiver of premiums for Veterans who are totally disabled.Learn more about premium waivers

You must pay your premiums for supplemental S-DVI.

## What if I need help with my claim?

If you have questions about Service-Disabled Veterans Insurance or a VA life insurance policy that starts with a V, RH, J, RS, K, or W, you can call the VA Life Insurance Center at 800-669-8477. We re here from 8:30 a.m. to 6:00 p.m. ET.

## Veterans Mortgage Life Insurance (VMLI)

If you have a severe service-connected disability that we ve concluded was caused or made worse by your service, you may be able to get Veterans Mortgage Life Insurance (VMLI). In the event of your death, this mortgage protection insurance can help your family pay off the home mortgage on a home that s been adapted to meet your needs.

To get VMLI, you ll need to apply for our Specially Adapted Housing (SAH) Grant. The SAH grant can help you buy, build, or make changes (like installing ramps or widening doorways) to a home so you can live more independently. When you receive an SAH grant, your Loan Guaranty agent will tell you if you qualify for VMLI and will help you apply.Find out if you qualify for an SAH grant and how to applyFind out if you qualify for VMLI and how to apply

text:
[军人团体人寿保险（SGLI） > 我是否符合SGLI资格？]
军人团体人寿保险（SGLI）为符合条件的服役人员提供低成本定期保险。如果您是符合特定标准的服役人员，我们将自动为您注册。了解您是否符合资格，并学习如何管理您的SGLI保险。

如果您符合以下任何一项描述，您可能有资格获得全职SGLI保险。

至少以下一项必须属实。您是：

- 陆军、海军、空军、海军陆战队或海岸警卫队的现役成员，或
- 国家海洋和大气管理局（NOAA）或美国公共卫生服务局（USPHS）的委任成员，或
- 美国军事学院的学员或海军学校学员，或
- 参与授权训练和实习航行的后备军官训练团（ROTC）成员、学员或海军学校学员，或
- 预备役或国民警卫队的成员，被分配到某个单位，并计划每年至少进行12次非现役训练，或
- 个人预备役（IRR）动员类别的志愿者

#### 如果您处于预备役或国民警卫队的无薪状态

如果您满足以下两项要求，您可能有资格获得全职SGLI保险。

以下两项必须都属实。您是：

- 计划当年进行12次非现役训练，且
- 为积分而非薪水进行训练

注意：您必须直接支付保费。

[军人团体人寿保险（SGLI） > 在服役期间访问和管理SGLI]
### 我可以获得哪些类型的人寿保险福利？

您可以获得：

- 最高限额为400,000美元，以50,000美元为增量递增的保险
- 从您离开军队之日起120天的免费保险
- 当您离开军队时，如果您完全残疾，免费保险可延长至多2年。请参阅下方关于SGLI残疾延期的信息
- 兼职保险（如果您是不符合全职保险资格的预备役成员）

### 我如何获得这些福利？

如果您符合SGLI的资格，我们将通过您的军种自动为您注册。详情请咨询您所在单位的人事办公室。

### 我可以更改我的福利吗？

可以。您可以选择您的保险金额，甚至完全拒绝保险。您也可以选择您的受益人（您指定在您去世后从人寿保险单中获得保险金的人），并根据需要更改他们。

### 如何更改您的受益人或减少、拒绝或恢复您的SGLI保险

如果您是陆军、海军、空军、海军陆战队、海岸警卫队或国家海洋和大气管理局的成员，请通过SGLI在线注册系统（SOES）在线提交您的更改。要访问SOES：

1.  前往milConnect

2.  登录。

3.  前往福利，人寿保险SOES-SGLI在线注册系统。

4.  检查您的保险和受益人信息，并进行任何必要的更新。

一旦您收到可以开始使用SOES的通知，您就可以使用CAC或DS Logon通过Internet Explorer登录。

如果您是公共卫生署的成员，请填写《军人团体人寿保险选择和证明》（SGLV 8286）并将其交给您单位的人事官员来提交您的更改。下载SGLV 8286（PDF）了解更多关于SOES的信息

text:
[军人团体人寿保险（SGLI） > 在您退役或退休时申请VGLI]
### 当我离开军队时如何申请VGLI？

当您离开军队时，您可以在退伍后1年零120天内申请退伍军人团体人寿保险（VGLI），最高保额为您通过SGLI拥有的保险金额。了解更多关于VGLI的信息

您还可以在离开军队之日起120天内将您的SGLI保单转换为 civilian 保单。了解如何将您的SGLI保障转换为个人保单（PDF）

### 如果我离开军队时残疾，我可以免费延长我的SGLI保障吗？

如果您在离军日期后2年内，并且满足以下任一要求，您可能可以在离开军队之日起保留保障最多2年。

以下至少一项必须为真：

- 您在退伍时完全残疾且无法工作，或
- 无论您的工作状况如何，您已患有以下情况之一：
  - 双耳完全失聪
  - 丧失言语能力，即使借助人工设备也无法低声说话
  - 双手、双脚或双眼，或一只手和一只脚，或一只手或一只脚和一只眼睛永久（长期）丧失功能

### 我如何申请SGLI残疾延长？

您需要申请军人团体人寿保险残疾延长（SGLI-DE）。

要申请，请填写SGLI残疾延长申请表（SGLV 8715）并将其发送至申请表上列出的OSGLI地址。下载SGLV 8715（PDF）

如果您的申请获得批准，您将在离军日期后20个月收到通知，告知您的SGLI-DE即将结束，并且您现在可以选择支付保费以参加退伍军人团体人寿保险（VGLI）。

如果您支付保费，只要您持续支付保费，您就可以保留您的人寿保险保障。了解更多关于VGLI的信息

### 如果我的索赔需要帮助怎么办？

如果您对军人或退伍军人团体人寿保险有疑问，您可以拨打军人团体人寿保险办公室（OSGLI）电话800-419-1473，或发送电子邮件至保德信保险公司。

### 我的家人需要哪些表格？

- 要为患有绝症的军人申请预付保险金，家属需提交加速给付索赔表（SGLV 8284）。下载SGLV 8284（PDF）
- 要在需要时获得保险金，家属需提交死亡抚恤金索赔表（SGLV 8283）。下载SGLV 8283（PDF）
- 要帮助军人在创伤性损伤恢复期间获得短期经济支持，家属需与军人共同提交TSGLI福利申请表（SGLV 8600）。下载SGLV 8600（PDF）

# Special Claims | Veterans Affairs

## Special claims

Do you have a disability that isn t listed on this site as being linked to military service? You may still be able to get disability compensation (payments) or other benefits. If you re a Veteran with a disability we ve concluded is the result of an illness or injury caused or made worse by your active-duty service (called a service-connected disability), you may be able to get special compensation to help with disabilities like the ones listed below.

## Automobile allowance and adaptive equipment

If your service-connected disability prevents you from driving, find out if you can get money to help buy a specially equipped vehicle or make needed changes to your existing vehicle.

## Birth defects linked to Agent Orange

If you were exposed to specific chemicals while serving in Vietnam, Thailand, or the Korean Demilitarized Zone, and your child has spina bifida or other birth defects, your child may be eligible for disability benefits.

## Replacing damaged clothing

If your clothing s been damaged by your prosthetic or orthopedic device or by medicine you re taking for a skin condition find out if you can get money to help buy new clothes.

## Recovery from surgery or an immobilizing disability (convalescence)

If you re recovering from surgery or other treatment that s left you unable to move, find out if you can get temporary disability payments or other benefits.

### Dental care

If you re a Veteran, find out if you can get dental care through VA.

# Time spent in a hospital

If you spent time in a VA or VA-approved hospital for a service-connected disability, find out if you can get benefits like disability payments for that time.

# Being unable to work (Individual Unemployability)

If you can t work because of your service-connected disability, find out if you can get increased disability payments.

## Title 38 U.S.C. 1151 disabilities

If you suffered an added disability while getting VA medical care or taking part in a VA program designed to help you find, get, or keep a job, find out if you can get disability payments.

# Immediate help for temporary disability needs (prestabilization)

If you recently ended your active military service and you have a service-connected disability, find out if you can get temporary disability payments or other benefits right away.

# Substance Use Treatment For Veterans | Veterans Affairs

## Substance use treatment for Veterans

If you re struggling with substance use problems, you re not alone. Many Veterans have problems with the use of alcohol, tobacco, street drugs, and prescription medicines. We re here to help. Find out how to get support for substance use problems through VA.

How do I talk to someone right now?

Find out how to get support anytime day or night.

If you're a Veteran in crisis or concerned about one, connect with our caring, qualified Veterans Crisis Line responders for confidential help. Many of them are Veterans themselves. This service is private, free, and available 24/7.

To connect with a Veterans Crisis Line responder anytime day or night:

- Call 800-273-8255, then select 1.

- Start a confidential Veterans chat.

- Text 838255.

- If you have hearing loss, call TTY: 800-799-4889.

You can also:

- Call 911.

- Go to the nearest emergency room.

- Go directly to your nearest VA medical center. It doesn't matter what your discharge status is or if you're enrolled in VA health care.Find your nearest VA medical center

What services does VA provide for Veterans with substance use problems?

We provide many options for Veterans seeking treatment for substance use problems ranging from unhealthy alcohol use to life-threatening addiction. The services we offer you depend on your specific needs.

We offer proven medication options, like:

- Medically managed detoxification to stop substance use safely, and services to get stable - Drug substitution therapies and newer medicines to reduce cravings (like methadone and buprenorphine for opiate addiction)

- Nicotine replacement or other medicines for stopping tobacco use

We offer counseling and other therapy options, like:

- Short-term outpatient counseling

- Intensive outpatient treatment

- Marriage and family counseling

- Self-help groups

- Residential (live-in) care

- Continuing care and relapse prevention (making sure you don t slip back into the same substance use problems)

- Special programs for Veterans with specific concerns (like women Veterans, returning combat Veterans, and homeless Veterans)

We also offer treatment and support for health conditions that can be related to substance use problems, like:

- Posttraumatic stress disorder (PTSD)

- Depression

Learn more about treatment programs for substance use problems

## How do I access VA services for substance use problems?

The VA health care program covers services to treat substance use problems. To access these services, first apply for VA health care.Apply for VA health care

Once you ve signed up:

- If you have a VA primary care provider, talk to them about your substance use. Your provider can help you get screened for substance use problems and related issues (like PTSD or depression) and can offer treatment and support as needed.

- If you don t have a VA primary care provider or have never been seen in a VA hospital or clinic:

- - Find a Substance Use Disorder (SUD) program near you, or

- - Call our general information hotline at 800-827-1000, or

- - Contact your local VA medical center.Find a VA medical center near you

- If you served in Operation Enduring Freedom (OEF), Operation Iraqi Freedom (OIF), or Operation New Dawn (OND), call your local VA medical center, and ask to speak to the OEF/OIF/OND coordinator.Find a VA medical center near you

## What if I don t have VA health care benefits?

You may still be able to get care:

- If you ve served in a combat zone, get free private counseling, alcohol and drug assessment, and other support at one of our 300 community Vet Centers.Find a Vet Center near you

- If you re homeless or at risk of becoming homeless:

- - Visit our website to learn about VA programs for Veterans who are homeless.Learn about our homelessness programs

- - Contact the National Call Center for Homeless Veterans at 877-424-3838 for help 24 hours a day, 7 days a week. A trained VA counselor will offer information about VA homeless programs, health care, and other services in your area. The call is free and confidential (private).

- - Call or visit your local VA Community Resource and Referral Center. Even if you don t qualify for VA health care, our staff can help you find non-VA resources you may qualify for in your community.Find your local Community Resource and Referral Center

## Where can I find more information and support?

- Download our Guide to VA Mental Health Services (PDF).

- Go to our Make the Connection website to hear stories from Veterans about their own experiences with overcoming drug and alcohol problems, and to get access to more resources and support.Visit Make the Connection

- Visit our self-help resources guide to get links to books, web resources, and mobile applications that have been reviewed and recommended by VA experts.Get self-help resources

- Visit the resources section of our VA website to find more trusted resources outside VA that can offer information and support.Find resources

- Download our Stay Quit Coach mobile app designed to help Veterans with PTSD quit smoking. We based this app on steps proven to work to help people quit smoking. It includes tools to control cravings and manage smoking triggers, messages to keep you going, medication reminders, and more.Get the Stay Quit Coach app

# Survivors’ And Dependents’ Educational Assistance | Veterans Affairs

## Survivors and Dependents Educational Assistance

Learn about the Survivors and Dependents Educational Assistance (DEA) program. If you re the child or spouse of a Veteran or service member who has died, is captured or missing, or has disabilities, you may be able to get help paying for school or job training through the DEA program also called Chapter 35. Find out if you re eligible for this benefit.

## Am | eligible for education benefits through the DEA program?

You may be able to get these benefits if both you and the Veteran or service member meet certain eligibility requirements.

One of the descriptions below must be true. The Veteran or service member:

- ls permanently and totally disabled due to a service-connected disability, or

- Died while on active duty or as a result of a service-connected disability, or

- ls missing in action or was captured in the line of duty by a hostile force, or

- Was forcibly detained (held) or interned in the line of duty by a foreign entity, or

- Is in the hospital or getting outpatient treatment for a service-connected permanent and total disability and is likely to be discharged for that disability (effective December 23, 2006)

## If you re the child of a Veteran or service member

- You can get benefits if you re between the ages of 18 and 26, except in certain cases. You may be married or unmarried.

- If you re over 18 years old and using DEA, you can t get Dependency and Indemnity Compensation (DIC) from us. Learn about DIC

- If you join the military, you can t use this benefit while on active duty. And if you want to use this benefit after you leave the service, you can t have a dishonorable discharge. Military service can extend your eligibility, but this increase doesn t usually go past your 31st birthday.

## If you re the spouse of a Veteran or service member

- Your benefits start on the date we conclude that you qualify or on the date of the Veteran s death, and last for 10 years.

- If we rated the Veteran as permanently and totally disabled, with an effective date that s 3 years after discharge, you Il qualify for benefits for 20 years from that effective date. This new

## policy began on October 10, 2008. We won t pay benefits for training you started before this

date.

- If the service member died on active duty, your benefits end 20 years from the date of death.

- You can get DIC payments from us and use DEA benefits.

# What benefits can | get?

We Il send you a monthly payment to help you cover the cost of:

- College or graduate degree programs

- Career-training certificate courses

- Educational and career counseling

- Apprenticeships

- On-the-job training Note: If you began using this program to pay for your school or training before August 1, 2018, you can get benefits for up to 45 months. If you began using the program on or after August 1, 2018, you can get benefits for up to 36 months.

View current payment rates

# What if | qualify for both DEA and the Fry Scholarship?

You II need to pick one or the other. Once you make this choice, you can t switch to the other program. Learn about the Fry Scholarship

Exception: If you re the child of a service member who died in the line of duty before August 1, 2011, you can use both DEA and the Fry Scholarship and get up to 81 months of education and training. You Il need to use one program at a time.

# Can | get more help if | have a disability that prevents me from working toward my goals?

We may prescribe special restorative training, if needed, to help you overcome or lessen the effects of a physical or mental disability so you can work toward your educational or training goal. Or we may approve special vocational training you may need due to a physical or mental disability. These special benefits won t include medical or psychiatric care.

# How do | get these benefits?

First, contact your school s certifying official to make sure your program is approved for VA benefits. Then, you can:

- Apply online now, or

- Apply by mail. You II need to fill out a Dependents Application for VA Education Benefits (VA Form 22-5490) and mail it to the regional processing office for your state. You II find the address on the last page of the form.Download VA Form 22-5490

## If you haven t started school or a training program:

- Get help from a trained professional trusted to help with VA-related claims.Get help filing your claim

- Get more information about schools and see if we ve approved your program.Use the Gl Bill Comparison Tool

## If you ve already started your program:

- Take your application to your school or employer.

- Ask your school to fill out a VA Enrollment Certification (VA Form 22-1999) and send it to us along with your application. Last updated:

# Temporary Disability Rating After Surgery Or Cast | Veterans Affairs

## Temporary disability rating after surgery or cast

Are you recovering from surgery or a disability related to your military service that s left you unable to move? You may be able to get a temporary 100% disability rating and disability compensation or benefits if you have this kind of immobilizing disability. Find out if you can get this benefit.

## Can | get disability benefits from VA?

You may be able to get disability benefits if you ve had surgery or received other treatment ata VA hospital, approved hospital, or outpatient center for a disability related to your military service (called a service-connected disability).

If you had surgery, both of these must be true for you:

- The surgery required a recovery time of at least one month or reports show that the surgery or treatment was for a service-connected disability, and

- The surgery resulted in severe issues, like:

- - Surgical wounds that haven t totally healed

- - Stumps of recent amputations

- - Being unable to move due to being put in splints or casts to help with healing (known as therapeutic immobilizations)

- - Being unable to leave your house (known as house confinement)

- - Being required to use a wheelchair or crutches If you didn t have surgery, this must be true:

You had one or more major joints immobilized by a cast.

### Who s covered?

Veterans

## What kind of disability benefits can | get?

- Health care

- Added compensation (payments) while you recover

- Atemporary 100% disability rating

# How do | get these benefits?

You II need to file a claim for disability compensation. Find out how to file a claim for disability compensation

Recovery time from either a surgery or the immobilization of a joint by a cast without surgery requires a temporary 100% disability rating for a service-connected disability. The temporary 100% rating may continue for 1 to 3 months depending on your unique case. You may be able to get an extension for up to 3 more months if your case is severe.

## Example: A Veteran had a left knee injury that resulted in a 30% disability rating. As the knee

problem got worse, the Veteran s VA doctor recommended surgery to stop more damage from happening. Since the doctor wouldn t know if the surgery was successful until 3 months after the Veteran s 1-week stay in the hospital, we granted the Veteran a temporary 100% disability rating for 3 months.

text:
[完全残疾或身患绝症的投保人 > 针对完全残疾投保人的保费豁免]
保费豁免意味着您不必支付人寿保险费（您为持有保单而支付的每月款项）。在大多数情况下，保费只能追溯到收到索赔前一年内豁免。

- 如果您满足以下所有要求，您可能能够获得人寿保险费的豁免。

以下所有条件必须都满足：

- 您有精神或身体残疾，使您无法工作，并且
  - 您投保了退伍军人服务残疾保险（S-DVI），并且
  - 您的完全残疾发生在65岁之前但在您的人寿保险保单生效日期之后，并且
  - 您的完全残疾持续至少连续6个月

上述条件有某些例外。但如果您认为自己有权获得保费豁免，您应尽快申请，我们将告知您是否符合资格。

- 您需要在完全残疾后尽快申请这些福利。我们将决定您是否符合资格，并通知您决定。

如需申请，请填写并签署《残疾保险索赔表》（VA表格29-357），然后邮寄至表格上所列地址。

下载VA表格29-357（PDF）

text:
[完全残疾或身患绝症的投保人 > 为临终投保人提供的加速给付]
符合条件的退伍军人、服役人员及其受保配偶可获得加速给付。通过加速给付，您可以在去世前获得保额面值的最高50%，以每次5,000美元的增量支付给您。

- 如果您同时满足以下两项要求，您或您的配偶可能可以提前获得给付。

以下两项必须均为属实：

- 您拥有SGLI、家庭SGLI或VGLI人寿保险，并且
  - 您或您受保的配偶持有医生出具的书面证明，表明您（或您的配偶）预期寿命为9个月或更短

注意：只有受保的服役人员或退伍军人本人可以申请加速给付。任何人均不得代其申请。若配偶为临终患者，则只有受保人本人可以申请。

- 只有受保的服役人员或退伍军人本人可以申请加速给付。任何人均不得代其申请。若配偶为临终患者，则只有受保人本人可以申请。

请根据您所持保险类型使用相应的申请表：

如果您是SGLI或VGLI投保人，请填写《加速给付索赔表》（SGLV 8284）。下载《加速给付索赔表》

- 如果您仍在服役或您是预备役人员，请将表格提交给您的军种部门。他们将需要填写表格的一部分。

- 如果您是退伍军人，请让您的医生填写其部分，然后将填好的表格发送至：

美国保德信保险公司 邮政信箱70173 费城，宾夕法尼亚州 19176-0173

或者，将表格传真至877-832-4943。

如果您受家庭SGLI保障，请填写《加速给付索赔表》（SGLV 8284A）。下载《加速给付索赔表》

您需要填写申请表的一部分，您的医生需要填写另一部分。

在您去世时，我们将保险单面值的剩余金额支付给您指定的受益人（您选择的从保单中获得款项的人）。若配偶为临终患者，则在您的配偶去世时，我们将保险单的剩余部分支付给您。

# Transfer Your Post-9/11 GI Bill Benefits | Veterans Affairs

# Transfer your Post-9/11 GI Bill benefits

Find out if you can transfer any of your unused Post-9/11 GI Bill benefits to your spouse or dependent children.

Note: The Department of Defense (DoD) decides whether you can transfer GI Bill benefits to your family.

### Can I transfer benefits?

You can transfer education benefits if you re on active duty or in the Selected Reserve and you meet the requirements listed below.

At least one of these must be true:

- You have completed at least 6 years of service on the date your request is approved and you agree to add 4 more years of service, or
- You have completed at least 10 years of service on the date your request is approved, can t commit to add 4 more years of service because of either a policy or statute, but agree to serve for the maximum amount of time allowed

And this must also be true:

The person getting benefits has enrolled in the Defense Enrollment Eligibility Reporting System (DEERS).

### Who s covered?

Qualified dependents

## What benefits can my qualified dependents get?

If the DoD approves the Transfer of Entitlement (TOE), your spouse or dependent children can apply for up to 36 months of benefits, and may be able to get money for:

- Tuition
- Housing
- Books and supplies

## When can they use the transferred benefits?

These conditions apply to family members using transferred benefits:

#### Spouses

- May use the benefit right away
- May use the benefit while you re on active duty or after you ve separated from service
- Don t qualify for the monthly housing allowance while you re on active duty
- May use the benefit for up to 15 years after your separation from active duty

#### Children

- May start to use the benefit only after you ve finished at least 10 years of service
- May use the benefit while you re on active duty or after you ve separated from service
- May not use the benefit until they ve gotten a high school diploma (or equivalency certificate), or have reached 18 years of age
- Qualify for the monthly housing allowance even when you re on active duty
- Don t have to use the benefit within 15 years after your separation from active duty, but can t use the benefit after they ve turned 26 years old.

Your dependents may still qualify even if a child marries or you and your spouse divorce. However, service members and Veterans can revoke (cancel) or change a TOE at any time. If you want to totally revoke transferred benefits for a dependent and you re still in the service, please turn in another transfer request for the dependent through milConnect. If a dependent s transfer eligibility (ability to get a TOE) has been totally revoked, you can t transfer benefits again to that dependent.

## How do I transfer the benefit?

While you re still on active duty, you ll request to transfer, change, or revoke a Transfer of Entitlement (TOE) through milConnect. You can t apply for a TOE through us.Transfer, change, or revoke a TOE

If the DoD approves the TOE, your family members may apply for benefits.

- Apply online now, or
- Apply by mail. Fill out and mail an Application for Family Member to Use Transferred Benefits (VA Form 22-1990E) to the nearest VA regional benefit office.Download VA Form 22-1990E (PDF)Find your nearest VA regional benefit office

Once you leave active duty, you can still provide a future effective date for when the TOE can be used, change the number of months transferred, or revoke the TOE by submitting a written request to VA through milConnect.

## Get more information

- DoD website for information on transferring benefits
- Fact sheet on transferring Post-9/11 GI Bill benefits (PDF)
- To find out if you qualify, the status of your transfer request, and how to use the TEB Portlet (for service-specific questions), please contact the right career counselor or personnel center from this list:
  - Army Active-Duty Officer Email
  - Army Active-Duty Enlisted Email
  - Army National Guard Email
  - Army Reserve (Enlisted and Officer) Email
  - Navy Active-Duty Personnel 866-U-ASK-NPC (866-827-5672) or DSN 882-5672
  - Navy Reserve 800-621-8853, Fax: 757-444-7597/7598 Email
  - Marine Corps Active-Duty Officer Email
  - Marine Corps Active-Duty Enlisted Email
  - Marine Corps Reserve Email
  - Air Force Active Duty 800-525-0102 or 210-565-5000 or DSN 665-5000
  - Air National Guard (Contact unit retention manager)
  - Air Force Reserve Email
  - Coast Guard Active Duty Email
  - Coast Guard Reserve Email
  - NOAA Email or 301-713-7728
  - PHS Email or 240-453-6130

text:
# 创伤性损伤保护（TSGLI）| 退伍军人事务部

## 创伤性损伤保护（TSGLI）

TSGLI（也称为军人团体人寿保险创伤性损伤保护）提供短期经济支持，帮助符合条件的服役人员 从严重伤害中恢复。如果您在服役期间投保了SGLI并遭受了创伤性损伤，请了解如何提交TSGLI索 赔或对先前的决定提出上诉。

### 我是否符合TSGLI资格？

如果您在遭受创伤性损伤时已投保SGLI，并且满足以下列出的所有要求，您可能可以获得TSGLI。

以下所有条件必须成立。您：

- 有因创伤性损伤直接导致的计划内损失，并且

- 在离开军队的当天午夜之前遭受了创伤性损伤，并且

- 在创伤性损伤后2年（730天）内遭受了计划内损失，并且

- 自创伤性损伤之日起存活了至少7整天（7天期限从创伤性损伤的日期和时间开始，至168整小 时后结束），并且

- 是现役军人、预备役人员、国民警卫队成员、执行葬礼荣誉任务或参加1天召集任务的人员

是否有任何损伤被排除在TSGLI之外？

是的。要符合TSGLI资格，您的损伤不能符合以下任何描述。

以下任何情况都不能成立。您的损伤不能：

- 是故意自残或企图自残的结果，或

- 涉及使用未经医生建议而给予或服用的非法药物或受控物质，或

- 是疾病或病症的医疗或手术治疗结果，或

- 在实施或试图实施重罪时发生，或

- 是身体或精神疾病或病症的结果（不包括由伤口感染；化学、生物或放射性武器；或意外摄入 受污染物质引起的疾病或病症）

#### 查看TSGLI损失标准

我能否为过去的损伤获得追溯性TSGLI？

如果您在2001年10月7日至2005年11月30日期间受伤，并且满足上述所有TSGLI资格条件，您可能 可以获得追溯性TSGLI（意味着从过去的某个日期开始生效）。

无论损伤发生在何处，无论您是否在执行任务，也无论您受伤时SGLI保险是否有效，您都可以使用 此福利。

注意：我们已取消了您必须在“持久自由行动”或“伊拉克自由行动”（OEF或OIF）期间受伤的先前要 求。了解您是否符合追溯性福利的资格

谁受保障？

受SGLI保障的服役人员

通过TSGLI我可以获得哪些类型的人寿保险福利？

您可能会获得25,000美元至100,000美元的短期经济支持，以帮助您从创伤性损伤中恢复。

## 我如何获得这些福利？

如果您注册了全职SGLI，您将自动获得TSGLI的保障。即使您的伤害发生在非执勤期间，这项保险 也会覆盖您。

要获得包括追溯性TSGLI付款在内的款项，您需要提出申请。要提交索赔，请填写TSGLI福利申请 表（SGLV 8600），并通过传真、电子邮件或邮寄方式发送给我们。请查看表格首页上您所在军种 的地址。下载TSGLI福利申请表（PDF）

如果我的福利申请被拒绝，我该如何提出上诉？

首先，查看您从所属军种收到的拒绝信。您的信件会告知您是否应使用TSGLI上诉请求表（SGLV 8600A），以及您需要在上诉提交期限内完成。

如果您的信件要求您填写此表格，请填写并提交给您所属的军种。下载TSGLI上诉请求表（PDF）

我需要为这些福利支付多少费用？

如果您有SGLI保险，您的SGLI保费（会自动从基本工资中扣除）中包含每月1美元的TSGLI固定费 率保费。这就是您为此福利需要支付的全部费用。

# Tuition Assistance Top-Up | Veterans Affairs

# Tuition Assistance Top-Up

Does your college tuition cost more than what s covered by the Tuition Assistance (TA) program? Find out if you can get more money to help pay for school through the Tuition Assistance Top-Up program.

### Am I eligible for tuition assistance?

You can get tuition assistance if you re approved for federal TA and you meet both of the requirements listed below.

Both of these must be true:

- You qualify for Montgomery GI Bill Active Duty (MGIB-AD) or Post-9/11 GI Bill benefits, and
- The cost of the course and fees is more than TA will cover.

### Who s covered?

Veterans

## What benefits can I get?

You can get more tuition funding to cover the difference between the full cost of a college course and the amount covered under active-duty TA for up to 36 months.

## How do I get these benefits?

You ll need to apply. Apply for benefits

If you re using the Montgomery GI Bill, you ll get the difference between the DoD payment and the total cost of the course. If you re using the Post-9/11 GI Bill, we ll pay back your school the difference between the DoD payment and the authorized (approved) maximum tuition and fees.

Note: It s very important that you talk with your education officer and use the GI Bill Comparison Tool before applying for benefits through this program. Using Top-Up will affect your GI Bill payments, so you ll want to think carefully about your situation before applying. If you re going to take more courses after leaving the military, figure out if the GI Bill benefits you have left will cover your needs. Use the GI Bill Comparison Tool

- If you use the Montgomery GI Bill, this benefit will be reduced, or charged, one month of entitlement for each payment received that is equal to the full-time monthly GI Bill rate. See the rate tables
- If you use the Post-9/11 GI Bill, this benefit will be charged based on training time no matter how much money you re paid back. Half-time training rates reduce your GI Bill benefit by a half-month for each month you re enrolled.

Exception: In no case will the combined amount paid by DoD and VA be more than the total cost of the course.

## Get more information

Read the Top-Up fact sheet (PDF)

# 教程援助 | 退伍军人事务部

## 教程援助

如果您正在使用VA教育援助，并且在课程学习上遇到困难，我们可能帮助您支付辅导费用。了解其 运作方式。

### 我是否有资格获得此福利？

如果您正在使用VA教育援助，并且满足以下列出的所有要求，您就可以获得此福利。

以下所有条件必须为真：

- 您注册了半日制或以上的教育项目，并且

- 您正在修读一门困难的课程，并且

- 您必须将该课程作为您教育项目的一部分

### 谁受保障？

退伍军人

## 我可以获得哪些福利？

用于支付辅导费用的资金

注意：我们每月支付的辅导费用不会超过100美元，且总金额不会超过1,200美元。

## 我如何获得此福利？

- 您所在学校的课程讲师（或教师）必须同意您需要辅导，并代表您写一封信。讲师应将信发送 给您学校的认证官员，并将副本添加到您的VA学生档案中。

- 如果您的学校批准您需要辅导，它将为您指派一名辅导员，并确认辅导员的时薪。

- 在接受辅导后，您、您的辅导员和您学校的认证官员必须填写并签署个性化教程援助申请表（ VA表格22-1990t）。如果您使用的是Post-9/11 GI

Bill，您的讲师还必须签署此表格的第18部分。下载VA表格22-1990t（PDF）

- 表格必须在最后一次认证辅导课程日期（表格上的第12b项）当天或之后签署并注明日期。

如果您使用的是蒙哥马利GI法案（MGIB），在从您的福利中扣除之前，您最多可以获得600美元。 如果您使用的是Post-9/11 GI Bill或受抚养人教育援助（DEA），我们不会从您的GI Bill福利中扣除。

注意：使用预备役教育援助计划（REAP）福利的预备役人员不能同时获得教程援助。
